papers.title: MeerKAT Reveals Evidence of a Radio Megahalo at GHz Frequency
papers.abstract: Radio megahalos are recently discovered large-scale diffuse synchrotron sources identified through LOFAR observations. We present MeerKAT L-band observations of the massive galaxy cluster RXC~J0528.9$-$3927, that reveals faint emission surrounding its central radio halo. At 1.28 GHz, the known $\sim1.14$ Mpc halo is embedded within previously unreported low-surface-brightness emission extending to $\sim2$ Mpc. The surface-brightness profile of the emission shows a distinct flattening beyond $\sim0.55R_{500}$, suggesting that the outer emission forms an additional component. These properties make the cluster a candidate megahalo system and potentially the first detected at GHz frequencies, although deeper multi-frequency observations are required for confirmation.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, accepted for publication in URSI Radio Science Letters

analysis.title_zh: MeerKAT 在 GHz 频率揭示射电巨晕的证据
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告 MeerKAT L 波段对大质量星系团 RXC J0528.9−3927 的观测，在已知约 1.14 Mpc 中心射电晕之外发现延展至约 2 Mpc 的低表面亮度弥散辐射。摘要称其表面亮度剖面在约 0.55R500 外出现明显变平，使该系统成为 GHz 频率下 megahalo 的候选，但仍需更深的多频观测确认。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系团弥散同步辐射追踪宇宙大尺度结构中的磁场、相对论电子和湍流再加速过程，是星系团形成和重子物理的重要探针。对 CMB 研究者而言，这类 GHz 低表面亮度射电组分也关系到星系团前景、SZ/射电联合分析以及未来高灵敏度巡天中的源建模。
key_points: MeerKAT L 波段在 RXC J0528.9−3927 中看到中心射电晕外的低表面亮度弥散辐射。
1.28 GHz 下，已知约 1.14 Mpc 射电晕嵌在延展至约 2 Mpc 的此前未报告辐射中。
作者将其列为候选 megahalo，并强调需要更深的多频观测确认。
methods: MeerKAT L-band observations
1.28 GHz radio continuum analysis
surface-brightness profile of diffuse emission
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对外层低表面亮度辐射的成像、去源和背景处理是否稳健，以及表面亮度剖面变平是否足以支持独立 megahalo 组分而非普通射电晕外延或系统误差。

papers.title: LIGO A$^\sharp$: Detector Design and Science Prospects Beyond A+
papers.abstract: We present the LIGO A$^\sharp$ detector concept, an upgrade for the LIGO observatories based on room-temperature interferometers beyond the fifth observing run (O5). Building on the A+ sensitivity, A$^\sharp$ targets broadband sensitivity improvements through heavier test masses, improved suspensions and seismic isolation, increased arm-cavity power, enhanced frequency-dependent squeezing, reduced coating thermal noise considering two scenarios, and improved control of mechanical motion and optical modes. We describe the principal design choices, projected noise performance, and corresponding astrophysical prospects. LIGO A$^\sharp$ substantially increases compact-binary detection rates, strengthens population inference, and improves both early-warning times and localization for binary neutron star mergers. The improved sensitivity enables more detailed studies of compact-binary coalescences, including higher-order multipoles, intermediate-mass black holes, remnant black hole ringdown, and the neutron star equation of state. It also broadens the discovery potential for new gravitational-wave sources such as continuous waves and bursts, should enable detection of the stochastic background from compact binary mergers if it remains undetected after O5, and strengthens the role of gravitational-wave detectors as probes of fundamental physics. We discuss key technical challenges and the role of A$^\sharp$ as both a major scientific upgrade for the 2030s and a technology pathfinder for next-generation gravitational-wave observatories, such as Cosmic Explorer.

analysis.title_zh: LIGO A^sharp：超越 A+ 的探测器设计与科学前景
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出 LIGO A^sharp 探测器概念，作为 O5 之后基于室温干涉仪的 LIGO 升级方案，并概述主要设计选择、预期噪声表现和天体物理前景。摘要称该升级将显著提高紧致双星探测率、族群推断能力、双中子星预警和定位，并扩展对连续波、爆发源和紧致双星随机背景的发现潜力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文与 CMB 的直接交集不大，但与宇宙学中的引力波背景和基础物理探针相关。若 A^sharp 能提升随机引力波背景灵敏度，它将与 CMB 对早期宇宙、相变、暴胀或紧致源背景的约束形成互补，不过摘要中强调的是紧致双星并合随机背景而非原初背景。
key_points: 提出 O5 之后面向 LIGO 台站的 A^sharp 室温干涉仪升级概念。
设计目标包括更重测试质量、改进悬挂与隔震、更高臂腔功率、频率相关压缩和降低镀膜热噪声等。
预期提升紧致双星探测率、定位和预警能力，并增强随机背景、连续波和爆发现象的发现潜力。
methods: LIGO A^sharp 探测器概念设计
投影噪声性能评估
基于设计灵敏度的天体物理前景评估
两种降低镀膜热噪声情景
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对投影噪声曲线、各升级项对灵敏度的边际贡献、随机背景可探测性所依赖的背景模型，以及 A^sharp 与 Cosmic Explorer 等下一代设施之间的技术承接关系。

papers.title: Constraints on ultralight bosons from merging binary and remnant black holes observed during the second and third parts of the fourth LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observing run
authors: J. F. J. van den Brand
papers.abstract: We present constraints on ultralight bosons using binary black hole mergers observed in the second and third parts of the fourth LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observing run. Directed searches are conducted for long-transient gravitational waves from ultralight vector boson clouds around merger remnants, using a hidden-Markov-model (HMM) tracking scheme. We target the remnant black holes formed in the binary coalescences that produced GW250114 and GW250207. We find no evidence for such signals from either target. Estimating our search sensitivity at a threshold corresponding to a 1% false alarm probability, we thus disfavor vector boson masses in the range of $[2.80, 3.95]\times 10^{-13}$ eV with greater than 90% confidence. In addition, we derive constraints on ultralight scalar and vector bosons from the inferred high spins of the constituent black holes in three binaries, using events GW240515, GW241113, and GW241225_08. The excluded mass ranges in this approach depend on the assumed black-hole ages. At $10^5$ years, corresponding to typical dynamically formed binaries, we exclude scalar and vector bosons in the ranges $[1.39, 6.94]\times 10^{-13}$ eV and $[0.32, 14.4]\times 10^{-13}$ eV at 90% confidence, respectively.
papers.comment: 27 pages (12 pages author list, 15 pages main paper), 5 figures

analysis.title_zh: 利用 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 第四观测轮第二和第三部分观测到的并合双黑洞及遗迹黑洞约束超轻玻色子
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 第四观测轮后续双黑洞并合事件检验超轻玻色子，既对并合遗迹黑洞周围矢量玻色子云的长暂态引力波进行 HMM 定向搜索，也利用部分双星组分黑洞的高自旋推导约束。摘要报告未在 GW250114 和 GW250207 遗迹中发现相应信号，并给出若干矢量与标量超轻玻色子质量区间的 90% 置信排除，后者依赖黑洞年龄假设。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要属于引力波和粒子天体物理，但与宇宙学中的暗物质候选体相关：超轻玻色子是波状暗物质/类轴子暗物质的重要模型族。对 CMB 研究者而言，它提供了与早期宇宙和大尺度结构约束互补的强场黑洞检验，不过摘要内容并未直接涉及 CMB 数据或参数推断。
key_points: 利用 O4 第二、三部分的双黑洞并合事件约束超轻玻色子。
对 GW250114 和 GW250207 的并合遗迹黑洞进行长暂态引力波定向搜索，未发现信号。
还利用若干双黑洞组分的高自旋推导标量与矢量超轻玻色子的质量排除范围。
methods: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 第四观测轮第二、三部分的双黑洞并合事件
针对遗迹黑洞的长暂态引力波定向搜索
隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）跟踪方案
基于 1% 误警概率阈值的搜索灵敏度估计
利用 GW240515、GW241113、GW241225_08 中组分黑洞高自旋进行约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 HMM 搜索的信号模型、灵敏度注入/恢复流程、1% 误警概率阈值如何转化为大于 90% 置信排除，以及基于黑洞高自旋的约束对黑洞年龄和形成通道假设的依赖。

papers.title: Testing Covarying Coupling Constants (CCC) against the full SPARC rotation-curve sample: a like-for-like comparison with MOND and NFW
papers.abstract: The Covarying Coupling Constants (CCC) framework, developed to account for high-redshift JWST observations, contains a mechanism -- a covarying-constant effective mass field keyed to local density -- that modifies galactic dynamics without particle dark matter. We test it against the full Spitzer Photometry and Accurate Rotation Curves (SPARC) sample of 175 disc galaxies, extending an earlier study of a few objects. Working in an inverse formulation, in which each model predicts the baryonic rotation curve from the observed one, we compare CCC against Modified Newtonian Dynamics (MOND) and one- and two-parameter Navarro-Frenk-White (NFW) haloes on identical footing, using the reduced $χ^2_ν$. We show that the published sharp density turn-off in the earlier study is unphysical and replace it with a smooth transition -- the density-space analogue of the MOND interpolating function, introducing no new parameter. One-parameter smooth-CCC then performs comparably to galaxy-by-galaxy fitted MOND (the lower $χ^2_ν$ in 56 per cent of galaxies, mean $χ^2_ν$ of 2.58 versus 2.65; the paired difference is not significant), while two-parameter NFW shows a substantially broader fit-quality distribution and a larger tail of poor or boundary-limited fits (mean $χ^2_ν\approx 7$). The CCC turn-off density is not universal (scatter 0.82 dex) and correlates with galaxy size, qualitatively consistent with a spherical reconstruction applied to flattened disc systems. Recast as an acceleration, however, $a_t = V_{\rm flat}^2/R_t$ has scatter 0.33 dex (on the 91-galaxy resolved subset) -- matching the MOND scale $a_0$ (0.34 dex) -- and comparable magnitude of order $2 \times 10^{-10}$ m/s$^2$, with its size correlation removed. Though not designed for galactic dynamics, CCC describes rotation curves as well as galaxy-by-galaxy fitted MOND.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables, a montage of 165 galaxy rotation curves as supplementary material. Comments are welcomed

analysis.title_zh: 用完整 SPARC 旋转曲线样本检验共变耦合常数（CCC）：与 MOND 和 NFW 的同等条件比较
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用完整 SPARC 175 个盘星系旋转曲线样本检验 Covarying Coupling Constants（CCC）框架，并在相同反演设定下与 MOND 和 NFW 晕比较。摘要报告，经平滑密度转变修正后的一参数 CCC 与逐星系拟合 MOND 的约化卡方表现相当，而两参数 NFW 出现更宽的拟合质量分布和更多差拟合或边界受限情况。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系旋转曲线是暗物质或修正引力模型的低红移检验，与 CMB 推断出的 ΛCDM 暗物质图景形成互补。若 CCC 这类无粒子暗物质机制能在星系尺度拟合旋转曲线，它需要进一步面对 CMB 声学峰、结构增长和背景宇宙学的一致性检验；但本摘要只讨论星系动力学样本，并未给出 CMB 约束。
key_points: 用完整 SPARC 175 个盘星系样本检验 CCC 星系动力学表现。
采用反演表述，用相同标准比较 CCC、MOND 与 NFW。
摘要称平滑 CCC 与逐星系拟合的 MOND 表现相近，而两参数 NFW 的拟合质量分布更宽且差拟合尾部更大。
methods: SPARC（Spitzer Photometry and Accurate Rotation Curves）175 个盘星系样本
反演表述：由观测旋转曲线预测重子旋转曲线
与 MOND、一参数和两参数 NFW 晕作同等比较
约化卡方 χ²ν
用平滑密度转变替代尖锐密度截断
91 个星系的 resolved subset 用于加速度散布比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“反演表述”是否对各模型真正公平、质量光度比和距离等星系系统误差如何处理、CCC 平滑转变是否确实未引入新自由度，以及与 MOND/NFW 的 χ²ν 比较是否受样本选择或边界拟合影响。

papers.title: How to Identify a Majoron: Effective Field Theories of Spontaneous Lepton Number Breaking
papers.abstract: We revisit the traditional Type I, II and III Seesaw mechanisms in the presence of a complex scalar field charged under a global $U(1)$ symmetry that can be identified with lepton number and the Peccei-Quinn symmetry. After symmetry breaking, the radial mode becomes heavy while the angular mode appears as an axion-like particle, traditionally dubbed the Majoron. We construct the effective field theory obtained after integrating out the heavy states and analyse two matching orders: first removing the radial mode and then the Seesaw fields, and vice versa. Both procedures yield the same low-energy Lagrangian containing only Standard Model fields and the Majoron. Because a single vacuum expectation value fixes the mediator masses, the radial mode and every Majoron coupling, these models predict relations among observables rather than their individual size, and it is these relations that are testable. Indeed, the invisible Higgs width is locked to the universal suppression of the Higgs couplings, while the Majoron-lepton coupling is fixed by the measured non-unitarity of the leptonic mixing matrix, and the two independently give comparable lower bounds on the same lepton-number breaking scale, of order $1$-$10$ TeV. Neutrinoless double beta decay with Majoron emission, by contrast, has no sensitivity in this class of models. The framework is thus falsifiable even when the new states lie far beyond experimental reach.

analysis.title_zh: 如何识别 Majoron：自发轻子数破缺的有效场论
analysis.summary_zh: 本文重新考察在带全局 U(1) 复标量场时的 I、II、III 型 Seesaw 机制，并构造积分出重态后的含标准模型场与 Majoron 的有效场论。摘要报告两种匹配顺序得到相同低能拉氏量，且模型通过不可见 Higgs 宽度、Higgs 耦合压低和轻子混合非幺正性之间的关系而可证伪，而 Majoron 发射的无中微子双β衰变在此类模型中无灵敏度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章偏粒子唯象和中微子质量起源，与宇宙学的联系在于轻子数破缺、轴子样粒子和潜在暗扇区自由度可能影响早期宇宙热史与辐射组分。对 CMB 研究者而言，它提示 Majoron/类轴子模型若要作为宇宙学新物理，需要与实验室可观测关系共同检验；但摘要没有直接讨论 CMB、Neff 或宇宙学数据约束。
key_points: 研究带有全局 U(1) 对称性复标量场的 I/II/III 型 Seesaw 机制。
对重态积分出低能 EFT，角向模表现为 Majoron。
摘要强调可检验的是不同观测量之间的关系，而非单个耦合大小；Majoron 发射的无中微子双β衰变在该模型类中无灵敏度。
methods: I、II、III 型 Seesaw 机制
带轻子数/Peccei-Quinn 对称性解释的复标量场
自发对称性破缺后的径向模与角向模分析
积分出重态得到有效场论
两种匹配顺序：先去除径向模再去除 Seesaw 场，及相反顺序
低能拉氏量匹配与可观测量关系分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对两种匹配顺序等价性的假设范围、Majoron 各耦合与同一个真空期望值之间的关系如何推出，以及不可见 Higgs 宽度、Higgs 耦合普遍压低和轻子混合非幺正性给出相近 TeV 标度下限的具体前提。

papers.title: Torsional pseudo-inflation beyond Einstein-Cartan
papers.abstract: Torsion entered early-universe cosmology twice: through the nonsingular Einstein--Cartan bounce, where the quantum spin of fermions halts the contraction, and through the proposal that the expansion following that bounce could take over the duties of cosmic inflation. We revisit the second idea in a constructive spirit. First we compute its budget: for a Weyssenhoff spin fluid with barotropic source, $w\in\left[0,1\right]$, the accelerated window that follows the bounce spans $N_e=\ln\left[4/\left(1+3w\right)\right]/3\left(1-w\right)\leq\tfrac{1}{3}\ln4\simeq0.46$ e-folds, and positive spatial curvature only shrinks it. The mechanism is sound; its torsional ``fuel'' dilutes as $a^{-6}$, and the engine stops two orders of magnitude short of inflationary needs. We then ask what torsion would need in order to sustain a quasi-de Sitter phase, and give a two-branch answer in Riemann--Cartan cosmology with nonminimal couplings, where torsion is fed by the couplings rather than by spin. The vectorial branch reproduces Palatini inflation, observationally alive. On the axial branch we exhibit an exact de Sitter solution sustained by a torsion condensate: constant axial torsion $f_{0}$, a linear Gauss--Bonnet coupling, and a potential fixed to $V_{0}=6f_{0}^{2}+\tfrac{5}{2}v^{2}$ by the Friedmann constraint. The solution is an attractor of the homogeneous dynamics, with eigenvalue exactly $-3H$. The phase ends when the slope $U^{\prime}$, a decreasing function of the roll speed at fixed flat potential, drifts down to the floor $5/16V_{0}$ and the condensate switches itself off; consistency of the effective theory pins the whole episode near the Planck scale, $H\gtrsim0.3$ in reduced Planck units. We studied this branch at background level; its perturbation spectrum remains open.

analysis.title_zh: 超越 Einstein-Cartan 理论的挠率伪暴胀
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文重新评估挠率在早期宇宙中替代暴胀的可能性：作者先计算 Einstein-Cartan/Weyssenhoff 自旋流体反弹后的加速窗口，发现最多约 0.46 个 e-folds，远不足以满足暴胀需求。随后他们在含非最小耦合的 Riemann-Cartan 宇宙学中构造两类由耦合维持挠率的准 de Sitter 方案，其中矢量分支对应 Palatini inflation，轴向分支给出一个背景层面的精确 de Sitter 吸引子解，但扰动谱仍是开放问题。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 对早期宇宙加速阶段及其扰动谱高度敏感，因此任何替代或扩展暴胀的机制都必须最终给出可检验的标量、张量和非高斯性预言。该摘要表明作者已经排除了传统自旋流体挠率本身提供足够暴胀的可能，并提出新的挠率驱动背景解；但由于扰动谱尚未给出，它目前对 CMB 观测约束的直接可比性仍有限。
key_points: Einstein-Cartan 自旋流体反弹后的加速阶段不足以承担标准暴胀功能。
作者在含非最小耦合的 Riemann-Cartan 宇宙学中讨论由耦合供给挠率的两类分支。
轴向分支的扰动谱仍未解决，摘要仅报告背景层面的研究。
methods: Weyssenhoff spin fluid with barotropic source
Riemann-Cartan cosmology with nonminimal couplings
vectorial branch / axial branch analysis
exact de Sitter solution
homogeneous dynamics attractor analysis
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：从 Einstein-Cartan 自旋流体得到极少 e-folds 的推导假设是否稳健；非最小耦合下轴向挠率凝聚的有效场论一致性、Planck 标度附近适用性，以及尚未计算的扰动谱是否可能破坏其宇宙学可行性。

papers.title: Magnetic fields in extreme primordial halos: turbulent collapse and implications for early quasar formation
papers.abstract: It is sometimes suggested that the most massive quasars at high redshift may have formed from rare high-sigma peaks in the cosmic density field. We explore here the evolution in a massive primordial halo corresponding to one of these rare sigma peaks, employing cosmological high-resolution magneto-hydrodynamical zoom-in simulations with initial field strength of $10^{-14}-10^{-8}$ G. The dark matter halo forms at the intersection of strongly convergent flows, leading to the formation of highly supersonic turbulence already on intergalactic scales, with turbulent Mach numbers of order $10-20$ also within the halo. Turbulent magnetic field amplification has never been explored in this regime and we therefore investigate whether this gives rise to effects similar to those observed in more typical halos. While the weaker initial field is somewhat more strongly amplified as a result of the shear flows, overall the evolution in the different simulations is rather similar and the flows are dominated by supersonic turbulence. We show in particular that the turbulent Jeans mass always dominates over the thermal and magnetic Jeans masses, and only on scales of $10^{-2}-10$ pc, the magnetic Jeans mass may become comparable to the thermal one. Our simulations thus strongly suggest the evolution to be dominated by the large-scale dynamics. As established in previous work, we thus expect the formation of central massive objects of a few times $10^4$ M$_\odot$ also in the presence of magnetic fields. The situation is somewhat different from more typical atomic cooling halos, where previous results have indicated a larger relevance of the magnetic Jeans mass on intermediate scales, potentially enhancing the mass of the massive object.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 9 figures, 1 table. Accepted for publication in A&A

analysis.title_zh: 极端原初晕中的磁场：湍流坍缩及其对早期类星体形成的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文用高分辨率宇宙学磁流体 zoom-in 模拟研究极端稀有原初暗物质晕中的磁场、湍流坍缩及早期类星体种子形成。摘要报告称，强汇聚流在星系际和晕内尺度产生高马赫数超声速湍流，使湍流 Jeans 质量始终主导热和磁 Jeans 质量，因此整体演化主要由大尺度动力学控制，并预计仍会形成数万太阳质量量级的中心大质量天体。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作与 CMB 的联系较间接，主要通过高红移结构形成、原初磁场和早期黑洞/类星体形成影响宇宙再电离及热历史。对 CMB 研究者而言，它可作为理解早期天体源族、再电离背景和原初磁场天体物理后果的辅助文献，而不是直接的 CMB 各向异性分析。
key_points: 研究对象是高红移极大质量类星体可能的稀有原初晕。
模拟显示流体演化主要由大尺度超声速湍流主导。
磁场在部分小尺度上可接近热 Jeans 质量，但总体不主导演化。
methods: cosmological high-resolution magneto-hydrodynamical zoom-in simulations
initial magnetic field strength 10^-14-10^-8 G
massive primordial halo / rare sigma peak setup
comparison of turbulent, thermal, and magnetic Jeans masses
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对模拟的稀有峰初始条件、分辨率和磁场种子设定是否足以支撑对早期类星体形成通道的结论，并检查 Jeans 质量比较是否受亚网格物理或数值耗散影响。

papers.title: A new measurement of the FRB DM-galaxy cross correlation and a first joint analysis with the kinematic SZ effect
papers.abstract: Understanding the distribution of cosmic baryons is crucial for advancing cosmology and galaxy formation. Localized Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) are a promising new probe of the diffuse gas, but measurements thus far have been limited by small sample size. In this work, we measure the FRB dispersion measure (DM)-galaxy cross correlation with 130 localized FRBs, including new spectroscopic host redshifts from the DSA-110, and the DESI Legacy Survey Bright Galaxy Sample. We detect this signal at the highest significance to date ($6.5σ$) in both configuration and harmonic space. By comparing to simulations and a halo model, we demonstrate that this statistic can constrain the strength of baryonic feedback. Our measurements disfavor a no-feedback scenario in which gas traces the underlying dark matter at $\sim\,9σ$. In addition to small scale feedback, this represents one of the first direct measurements of the clustering of electrons on scales larger than a few Mpc. We compare our measurement to recent kinematic Sunyaev-Zeldovich effect (kSZ) studies, which show good agreement despite the differences in observational methods and sample selection. Finally, we make a first attempt at breaking the kSZ optical depth degeneracy with FRBs, jointly measuring the growth rate of large-scale structure $fσ_8$. With future samples, FRB two-point statistics will provide precision constraints on the distribution of cosmic baryons and complement other probes.

analysis.title_zh: FRB 色散量-星系互相关的新测量及其与运动学 SZ 效应的首次联合分析
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文用 130 个定位快速射电暴及 DESI Legacy Survey 明亮星系样本测量 FRB 色散量与星系的互相关，并在实空间和谐空间报告 6.5σ 检测。作者将测量与模拟和 halo model 比较，说明该统计量可约束重子反馈，排斥无反馈气体追踪暗物质情形，并首次尝试与运动学 SZ 效应联合以约束大尺度结构增长率 fσ8。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 次级各向异性直接相关，因为 kSZ 信号追踪自由电子的动量场，但通常受光学深度和气体分布不确定性限制。FRB 的 DM 提供独立的电子柱密度探针，若能与 kSZ 联合，可帮助约束宇宙重子分布、反馈物理和结构增长，对 CMB-S4 等未来 kSZ 宇宙学分析具有现实意义。
key_points: 使用 130 个定位 FRB 测量 DM-星系互相关，并报告迄今最高显著性检测。
该统计量可约束重子反馈，并排斥气体完全追踪暗物质的无反馈情形。
论文首次尝试将 FRB 与 kSZ 联合，用于缓解 kSZ 光学深度简并并测量 fσ8。
methods: 130 localized FRBs
new spectroscopic host redshifts from DSA-110
DESI Legacy Survey Bright Galaxy Sample
FRB dispersion measure-galaxy cross correlation
configuration-space and harmonic-space measurements
simulations and halo model comparison
comparison and joint analysis with kinematic Sunyaev-Zeldovich effect studies
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 FRB 样本选择、宿主红移、银河系/宿主 DM 扣除、星系样本选择函数和协方差估计；同时检查 FRB-DM 与 kSZ 联合分析中对光学深度简并、反馈模型和 fσ8 先验的处理是否自洽。

papers.title: All You Need is not $Ω_\mathrm{gw}$: Beyond the Mean of the Cross-Correlation Estimator when Searching for an Astrophysical Gravitational-Wave Background
papers.abstract: Searches for the stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) using ground-based detectors rely heavily on the cross-correlation estimator $\bar C_f$, whose statistical properties determine the theoretical foundation for inference frameworks built on it. Past analyses usually assume Gaussianity of $\bar C_f$, but this assumption has not been systematically tested for a background of astrophysical origin like the one produced by compact binary coalescences. In this work, we decompose $\bar C_f$ into three physically motivated components: (1) the mean intensity, (2) the geometrical shot noise, and (3) the polarization leakage, and we compute 90\% credible intervals for its cumulants up to fourth order for the binary black hole, binary neutron star, and neutron star-black hole populations by propagating local merger rate uncertainties. We find that for the upcoming LIGO O5 sensitivity, $\bar C_f$ remains effectively Gaussian for all three populations, validating current Gaussian likelihood frameworks. For Cosmic Explorer (CE), however, the $\bar C_f$ produced by binary black holes becomes non-Gaussian, with skewness and excess kurtosis of $0.31^{+0.04}_{-0.03}$ and $1.3^{+0.4}_{-0.3}$, respectively, in the most sensitive band over a one-year observation period. For binary neutron star and neutron star - black hole mergers, $\bar C_f$ remains largely Gaussian even at CE. These results indicate that the Edgeworth expansion provides an adequate leading-order description of the non-Gaussianity expected in the next-generation era, while also motivating the development of more sophisticated statistical methods for a more accurate treatment.

analysis.title_zh: 你需要的不只是 $Ω_\mathrm{gw}$：在搜索天体物理引力波背景时超越交叉相关估计量的均值
analysis.summary_zh: 本文检验天体物理起源随机引力波背景搜索中交叉相关估计量是否可近似为高斯分布，并将其分解为平均强度、几何 shot noise 和偏振泄漏三部分来计算至四阶累积量。摘要报告称 LIGO O5 下三类致密双星种群基本支持高斯似然，而 Cosmic Explorer 下双黑洞背景会产生可观非高斯性，需用 Edgeworth 展开或更复杂统计方法处理。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 随机引力波背景是与 CMB 互补的早期宇宙和天体物理背景探针；虽然本文聚焦地面引力波而非 CMB，但其对背景场统计量非高斯性和似然建模的讨论，与 CMB 随机场分析、非高斯检验和未来高灵敏度实验的数据解释有方法学关联。
key_points: 研究对象是地面引力波探测器搜索随机引力波背景时使用的交叉相关估计量。
摘要称 LIGO O5 情形下三类致密双星背景的估计量仍近似高斯。
在 Cosmic Explorer 情形下，双黑洞背景的交叉相关估计量出现非高斯性，Edgeworth 展开可作领先阶描述。
methods: 将交叉相关估计量分解为平均强度、几何 shot noise、偏振泄漏三项
计算至四阶累积量的 90% 可信区间
传播本地并合率不确定性
考虑双黑洞、双中子星、中子星-黑洞种群
比较 LIGO O5 与 Cosmic Explorer 灵敏度情形
Edgeworth expansion
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对交叉相关估计量三项分解的假设、并合率不确定性的先验/传播方式，以及 Edgeworth 展开在 CE 非高斯区间内的适用范围。

papers.title: Fine-tuning in mixed Dark Matter models with Primordial Black Hole relics
papers.abstract: We investigate the fine-tuning of a tripartite dark matter (DM) scenario involving ultra-light primordial black holes (PBHs), whose evaporation before Big Bang Nucleosynthesis leaves Planck-mass relics and produces DM particles together with an independently produced DM component. We uniformly evaluate the parameter sensitivity required to reproduce the observed DM abundance, $Ω_{\rm DM}$. Considering thermal WIMP freeze-out, freeze-in, and QCD axion misalignment, and assuming PBHs form via collapse of perturbations following horizon entry, we find that the fine-tuning is normally dominated by the structure of the PBH relic abundance calculation rather than by the particle DM candidate or the details of PBH evaporation. In radiation-dominated cosmologies, the DM abundance is highly sensitive to the primordial curvature power spectrum because the PBH formation fraction depends exponentially on density fluctuations. Although an early PBH-dominated era dilutes pre-existing abundances and reduces the apparent tuning of the PBH abundance, inflationary fine-tuning remains required to produce the required initial large amplitude perturbations. We further examine alternative PBH formation channels, including supercooled first-order phase transitions and collapsing domain walls, and find that they replace the inflationary fine-tuning with alternative exponential sensitivities. We conclude that a natural realization of an order unity PBH relic abundance is hard to motivate.

analysis.title_zh: 含原初黑洞遗迹的混合暗物质模型中的精细调节
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究包含超轻原初黑洞蒸发后普朗克质量遗迹、PBH 蒸发产生暗物质粒子以及独立产生暗物质组分的三组分暗物质模型，统一评估为复现实测暗物质丰度所需的参数敏感性。摘要报告称，精细调节通常由 PBH 遗迹丰度计算结构主导；辐射主导宇宙中丰度对原初曲率功率谱高度敏感，而替代形成机制也引入类似的指数敏感性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: PBH、暗物质丰度和原初曲率扰动都与早期宇宙物理直接相关；CMB 对原初扰动、暴胀模型和宇宙组分有强约束，因此这类 PBH 遗迹暗物质模型的自然性会影响其与 CMB 宇宙学框架的相容性判断。
key_points: 研究三组分暗物质情景：超轻 PBH 蒸发遗迹、PBH 产生的暗物质粒子、独立产生的暗物质组分。
摘要称在辐射主导宇宙中，PBH 形成丰度对原初曲率功率谱呈指数敏感。
作者认为要自然得到数量级为 1 的 PBH 遗迹丰度很难。
methods: 参数敏感性/精细调节评估
热 WIMP freeze-out、freeze-in、QCD 轴子 misalignment 情景比较
假设 PBH 由视界进入后的扰动坍缩形成
考察辐射主导宇宙学、早期 PBH 主导时期
替代 PBH 形成机制：过冷一级相变、坍缩畴壁
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其“精细调节”度量的定义、参数先验选择，以及 PBH 形成分数对曲率扰动的指数敏感性如何被量化；还要检查早期 PBH 主导时期中稀释效应与暴胀初始条件调节是否被一致处理。

papers.title: TauPolaris: reconstructing tau lepton polarimetric vectors with conditional normalizing flows
papers.abstract: The kinematics of tau lepton decay products depend on the tau spin, giving access to the spin correlations and CP structure of the process that produced them. The optimal spin observable is the polarimetric vector, which points along the most likely direction of the tau spin. Determining it requires the momenta of the neutrinos produced in the tau decays, which escape detection and must therefore be inferred. We present TauPolaris, a tool for reconstructing tau polarimetric vectors by estimating the undetected neutrino momenta with a conditional normalizing flow. Rather than performing a point regression, the method models the full conditional density of the neutrino kinematics, providing both the most likely configuration for each event and an estimate of its uncertainty. The resolution of the reconstructed spin observables improves on that obtained from networks trained with a mean-squared-error loss. Using simulated LHC proton-proton collisions, including detector resolution effects, we demonstrate the method in three applications. For tau leptons produced in Higgs boson decays, we show that the presence of quantum entanglement can be distinguished from its absence with a significance of at least $4.3σ$ at the High-Luminosity LHC. We demonstrate an 18% improvement in the sensitivity to CP violation in $H\rightarrowττ$ decays. Finally, we introduce new variables for suppressing the $Z\rightarrowττ$ background in Higgs boson searches.

analysis.title_zh: TauPolaris：用条件归一化流重建 tau 轻子的极化分析矢量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出 TauPolaris，用条件 normalizing flow 从 tau 衰变产物中推断不可见中微子动量，从而重建 tau 极化矢量。摘要报告称该方法较均方误差回归网络改善自旋观测量分辨率，并在模拟 LHC 数据中提升 Higgs 到 tau 衰变的量子纠缠、CP 破坏和背景抑制分析能力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于粒子物理和 collider phenomenology，与 CMB 观测没有直接联系；对宇宙学读者的相关性在于其处理不可见自由度、概率密度重建和不确定性估计的方法，可能对复杂观测反演问题有参考价值。
key_points: 提出 TauPolaris，用条件 normalizing flow 重建 tau 衰变中不可见中微子动量。
方法输出中微子运动学的条件密度，而非单点回归。
摘要报告其在 LHC 模拟中改善自旋观测量分辨率，并用于 Higgs 衰变纠缠、CP 破坏和背景抑制研究。
methods: 条件 normalizing flows
tau 极化矢量重建
未探测中微子动量估计
模拟 LHC 质子-质子碰撞
包含探测器分辨率效应
与均方误差损失训练网络比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对模拟样本、探测器效应和系统误差处理是否足以支撑所报 HL-LHC 显著性与 CP 灵敏度提升，并检查 normalizing flow 的条件变量和不确定性校准。

papers.title: Fitting trends in quasar emission and absorption line redshifts
papers.abstract: The spectrum of a quasar consists of a few emission lines whose wavelengths are shifted by similar redshifts and numerous absorption lines whose wavelengths are shifted by different redshifts. Hence each quasar is characterised by an emission line redshift and the absorption lines redshifts are all less than the emission line redshift. The distribution of observed absorption line redshifts ($z_{abs}$) with respect to emission line redshift ($z_{em}$) for a large sample of quasars shows a systematic trend as pointed out by \citet{2016arXiv160901593K}. They noticed that increase in $z_{em}$ is accompanied by a monotonic increase in the lowest detected value of $z_{abs}$ and inferred that the emission and absorption lines were all formed in the quasar. This study focuses on modeling the systematic trend in the observed $z_{em} \rightarrow z_{abs}$ distribution. We considered the redshift data of absorption lines of singly ionized magnesium (denoted by MgII) and triply ionized carbon (denoted by CIV) for a large sample of quasars. We find that the envelope of data points defining the lowest value of the MgII absorption line redshift (which we denote by $z_{MgIImodel}$) for a given $z_{em}$ satisfies $z_{MgIImodel} = (0.418 \pm 0.008) z_{em} - (0.482 \pm 0.02)$ with an $R^2$ value of 0.99. The model can be used to predict the lowest expected MgII absorption line redshift for any $z_{em}$. We find a similar model for the lowest expected redshift of triply ionized carbon lines for any $z_{em}$ which is $z_{CIVmodel} = 0.845 (\pm 0.0002) z_{em} - 0.153 (\pm 0.0006)$.

analysis.title_zh: 拟合类星体发射线与吸收线红移中的趋势
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对大样本类星体中发射线红移与吸收线红移的系统趋势进行建模，分别使用 MgII 和 CIV 吸收线数据拟合给定发射线红移下最低预期吸收线红移。摘要报告了两个线性包络模型，其中 MgII 模型给出很高的 R^2 值，并声称可用于预测任意发射线红移下的最低 MgII 吸收线红移。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 类星体吸收线常用于研究星系际介质、化学演化和大尺度结构，也可能进入宇宙学红移分布分析；但该摘要主要是类星体光谱经验关系，对 CMB 本身没有直接影响，更多属于宇宙学背景源和高红移吸收系统的相关课题。
key_points: 研究类星体发射线红移与吸收线红移分布的经验趋势。
使用 MgII 和 CIV 吸收线数据拟合最低吸收线红移包络。
摘要给出两个线性经验模型及其拟合不确定度。
methods: 大样本类星体吸收线红移数据
MgII 与 CIV 吸收线
发射线红移与吸收线红移分布的包络拟合
线性模型与 R^2 指标
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对样本选择、吸收线识别和探测阈值是否会人为塑造最低红移包络；还需检查作者从经验拟合到物理解释的推断是否充分。

papers.title: ATLAS. III. Dust Around Little Red Dots: Hydrogen Line Ratios beyond Dust-free Non-Case B Models
papers.abstract: We investigate broad hydrogen line ratios in little red dots (LRDs) using five high-redshift ($z>2$) sources from JWST/NIRSpec medium/high-resolution spectra in the DAWN JWST Archive and fifteen low-redshift sources ($z=0.1$--$0.9$) from the literature, all with broad H$β$ detected at $>5σ$. After carefully measuring the broad-line fluxes while accounting for absorption features and neighboring emission lines, we find that the broad H$α$/H$β$ ratios are very high, ranging from 6 to 30, well above the Case B recombination value. Using plane-parallel \textsc{Cloudy} photoionization models with the total line emission from both sides of the slab, we investigate the physical origin of the broad hydrogen line ratios beyond Case B, jointly modeling the Balmer and Paschen line ratios for the subset of one high-$z$ and two low-$z$ LRDs with detected broad Paschen lines. We find that one low-$z$ LRD is reproduced by a high gas number density ($\log (n_{\mathrm H}/{\rm cm^{-3}})\sim10$--11) on the broad-line H$α$/H$β$--Pa$β$/Pa$γ$ plane, whereas the remaining two LRDs additionally require substantial dust extinction of $E(B-V)\gtrsim0.2$--$1.0$, even after accounting for non-Case B effects. Since the narrow H$α$/H$β$ ratios do not indicate such large dust extinction, these results demonstrate that the obscuring dust is spatially associated with the broad-line region. Even without Paschen-line measurements, two and eight LRDs in the high- and low-redshift samples, respectively, exhibit H$α$/H$β>13$, which cannot be reproduced by the non-Case B models, suggesting that dust obscuration might be common among LRDs, occurring in at least about half of the population. Such dust may represent a lower-column-density counterpart of the dusty torus in AGNs, reconciling the weak hot-dust emission.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 10 figures in the main text, 8 figures in the Appendix, 2 Tables. Submitted to ApJ. Comments are welcome

analysis.title_zh: ATLAS III. Little Red Dots 周围的尘埃：超越无尘非 Case B 模型的氢线比
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 JWST/NIRSpec 高红移样本和低红移文献样本研究 little red dots 的宽氢线比，并用 Cloudy 光电离模型考察非 Case B 效应与尘埃消光。摘要报告称许多对象的宽 Hα/Hβ 过高，部分即使考虑非 Case B 效应仍需显著尘埃遮蔽，且尘埃可能与宽线区空间相关。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作与 CMB 的直接联系较弱，但涉及高红移星系/AGN 样本的尘埃遮蔽和谱线诊断，关系到早期星系与黑洞增长图景；这些天体物理过程会影响再电离史、红外/亚毫米背景和前景建模，从而间接关联 CMB 宇宙学解释。
key_points: 研究 little red dots 的宽氢线比，样本包括 JWST/NIRSpec 高红移源和低红移文献源。
摘要称宽 Hα/Hβ 比显著高于 Case B 复合预期，非 Case B 模型仍不足以解释部分对象。
结果指向与宽线区空间相关的尘埃遮蔽，且可能在 LRD 中较常见。
methods: JWST/NIRSpec medium/high-resolution spectra
DAWN JWST Archive
文献低红移样本
宽线流量测量并校正吸收特征与邻近发射线
plane-parallel Cloudy photoionization models
联合建模 Balmer 和 Paschen 线比
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对宽线/窄线分解、吸收和邻线扣除、Cloudy 模型几何与尘埃假设，以及“至少约半数 LRD 有尘埃遮蔽”这一推断对样本选择和 Paschen 线缺失的敏感性。

papers.title: Evolution of Neutron Star Environment in the Galactic Halo : Implications for Dark Matter Accretion
papers.abstract: Neutron stars (NS) are one of the indirect detection probes for dark matter (DM). The presence of DM is known to affect the observable properties of NS. Theoretical calculations for various equations of state of a DM admixed NS lead to estimates of the DM mass in a NS of the order of $10^{-2} M_{\odot}$. On the other hand, simplistic estimates of the amount of DM that is accreted on to the NS in the Solar neighborhood, over its age, suggest that this number is of the order $10^{-14} M_{\odot}$. Various studies have addressed this non-agreement theoretically by explaining the mechanisms leading to higher fraction than expected from smooth spherically symmetric accretion. In this work, we attempt to assess the role of the dynamic DM environmental density in the Galactic halo to explain possible enhancement in DM accretion. We consider a high resolution N-body simulation and method of Voronoi tessellation to calculate local DM density around putative NS locations in a statistically representative sample of Milky Way analogues. We infer that the dynamics of substructure may enhance the DM mass in NS by about a factor 2 as compared to the baseline, spherically symmetric expectation. Environmental effects therefore cannot explain the orders of magnitude discrepancy between equation of state and accretion based estimates of DM admixed in NS.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, Prepared for submission to JCAP

analysis.title_zh: 银河晕中中子星环境的演化：对暗物质吸积的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文考察银河晕中随时间和子结构变化的暗物质环境密度，是否能提高中子星吸积暗物质量，从而缓解暗物质混合中子星状态方程估计与简单吸积估计之间的巨大差异。摘要报告称，在类银河系高分辨率 N 体模拟中，子结构动力学相对于光滑球对称基准只带来约 2 倍增强，无法解释数量级差异。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 中子星作为暗物质间接探针可约束暗物质性质，而这些约束需要银河暗物质分布和小尺度结构建模；这与 CMB 给出的宇宙暗物质总丰度互补，但论文焦点在晚期银河环境和致密星吸积，并非直接 CMB 分析。
key_points: 评估银河晕中动态暗物质环境密度对中子星暗物质吸积的影响。
使用高分辨率 N 体模拟和 Voronoi 剖分估计类银河系样本中假定中子星位置的局域暗物质密度。
摘要称子结构动力学只带来约 2 倍增强，不能解释多个数量级差异。
methods: 高分辨率 N 体模拟
Voronoi tessellation 计算局域暗物质密度
类银河系类似体的统计代表性样本
与光滑球对称吸积基准估计比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对中子星空间分布假设、模拟分辨率对子结构密度峰的刻画能力、Voronoi 密度估计的系统误差，以及“约 2 倍增强”相对于吸积模型不确定性的稳健性。

papers.title: A Wandering 35,000-Solar-Mass Black Hole Fed by a Gravitational Wake
papers.abstract: Intermediate-mass black holes are widely considered to be the seeds of supermassive black holes, a substantial population of which is expected to remain displaced from galactic nuclei owing to hierarchical galaxy assembly and inefficient dynamical friction. While several fueling channels can sustain central black holes, those pathways are largely inaccessible to off-nuclear black holes, leaving their fuel supply uncertain. As these wandering black holes move through the interstellar medium of their host galaxies, theory predicts that they can capture gas from the dense wake produced by gravitational focusing. However, direct observational evidence for this process has remained elusive. Here we report evidence for a wandering intermediate-mass black hole of 35,000 solar mass accreting through such a gravitational wake. Its black-hole nature is supported by broad-line emission, a compact continuum counterpart, long-term optical variability, and a power-law-like spectral energy distribution. Multi-epoch spectroscopy reveals three distinct gas components: a blueshifted, low-density upstream flow; a redshifted, dense downstream wake; and optically thick absorbers well within the capture radius that drive rapid changing-look variability in the broad-line emission. This discovery establishes a previously unobserved channel for the growth of wandering intermediate-mass black holes.

analysis.title_zh: 一个由引力尾迹供给的游荡 35,000 太阳质量黑洞
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文报告一个质量约 35,000 个太阳质量的游荡中等质量黑洞候选体，并提出其通过在星际介质中运动时由引力聚焦形成的气体尾迹吸积。摘要称，多历元光谱揭示上游蓝移低密度流、下游红移致密尾迹和捕获半径内光学厚吸收体三种气体成分，并由此支持一种此前未被直接观测到的游荡黑洞增长通道。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要属于星系与黑洞形成研究，不直接涉及 CMB 观测或早期宇宙参数推断。其宇宙学相关性在于中等质量黑洞被视为超大质量黑洞种子，游荡黑洞的增长效率会影响黑洞种群演化、星系组装历史以及可能的多信使背景源建模。
key_points: 报告一个偏离星系核的中等质量黑洞候选体，质量为 35,000 个太阳质量。
摘要称其吸积来自由引力聚焦形成的致密尾迹。
证据包括宽线发射、紧致连续谱对应体、长期光学变异和类幂律能谱分布。
methods: 多历元光谱观测
宽线发射诊断
紧致连续谱对应体识别
长期光学变异分析
谱能量分布分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对该源被判定为中等质量黑洞而非其他瞬变或活动源的证据链，以及三种气体成分、捕获半径和“引力尾迹供给”解释之间是否有稳健的运动学对应关系。

papers.title: Baryogenesis and CMB spectral distortion from Axions
papers.abstract: We discuss a mechanism for generating the baryon asymmetry in the early universe. We show that an axion-like particle can modify the related gauge field configurations in the Standard Model, thereby altering their dispersion relations. This change in the Chern-Simons number can source a violation of baryon number. We derive the relationship between the resulting baryon number and the evolution of the axion background. We estimate the baryon asymmetry produced via this mechanism and show that the observed value can be naturally achieved. We also show that axion photon coupling produces Cosmic Microwave Background spectral distortion. Our results show that the resulting distortion approaches a constant at low frequencies, unlike the conventional y-type and $μ$-type distortions.

analysis.title_zh: 来自轴子的重子生成与 CMB 谱畸变
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论一种由轴子样粒子驱动早期宇宙重子不对称的机制：轴子背景改变标准模型相关规范场构型及其色散关系，从而通过 Chern-Simons 数变化产生重子数破坏。摘要还报告轴子-光子耦合会导致 CMB 谱畸变，其低频行为趋于常数，不同于传统 y 型和 μ 型畸变。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文把粒子宇宙学中的重子生成机制与 CMB 谱畸变观测直接相连；若低频常数型谱畸变预测成立，它可能为区分轴子相关早期宇宙过程与常规能量注入模型提供新的 CMB 诊断量。
key_points: 提出轴子样粒子通过改变标准模型相关规范场构型和色散关系来产生重子数破坏。
摘要称该机制可自然达到观测到的重子不对称。
轴子-光子耦合会产生一种低频趋于常数的 CMB 谱畸变，区别于常规 y 型和 μ 型畸变。
methods: 推导生成的重子数与轴子背景演化之间的关系
估计该机制产生的重子不对称
分析轴子-光子耦合导致的 CMB 谱畸变
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对轴子背景演化、规范场 Chern-Simons 数变化与重子数产生之间的推导假设，以及所预测低频常数型谱畸变是否满足现有 FIRAS 和未来谱畸变实验约束。

papers.title: Electromagnetic responses driven by gravitational-wave memory in magnetar-flare outflows
papers.abstract: An asymmetric relativistic outflow from a magnetar giant flare produces a step-like gravitational-wave (GW) memory. In the magnetized pair plasma surrounding the star, such GW memory drives transverse electromagnetic (EM) X-mode/fast-magnetosonic responses at the corresponding frequencies. We use this GW-memory spectrum to drive a global wave equation for a cold electron--positron pair plasma. With radiative boundary conditions excluding incoming waves, the driven response forms an outgoing EM mode that reaches the outer boundary of the source region. For central-engine energy-release timescales of $10$, $1$, and $0.15\,μ\mathrm{s}$, 90\% of the integrated response energy lies below 23.3 kHz, 233 kHz, and 1.51 MHz, respectively. The principal response occupies the 10 kHz--1 MHz frequency band; a substantial extension into the 1--3 MHz frequency band also appears when a submicrosecond asymmetric-energy component is present. The electromagnetic response can escape from the source region and potentially propagate in the interstellar medium.

analysis.title_zh: 磁星耀斑外流中由引力波记忆驱动的电磁响应
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究磁星巨耀斑的非对称相对论外流产生的引力波记忆如何在周围磁化正负电子等离子体中驱动电磁 X 模/快磁声响应。作者用引力波记忆频谱驱动冷对等离子体全局波动方程，摘要报告主要响应位于 10 kHz 到 1 MHz，且在含亚微秒非对称能量成分时可扩展到 1 到 3 MHz，并可能逃离源区。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作不直接服务于 CMB 功率谱或参数估计，但与引力波记忆、多信使瞬变和低频电磁传播有关。对 CMB 研究者而言，其关联主要在于理解非标准瞬变前景、早期宇宙引力波记忆概念的近源类比，以及电磁-引力耦合在等离子体中的可观测后果。
key_points: 非对称磁星巨耀斑相对论外流可产生阶跃状引力波记忆。
摘要研究这种记忆在磁化正负电子等离子体中驱动的横向电磁响应。
主要响应频段为 10 kHz 到 1 MHz，并可能在亚微秒非对称能量成分存在时延伸到 1 到 3 MHz。
methods: 引力波记忆频谱作为驱动项
冷电子-正电子对等离子体的全局波动方程
辐射边界条件以排除入射波
磁化对等离子体中的 X 模/快磁声响应建模

papers.title: The generalized second law as a thermodynamic selection criterion for dynamical dark energy
papers.abstract: The growing number of generalized horizon entropy proposals has led to a wide variety of modified cosmological models, yet there is currently no general physical principle capable of discriminating among them. We show that the generalized second law (GSL) of thermodynamics provides such a criterion. Considering a general modified Friedmann framework described by an arbitrary function $f(H)$ of the Hubble parameter, and allowing the apparent horizon and the cosmic fluid to evolve out of thermal equilibrium, we derive model-independent constraints on the asymptotic scaling of the horizon entropy, $S_A\propto A^k$. We find that phantom evolution requires $k\ge(3ω-1)/(2ω)$, with $ω$ the total fluid equation of state, whereas quintessence imposes the complementary upper bound. Additionally, in the exact thermal equilibrium limit, the dynamical coupling strictly enforces $k \le 2$, recovering the non-equilibrium quintessence bound. The two bounds converge to the unique value $k=2$ as the phantom divide is approached, indicating that a smooth crossing of the phantom divide is thermodynamically associated with a quadratic entropy-area scaling, where the effective theory degenerates into a logarithmic gravity framework. Applying this criterion to representative generalized entropy models shows that many commonly used proposals are constrained by the generalized second law, whereas multiparameter constructions are naturally compatible with the required asymptotic behavior. Finally, we demonstrate that the same thermodynamic selection principle extends to derivative-dependent cosmologies described by $f(H,\dot H)$, highlighting its robustness beyond entropy functionals that depend only on the horizon area.

analysis.title_zh: 作为动力学暗能量热力学选择判据的广义第二定律
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论能否用广义热力学第二定律作为动力学暗能量和广义视界熵模型的选择原则。摘要称，作者在一般 f(H) 修正 Friedmann 框架及非平衡演化中推导出 S_A∝A^k 的渐近约束，得到 phantom 与 quintessence 对 k 的互补限制，并指出在 phantom divide 附近约束收敛到 k=2，且该原则可扩展到 f(H,\dot H) 模型。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 动力学暗能量直接影响晚期宇宙膨胀史，而膨胀史会进入 CMB 角直径距离、ISW 效应以及与 BAO/SNe/弱透镜联合约束的参数推断。若 GSL 能排除部分广义熵或修正 Friedmann 模型，它可为 CMB 宇宙学中常见的暗能量参数化之外提供理论先验。
key_points: 提出用广义热力学第二定律筛选动力学暗能量与广义视界熵模型。
在一般 f(H) 修正 Friedmann 框架中，推导视界熵渐近标度 S_A∝A^k 的模型无关约束。
摘要称 phantom divide 附近两类约束收敛到 k=2，并可推广到 f(H, Hdot) 宇宙学。
methods: 广义第二定律（GSL）热力学判据
一般修正 Friedmann 框架 f(H)
非热平衡的表观视界与宇宙流体演化
视界熵渐近标度 S_A∝A^k 分析

推广到导数依赖的 f(H,\dot H) 宇宙学
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 GSL 推导中的热交换、温度和表观视界定义，phantom 与 quintessence 情形的状态方程取值范围，以及 k=2 与“对数引力框架退化”之间的逻辑是否依赖额外假设。

papers.title: Evidence for Enhancement in the Rate of Fast Radio Bursts Toward Galaxy Clusters
papers.abstract: Massive galaxy clusters can introduce gravitational lensing and populations of suppressed star formation member galaxies into the line of sight, potentially changing the distribution of observable sources toward them from that of the average sky. As a result, Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) aligned with galaxy clusters can provide a unique window into parameter spaces of the FRB population that other lines of sight do not afford. In this study, we demonstrate that the second CHIME/FRB baseband catalog contains FRBs emitted from within or behind clusters identified from the latest DECaLS data release; we isolate a sample of 26 FRBs where this is likely, including one repeating FRB and two FRBs that intersect the Coma cluster. Comparing our results against a range of simulated FRB populations, we conclude that the number of these associations represents a $3σ$ rate enhancement toward galaxy clusters, constituting $1.4\pm0.4\%$ of the FRBs detected in the second CHIME/FRB baseband catalog. We suggest that this enhancement is caused by an equal proportion of member galaxies hosting additional FRBs, and gravitational lensing magnifying background sources. We demonstrate that such contributions are sensitive to alternative progenitor channels and high redshift evolution in the FRB population, providing a future avenue for constraining these features. Considering the redshifts and masses of the associated clusters, we identify FRB 20211113A, which is aligned with the strong gravitational lens Abell 2218 as a potential lensed candidate for further consideration.
papers.comment: 31 Pages (8 Appendix) 17 Figures, submitted to ApJ

analysis.title_zh: 快速射电暴朝向星系团方向发生率增强的证据
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究快速射电暴在星系团方向是否出现发生率增强，利用第二个 CHIME/FRB baseband catalog 与最新 DECaLS 星系团数据寻找团内或团后 FRB 候选。摘要报告称得到 26 个可能关联事件，并相对模拟 FRB 种群发现 3σ 的星系团方向发生率增强，作者将其解释为团成员星系额外 FRB 与背景源引力透镜放大的共同贡献。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作不直接分析 CMB，但星系团、强/弱引力透镜和高红移瞬变源都与大尺度结构宇宙学相关。对 CMB 研究者而言，FRB-星系团关联可作为星系团质量、透镜选择效应、重子分布和结构增长的互补探针，并可能与 CMB 星系团样本或 CMB 透镜交叉研究发生联系。
key_points: 使用第二个 CHIME/FRB baseband catalog 与 DECaLS 星系团数据寻找 FRB-星系团视线重合。
摘要报告筛选出 26 个很可能位于团内或团后的 FRB，并称相对于模拟 FRB 种群有 3σ 的星系团方向发生率增强。
作者提出增强可能来自团成员星系额外贡献和背景源引力透镜放大，并标出 FRB 20211113A/Abell 2218 为候选透镜事件。

最新 DECaLS 数据发布中的星系团识别

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 FRB-星系团关联的角位置和红移判据、模拟 FRB 种群的选择函数、3σ 增强是否包含试验因子，以及成员星系贡献与透镜放大的分解是否存在模型依赖。

papers.title: Estimating the local star formation rate density from ASKAP RACS
papers.abstract: Understanding the evolution of the cosmic star formation rate density (SFRD) is key to uncovering how the Universe arrived at its present state. This paper presents a novel and efficient method to estimate the local SFRD, which uses supervised machine learning to first identify a population of star-forming galaxies (SFGs). Next, star-formation rates (SFRs) are determined using the 1.4-GHz radio-continuum emission detected by the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP). Specifically, a gradient-boosted decision tree model was implemented to classify extragalactic sources from the Beck et al. (2022, MNRAS, 515, 4711) catalogue as either galaxies or quasars using RACS-mid and WISE photometry. The full sample, consisting of 389,392 sources, was partitioned into a 70%-15%-15% split for training, validating, and testing. The optimised model achieved a weighted F1 score of 0.93 and an accuracy of 0.94 on the test dataset, ultimately classifying 336,674 sources as galaxies and 52,718 sources as quasars. Using the resulting $z<0.1$ depth-matched galaxy sample and the photometric redshift predictions from Beck et al. (2022, MNRAS, 515, 4711), a modified 1.4-GHz SFR calibration was determined, yielding a local, completeness-corrected, $z<0.1$ SFRD of $(1.4 \pm 0.5) \times 10^{-2} \; \rm M_{\odot}\, yr^{-1}\,Mpc^{-3}$ using 11,293 sources. This value is consistent with previous results. Thus, this study demonstrates the feasibility of using supervised learning to identify large populations of SFGs in order to investigate the SFRD evolution. This presents an exciting prospect for future, deeper surveys such as EMU, which will enable the cosmic SFRD to be probed out to higher redshifts.
papers.journal_ref: Publications fo the Astronomical Society of Australia 43, e094, 1-17 (2026)

analysis.title_zh: 利用 ASKAP RACS 估计局部恒星形成率密度
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文提出用监督式机器学习从 ASKAP RACS 与 WISE 光度数据中识别恒星形成星系，再用 1.4 GHz 射电连续谱估计局部恒星形成率密度。摘要报告梯度提升决策树在测试集上表现良好，并用 z<0.1 深度匹配样本得到与既有研究一致的完备性修正局部 SFRD。

papers.title: Tabular foundation models for the estimation of probabilistic quasar photometric redshifts in S-PLUS
papers.abstract: We assess whether tabular foundation models can be used as off-the-shelf probabilistic photometric-redshift estimators for quasars in the 12-band S-PLUS DR6 survey, where colour-redshift degeneracies produce multi-modal posteriors and spectroscopic training sets are shifted relative to the photometric population. TabPFN 2.5, RealTabPFN 2.5, and TabICL are benchmarked against eight task-specific baselines, including linear conditional Gaussians, FlexZBoost, mixture-density networks, normalising flows, random forests, and gradient-boosted trees, with training sets from 500 to 121,626 quasars, using both density and point-prediction metrics, together with importance-weighted scores that approximate deployment on the photometric target sample. TabPFN 2.5 is best or statistically tied for best on all metrics except the unweighted CDE loss, on which the normalising flow is statistically tied and attains the lowest mean value; its largest gains occur for small training sets and in difficult regimes (very bright and faint sources, high redshift), while retaining near-nominal calibration under covariate shift. Its main practical cost is inference: with frozen weights, large support and target catalogues require substantial GPU/accelerator memory, and full-catalogue deployment may need support-set subsampling or distillation. SHAP attributions identify WISE W1/W2 as the strongest individual predictors, with UV and optical bands offering non-negligible refinements. We conclude that TabPFN 2.5 is a strong default for probabilistic quasar photo-z estimation, particularly when training data are limited or when calibration under covariate shift is critical.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to the AAS Journals

analysis.title_zh: 用于估计 S-PLUS 中类星体概率光度红移的表格基础模型
analysis.summary_zh: 本文评估表格基础模型能否作为 S-PLUS DR6 12 波段类星体概率光度红移的即用估计器，并在存在颜色-红移简并和训练/目标样本偏移的情形下，与多类专用方法比较。摘要报告 TabPFN 2.5 在除未加权 CDE loss 外的所有指标上最佳或统计并列最佳，且在小训练集、极亮/极暗源和高红移等困难区间收益较大，同时在协变量偏移下保持接近标称的校准。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 类星体光度红移影响大尺度结构、弱透镜前景/背景选择和 CMB 交叉相关等宇宙学分析中的样本构建与系统误差控制。该工作主要是方法学贡献，若其概率校准在目标样本上可靠，可为与 CMB 透镜、ISW 或星系-类星体交叉相关相关的红移分布建模提供更稳健输入。

摘要指出全星表推断的 GPU/加速器内存成本可能较高。

papers.title: CORN -- Chronometers of Relic Nature I: The first estimate of the expansion rate of the Universe using compact relic galaxies
papers.abstract: Measuring the expansion rate of the Universe is a central challenge in cosmology. Independent and robust methods are essential to validate existing measurements and assess potential systematic effects. We employ the cosmic chronometer (CC) approach, which uses the differential age evolution of quiescent galaxies to measure the Hubble parameter H(z) without assuming an underlying cosmological model. In contrast to previous CC studies, we restrict our analysis to relics -- ultra compact massive galaxies (UCMGs) hosting the oldest stellar populations -- thereby minimising uncertainties related to star formation history and merger history. We select a sample of 189 relic galaxies in the redshift range 0.07< z <0.22 from the E-INSPIRE UCMGs catalogue. Using the D_n4000 spectral index of relic galaxies and its redshift evolution, combined with MILES stellar population synthesis models, we derive the differential age relation required to infer H(z). We account not only for metallicity effects but also for the impact of alpha-element enhancement, which has not been explicitly propagated into the systematic uncertainty budget of the D_n4000 cosmic chronometer method. We obtain an independent measurement of H(z=0.15) = 85\pm53 km/s/Mpc. The total uncertainty is dominated by statistical limitations. The systematic component is 13% (8.7% when alpha-enrichment is not propagated), among the tightest estimates in current CC studies. We find that alpha-enrichment plays a major role in the systematic error budget, particularly in the high metallicity regime, and must be properly accounted for in future analyses. We demonstrate the proof of concept that relic galaxies provide a promising pathway to reduce systematic uncertainties in the CC method. The statistical uncertainties, which dominate the error budget, can be significantly reduced by the increase of data volume expected during the next years.

analysis.title_zh: CORN——遗迹自然计时器 I：首次使用致密遗迹星系估计宇宙膨胀率
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用宇宙计时器方法，以 189 个超致密大质量遗迹星系的 D_n4000 指数随红移演化并结合 MILES 恒星族合成模型，给出不预设宇宙学模型的 H(z) 估计。摘要报告 H(z=0.15)=85±53 km/s/Mpc，统计误差占主导，并指出 alpha 元素增强是 D_n4000 计时器系统误差中的重要项。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: H(z) 的独立测量直接服务于宇宙膨胀史、暗能量约束和 H0 张力背景下的系统误差交叉检验。它与 CMB 的关系在于可作为低红移、近模型无关的距离-膨胀信息，与 CMB 推断的 ΛCDM 膨胀史进行一致性比较。
key_points: 使用致密遗迹星系作为宇宙计时器样本，目标是降低恒星形成史和并合史带来的系统误差。
样本来自 E-INSPIRE UCMGs 目录，包含 0.07<z<0.22 的 189 个遗迹星系。
摘要报告 H(z=0.15)=85±53 km/s/Mpc，误差主要受统计限制，alpha 元素增强显著影响系统误差预算。

papers.title: Scalar baryons in neutron stars
papers.abstract: Neutron stars have baryon chemical potentials that can exceed the neutron mass, providing favorable conditions to convert neutrons to new particles carrying baryon number, even if those processes are kinematically forbidden in vacuum. We study the effect of GeV-scale scalars with baryon number on neutron stars' equation of state and show that non-perturbatively large repulsive self-couplings are required to support the observed two-solar-mass neutron stars. We also study potentials with attractive self-interactions, which can trigger scalar production even for masses above the chemical potential and resemble Coleman's Q-matter.

analysis.title_zh: 中子星中的标量重子
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究中子星中高重子化学势是否会促使中子转化为携带重子数的 GeV 级标量，并分析这类新粒子对中子星状态方程的影响。摘要报告，为支持已观测到的两太阳质量中子星，需要非微扰大的排斥自耦合；若存在吸引自相互作用，即使标量质量高于化学势也可能触发产生并呈现类似 Q-matter 的行为。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 中子星约束是粒子宇宙学和致密天体物理连接的重要入口，可限制携带重子数的新轻/GeV 尺度自由度。它与 CMB 的联系较间接，主要体现在新粒子物理和重子数相关暗部门模型可能同时影响早期宇宙、暗物质候选体或宇宙学参数解释。
key_points: 研究带重子数的 GeV 标量在中子星高重子化学势环境中的产生与影响。
为支撑观测到的两太阳质量中子星，需要非微扰大的排斥自耦合。
吸引自相互作用势可在质量高于化学势时触发标量产生，并类似 Coleman 的 Q-matter。
