papers.title: Evaporation of Primordial Black Holes with Multimodal Mass and Extended Spin Distributions: Cosmological Imprints on the Effective Number of Relativistic Species
papers.abstract: Primordial black holes (PBHs) form through several distinct mechanisms, each imprinting a characteristic mass function that a single-mass treatment risks erasing. Building on the FRISBHEE code, we introduce FRISHBEE, implementing four mass functions--log-normal, power-law, critical collapse, metric preheating--in a multimodal framework, with spin modeled via Gaussian and Fishbach profiles. Crucially, each channel's weight is derived from the primordial collapse probability rather than fitted, tying the mass function to the power-spectrum amplitude--a link between inflationary model-building and CMB observables. Solving the Friedmann-Boltzmann equations for $M_{\rm PBH}^{\rm in}=10^{7}$~g in the pre-BBN window, we compute $ΔN_{\rm eff}$ for five distributions, three spin configurations, and three weightings. Extended mass functions enhance $ΔN_{\rm eff}$ over the monochromatic benchmark by factors of $\sim\!1.03$ (critical collapse) to $\sim\!1.84$ (log-normal), preserving the hierarchy $LN > MM > PL > MP > CC$ across the mass window $\{10^{5},10^{7},10^{8}\}$~g. Near-extremal spin ($a_{\star}=0.99$) and spin-2 dark radiation invert this trend: superradiant spin loss averages away faster in broad distributions than in a monochromatic population, letting the monochromatic approximation overestimate $ΔN_{\rm eff}$. Against CMB-S4 and Simons Observatory sensitivities ($σ\simeq 0.06$ and $0.05$), the monochromatic benchmark is undetectable for scalar dark radiation (sDR $=0$), while log-normal, power-law, and multimodal distributions reach $\sim\!1.6$--$1.7σ$; for spin-2 dark radiation the signal drops over an order of magnitude, with none detectable. The formation channel thus governs the magnitude and observational accessibility of the Hawking signal, establishing $ΔN_{\rm eff}$ as a discriminant between single- and multi-channel PBH formation scenarios.

analysis.title_zh: 具有多模态质量和扩展自旋分布的原初黑洞蒸发：有效相对论物种数的宇宙学印记
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究具有多模态质量函数和扩展自旋分布的原初黑洞蒸发对有效相对论自由度 ΔN_eff 的影响，并在 FRISBHEE 基础上实现 FRISHBEE，求解 Friedmann-Boltzmann 方程。摘要报告扩展质量函数相对单质量基准可增强 ΔN_eff，但在近极端自旋和 spin-2 暗辐射情况下趋势会反转，且不同形成通道影响 CMB-S4 与 Simons Observatory 的可探测性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: ΔN_eff 是 CMB 约束早期宇宙额外辐射成分的核心参数之一；这项工作强调 PBH 质量函数、自旋和形成通道会改变 Hawking 蒸发留下的 ΔN_eff 信号，因此直接影响用 CMB-S4、Simons Observatory 等实验检验 PBH 场景的解释框架。
key_points: 在 FRISBHEE 基础上引入 FRISHBEE，用多模态质量函数和扩展自旋分布描述 PBH 蒸发。
通道权重由原初坍缩概率给出，从而把质量函数与功率谱振幅及 CMB 可观测量联系起来。
摘要称扩展质量函数通常提高 ΔNeff，但近极端自旋和 spin-2 暗辐射情形下单质量近似可能高估信号。
methods: FRISHBEE 数值实现
四种 PBH 质量函数：log-normal、power-law、critical collapse、metric preheating
多模态框架
Gaussian 和 Fishbach 自旋分布
求解 Friedmann-Boltzmann 方程
计算 ΔN_eff
对比 CMB-S4 和 Simons Observatory 灵敏度
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对质量函数权重如何从原初坍缩概率导出、FRISHBEE 对 Hawking 蒸发与超辐射自旋损失的处理，以及给出的 CMB-S4/Simons Observatory 可探测性是否依赖特定暗辐射自旋和质量窗口选择。

papers.title: Heavy neutral leptons beyond the BBN bound: probing the lepton asymmetry of the Universe
papers.abstract: Hadronically decaying particles with lifetimes $τ\gtrsim0.02\,{\rm s}$ are excluded by Big Bang Nucleosynthesis almost independently of their abundance: the mesons from their decays convert protons into neutrons faster than the reverse, and helium is overproduced. For heavy neutral leptons (HNLs), this blankets the couplings the upcoming accelerator searches can reach. We propose a scenario with large lepton flavor asymmetries in which HNLs evade it. A Dirac HNL decays into $π^+$ and its antiparticle into $π^-$, so an asymmetry between the two populations injects an excess of $π^+$, which converts the neutrons back to their standard abundance, while a cancellation between the asymmetries and the HNL decays keeps the shift in $N_{\rm eff}$ small. This opens the parameter space with $m_l+m_π\lesssim m_N\lesssim1\,{\rm GeV}$ and $τ_N\lesssim1\,{\rm s}$, including a substantial region within the reach of SHiP. A discovery there, combined with the BBN and CMB observables, would fix the primordial flavor asymmetries up to one remaining direction. The relic neutrino background and a possibly first-order cosmic QCD transition, a source of gravitational waves, may probe that direction, and with it the lepton asymmetry of the Universe.

analysis.title_zh: 超越 BBN 边界的重中性轻子：探测宇宙的轻子不对称
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对寿命较长、强子衰变的重中性轻子通常受 BBN 强约束的问题，提出大轻子味不对称场景来规避该限制。摘要称 Dirac HNL 与反粒子衰变产生的 π+、π- 不对称可恢复标准中子丰度，同时通过不对称与 HNL 衰变的抵消使 N_eff 偏移较小，从而开放部分未来加速器可探测参数空间。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 虽然核心是 BBN 与重中性轻子模型，但 N_eff 和原初轻子不对称会影响 CMB 对早期辐射密度与中微子部门的约束；若加速器发现相关 HNL，CMB 与 BBN 可作为反推早期宇宙轻子味不对称的重要互补信息。
key_points: 提出大轻子味不对称场景，使强子衰变的 HNL 逃避通常的 BBN 排除。
Dirac HNL 与反粒子衰变产生 π+、π- 的不对称注入，可把中子丰度拉回标准值。
摘要称 BBN 与 CMB 可观测量结合潜在加速器发现，可限制原初味不对称到一个剩余方向。
methods: 构造具有大轻子味不对称的 HNL 场景
分析 Dirac HNL 衰变为 π+ 及其反粒子衰变为 π- 的效应
利用 BBN 与 CMB 可观测量讨论参数空间约束
关联 SHiP 可达参数空间
讨论遗迹中微子背景和可能的一阶宇宙 QCD 相变引力波探针
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对大轻子味不对称与 HNL 衰变对氦丰度和 N_eff 的抵消是否需要精细调节，以及 CMB/BBN 联合约束如何与 SHiP 可探测区域对应。

papers.title: Reconstructing Dark Matter Mass and Discriminating Standard and Non-Standard WIMP-Nucleus Interactions with Paleo-Detectors
papers.abstract: Paleo-detectors record and retain crystal damage in ancient minerals from nuclear recoils induced by dark matter scattering over geological timescales. Previous studies have shown that paleo-detectors can provide sensitivity to a variety of dark matter (DM) scenarios which is complementary to conventional direct-detection experiments. In this paper, we complete the first detailed study of how well paleo-detectors can reconstruct DM parameters or distinguish between different types of DM interactions with nuclei in the presence of a DM signal, considering both elastic and inelastic DM-nucleus scattering. For representative nuclear recoil track read-out scenarios, we demonstrate that weakly interacting massive particle (WIMP) DM masses can be reconstructed for a variety of Non-Relativistic Effective Field Theory (NREFT) interactions between WIMPs and nuclei. In particular, paleo-detectors are projected to be capable of reconstructing WIMP masses $\lesssim$ 10 GeV, a regime that is challenging for conventional direct-detection experiments; further, we find that paleo-detectors could reconstruct WIMP masses up to 1 TeV for hypothetical signals within their accessible parameter space, extending the mass range over which reconstruction is possible by up to a factor of $\sim 2$ compared with analogous studies of conventional direct-detection experiments. In addition, we demonstrate that paleo-detectors could discriminate between canonical spin-independent or spin-dependent NREFT interactions and non-canonical interactions which can depend on the relative velocity or momentum transferred between the WIMP and nucleus. Specifically, at WIMP masses $\gtrsim$ 10 GeV, we project that canonical NREFT interactions can be excluded by paleo-detectors in the cases of nearly all non-canonical interactions without measurement of nuclear recoil direction, which conventional experiments typically require.

analysis.title_zh: 利用古探测器重建暗物质质量并区分标准与非标准 WIMP-核相互作用
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究在已存在暗物质信号的情况下，古探测器能否重建 WIMP 暗物质参数并区分不同 WIMP-核相互作用，覆盖弹性和非弹性散射以及多种 NREFT 相互作用。摘要报告称，代表性核反冲轨迹读出情景下，古探测器可重建低于约 10 GeV 的 WIMP 质量，并在其可及参数空间内把质量重建范围扩展到最高 1 TeV，同时可区分典型自旋无关/自旋相关相互作用与速度或动量依赖的非典型相互作用。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于暗物质直接探测方法学，对 CMB 读者的意义在于它提供了与早期宇宙和 CMB 间接约束互补的低红移、实验室尺度暗物质信息。若古探测器能区分相互作用类型和重建质量，将有助于把 CMB 对暗物质湮灭、散射或丰度的宇宙学限制与粒子物理模型参数联系起来。
key_points: 古探测器利用古老矿物中由核反冲留下的晶格损伤轨迹。
摘要称其可在多种 NREFT 相互作用下重建 WIMP 质量，并区分标准与非标准 WIMP-核相互作用。
研究同时考虑弹性与非弹性 DM-核散射，并强调低质量 WIMP 区间对传统直接探测较困难。
methods: 古探测器核反冲轨迹读出情景
弹性与非弹性暗物质-核散射建模
非相对论有效场论（NREFT）相互作用框架
与传统直接探测实验的类比研究比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其投影灵敏度和质量重建能力对矿物年龄、轨迹读出分辨率、背景模型、局域暗物质速度分布以及 NREFT 参数先验的依赖；尤其要确认“无需反冲方向也能排除标准相互作用”的判别标准和适用质量范围。

papers.title: Lyman Break Galaxy selection and redshift measurement with supervised contrastive learning
papers.abstract: Some of the next steps for high-precision cosmology lie within the high-redshift, high-density universe. Spectroscopic survey experiments such as the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI)'s second phase DESI Run 2 will shift towards probing Lyman Break Galaxy (LBG) populations from z$\sim$2 to z$\sim$4.5. For this faint sample, spectroscopic redshift measurement and sample decontamination remains a challenge, even after target selection. We propose an approach based on supervised weighted contrastive learning, in order to both learn a redshift representation for spectra and decontaminate the sample from quasars and low redshift emission line galaxies. This strategy generalizes the contrastive learning loss approach with continuous relationship weights, such that the network simultaneously learns redshift and classification tasks. The model shows stronger outlier classification and comparable redshift identification performances when compared to the previous network used for DESI (a modified version of QuasarNET) on the same dataset. In particular, contrastive learning is well suited to the small, visually-inspected sample used for training and testing, especially given the multi-task nature of this work.

analysis.title_zh: 用监督对比学习选择 Lyman Break 星系并测量红移
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 DESI Run 2 等光谱巡天中的 z≈2 到 z≈4.5 Lyman Break Galaxy 样本，提出监督加权对比学习来同时进行红移表征学习和类星体、低红移发射线星系去污染。摘要报告称，在同一数据集上与 DESI 既有的 QuasarNET 修改版相比，该模型有更强的离群分类能力，并保持相当的红移识别表现。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 高红移 LBG 样本可用于测量早期宇宙的大尺度结构，进而约束暗能量、物质聚集和与 CMB 初始条件相连的宇宙学模型。对 CMB 研究者而言，改进红移测量和样本去污染有助于降低大尺度结构与 CMB 交叉相关、BAO/RSD 分析以及高红移结构增长研究中的系统误差。
key_points: 面向 DESI Run 2 等高红移 Lyman Break Galaxy 光谱样本。
方法是监督加权对比学习，同时学习红移表征和污染源分类。
摘要称相对 DESI 既有网络，在离群/污染分类上更强，红移识别性能相当。
methods: 监督加权对比学习
连续关系权重的 contrastive loss
光谱红移表征学习
类星体和低红移发射线星系去污染
与 DESI 使用的 QuasarNET 修改版在同一数据集上比较
小规模目视检查训练和测试样本
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对训练/测试样本的构建和目视标签可靠性、与 QuasarNET 修改版比较的公平性、低信噪比和不同红移区间的失败模式，以及样本去污染对后续聚类和宇宙学参数推断的系统误差影响。

papers.title: Flat Galactic Rotation Curves Interpreted as Evidence for the Mach's Principle
papers.abstract: We explore the possibility of a Machian interpretation for the phenomena associated with asymptotically flat rotation curves in disk galaxies, providing an alternative to both the Lambda-Cold Dark Matter ($Λ$CDM) paradigm and MOdified Newtonian Dynamics (MOND). We argue that the MOND acceleration scale $a_0$ is likely not a new fundamental constant, but rather a manifestation of the cosmological scales of the observable Universe ($a_0 \sim c^2/R_u \sim c^4/GM_u \sim c/t_u$). We rewrite the Baryonic Tully-Fisher Relation (BTFR) in a cosmological format, $\frac{M_{\rm bar}}{M_{u}} = \left( \frac{V}{c} \right)^4$, suggesting that the transition to the non-Newtonian regime occurs when local accelerations become small enough to feel the global cosmic boundary, and showing that any Machian interpretation must fulfill a relation of this form. Furthermore, this framework naturally predicts a cosmological evolution of the BTFR normalization as the mass in the observable Universe evolves. We test these predictions against recent high-redshift observations ($z \sim 2$ and $z \sim 5$), finding that the data favor a flat, baryon-only, $Λ$-dominated quasi-de Sitter universe ($Ω_m \approx 0.05$, $Ω_Λ\approx 0.95$) over standard MOND or $Λ$CDM parameters. These results suggest that flat galactic rotation curves may be interpreted as compelling evidence in favor of Mach's Principle, in at least some of its versions.

analysis.title_zh: 将银河系平坦旋转曲线解释为马赫原理的证据
analysis.summary_zh: 本文尝试把盘星系渐近平坦旋转曲线解释为马赫原理的表现，而不是 ΛCDM 暗物质或 MOND 的结果。作者将 MOND 的加速度尺度与可观测宇宙尺度联系起来，重写 BTFR，并称与 z∼2 和 z∼5 数据比较后更偏好平坦、仅重子、Λ 主导的准 de Sitter 宇宙。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文直接挑战标准 ΛCDM 中冷暗物质对星系旋转曲线的解释，并提出与宇宙学尺度相连的替代理论。对 CMB 研究者而言，关键在于其所称的低 Ω_m、仅重子宇宙是否能与 CMB 精确测得的物质密度、重子声学特征和早期宇宙扰动演化同时成立。
key_points: 把星系平坦旋转曲线解释为马赫原理的可能表现。
将 MOND 加速度尺度与可观测宇宙的尺度联系起来，并重写 BTFR。
摘要称高红移 BTFR 数据更偏好平坦、仅重子、Λ 主导的准 de Sitter 宇宙参数。
methods: 马赫式理论解释
重写重子 Tully-Fisher 关系（BTFR）为宇宙学形式
与近期高红移观测数据比较（z∼2 和 z∼5）
同 MOND 与 ΛCDM 参数进行对比
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对其高红移 BTFR 数据选择、误差处理和演化建模是否足以支持对 Ω_m≈0.05、Ω_Λ≈0.95 的偏好，以及这种“仅重子”宇宙图景如何与 CMB 对物质密度、声学峰和结构形成的约束相容。

papers.title: The Last Crossing in Excursion-Set Theory of Cosmic Reionization
papers.abstract: I introduce the last crossing of the photon-counting barrier as a statistic for analytical models of cosmic reionization. Because ionizing galaxies are biased tracers of density and their photons propagate through gas of spatially varying opacity, the galaxy-IGM connection requires statistics beyond the global ionized fraction. The excursion-set model of Furlanetto et al. (2004) identifies the ionized-bubble scale around a point with the first crossing of a photon-counting barrier. I develop the last-crossing formalism and define the last-crossing scale, $R_\ell$, as the smallest scale on which the enclosed photon budget still ionizes the enclosed gas. I derive its distribution analytically. Using the empirical-barrier framework of Kaurov (2016) applied to CROC simulations, I measure both crossings in the simulated IGM. The last-crossing formalism separates externally ionized regions, whose photon-counting condition fails below $R_\ell$, from internally ionized regions whose trajectories remain above the barrier to the resolution scale. Resolved external regions are predominantly underdense, with larger $R_\ell$ selecting lower density and later reionization. At fixed local density, first-crossing scale, and reionization redshift, these regions show deficits in ionizing-luminosity and galaxy-number density at small radius relative to matched unresolved regions, and excesses in both at intermediate radius. Their combination of low gas density and a deficit of nearby sources suggests that Ly$α$ transmission spikes may preferentially arise in these regions: low density reduces the opacity, while sources on larger scales maintain the ionized state. The last-crossing picture connects the internal source geometry of ionized regions to a testable prediction for radial galaxy distributions around transmission-selected IGM locations.

analysis.title_zh: 宇宙再电离 Excursion-Set 理论中的最后穿越
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在宇宙再电离的 excursion-set 理论中引入光子计数屏障的“最后穿越”统计量，用以刻画某点周围最小的仍能由局部光子预算电离封闭气体的尺度。作者解析推导其分布，并在 CROC 模拟的 empirical-barrier 框架中测量首次与最后穿越，发现该形式可区分外部和内部电离区域，并连接到 Lyα 透射尖峰周围的星系径向分布预言。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 再电离历史和电离泡拓扑会影响 CMB 大尺度偏振光学深度及小尺度二级各向异性，例如 kSZ 信号。该文提供一种比全局电离分数更细的统计描述，有助于把高红移星系、IGM 透射观测和 CMB 再电离约束联系起来。
key_points: 提出再电离 excursion-set 模型中的“最后穿越”统计量。
最后穿越尺度用于区分外部电离与内部电离区域。
摘要给出与 Lyα 透射尖峰和径向星系分布相关的可检验预言。
methods: excursion-set 理论
光子计数屏障的最后穿越形式化
解析推导最后穿越尺度分布
Kaurov（2016）的 empirical-barrier 框架
CROC 模拟中的 IGM 测量
按局部密度、首次穿越尺度和再电离红移进行匹配比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对最后穿越分布的解析推导假设、empirical barrier 与 CROC 模拟的对应方式，以及“外部电离区域”到 Lyα 透射尖峰观测预言之间是否存在稳健、可观测的选择函数。

papers.title: Mysterious Transients in the Palomar Observatory Sky Survey (POSS-1) as profound manifestation of the Dark Matter physics
papers.abstract: Transient star-like objects of unknown origin have been identified in the first Palomar Observatory Sky Survey (POSS-1) as part of the Vanishing and Appearing Sources during a Century of Observations (VASCO) project. The source of the transients recorded by POSS-1 remains unknown, which is the warrant to coin the observed phenomena as Mysterious Transients (MT). We advocate an idea that the dark matter (DM) in form of the axion quark nuggets (AQN) made of standard model quarks (or antiquarks) and gluons, similar to the old idea of the Witten's strangelets, could {\it simultaneously} explain {\it all } the observed MT signals (including very short time scale for flash itself, association with nuclear test timing, observed alignments of several MT events, correlation with UAP reports, etc) collected or recorded for many years. Essentially we argue that the MT is a cousin of Ball Lightning (BL) events, also observed for centuries, without commonly accepted physics explanation. The basic parameters of this model (such as the typical baryon charge of the nuggets) had been fixed long ago by explaining the observed excess of radiation at variety of scales: from galactic to the solar, to local Earth's environments. In this work we use the same framework with the same set of parameters to study the observed MT phenomena. We also suggest several tests which substantiate or refute our proposal. We also present some suggestions on type of instruments required to study this specific (and well defined) type of the UAP events representing the cousins of BL and MT events in the AQN framework.

analysis.title_zh: 帕洛马天文台巡天（POSS-1）中的神秘暂现源作为暗物质物理的深刻表现
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论 POSS-1 巡天中 VASCO 项目发现的未知短暂星状源，并主张轴子夸克团块形式的暗物质可同时解释这些“神秘暂现源”及若干相关异常现象。摘要称作者沿用此前用于解释多尺度辐射过量的同一 AQN 参数框架，并提出若干检验和仪器建议。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 若此类轴子夸克团块暗物质模型成立，将属于非标准暗物质候选，对结构形成、暗物质相互作用和宇宙学约束都有潜在影响。不过摘要中的论证主要基于异常暂现源和非常规关联，CMB 读者应把重点放在其是否满足暗物质丰度、能量注入、各向异性和早期宇宙约束。
key_points: 讨论 POSS-1 中来源未知的短暂星状暂现源。
提出轴子夸克团块暗物质可同时解释多类异常信号。
摘要涉及核试验时间关联、排列、UAP 报告等非常规关联，需特别审慎核查。
methods: 基于 VASCO/POSS-1 暂现源样本的现象解释
轴子夸克团块（AQN）暗物质模型
使用作者称此前已固定的 AQN 参数框架
提出可证伪或支持该设想的测试与仪器建议
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对 POSS-1 暂现源的观测可靠性、污染源排除、与核试验或 UAP 报告等关联的统计处理，以及 AQN 模型是否给出定量、可证伪且不与既有天文和 CMB 暗物质约束冲突的预言。

papers.title: Realization Variance of Gravitational Wave Background Anisotropies from Shot Noise for Pulsar Timing Arrays
papers.abstract: Shot-noise anisotropies in the nHz gravitational wave background (GWB) are a promising target for pulsar timing arrays (PTAs). If the nHz GWB is sourced by merging supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs), as current evidence suggests, the shot-noise signal is expected to be large, potentially of order unity at observing frequencies of $f \sim 1 \, \mathrm{yr}^{-1}$. In this regime, the signal is dominated by rare bright binaries, and Poisson fluctuations in the discrete SMBHB population produce significant spatial anisotropies. Here, we use Monte Carlo simulations to model the realization-to-realization scatter in the shot-noise, sampling from empirically calibrated models of the SMBHB source populations. We find that the probability distribution of shot-noise amplitudes is broad, spanning a factor of $\sim 50$ (95\% interval) at fixed frequency, with a long tail towards high amplitudes. The most probable and median amplitudes lie significantly below the ensemble means by factors of $\sim 2-3$, implying that the shot-noise in typical realizations is smaller than the mean. The ensemble-averaged shot-noise also differs from simple estimates based on moments of the strain, $\langle h^4 \rangle/\langle h^2 \rangle^2$, because the average of a ratio is not equal to the ratio of the averages (i.e., $\langle X/Y \rangle \ne \langle X \rangle/\langle Y \rangle$). This difference is a factor of $\sim 3$ at $f = 0.1 \, \rm{yr}^{-1}$, growing to larger than two orders of magnitude by $f \sim 1 \, \rm{yr}^{-1}$, where the GWB is dominated by low abundance, high-strain sources. Shot-noise nevertheless provides a powerful diagnostic for understanding the GWB and SMBHB populations; interpreting PTA measurements, however, requires modeling its full probability distribution.

analysis.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列中由 Shot Noise 导致的引力波背景各向异性的实现方差
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究脉冲星计时阵列中 nHz 引力波背景各向异性的 shot-noise 实现方差，使用基于经验校准 SMBHB 源族模型的蒙特卡罗模拟。摘要报告称，在固定频率下 shot-noise 振幅分布很宽并带有高振幅长尾，典型实现的振幅低于系综均值，且简单应变矩比值估计会与系综平均 shot-noise 明显不同。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不直接处理 CMB，但与随机背景各向异性分析有方法论联系：PTA 的 nHz 引力波背景各向异性同样需要区分系综平均、单一宇宙实现和离散源噪声。对 CMB 读者而言，它提醒在解释随机背景角功率或各向异性时，非高斯离散源和 realization variance 可能主导观测量。
key_points: nHz 引力波背景若由并合超大质量黑洞双星主导，离散源泊松涨落可产生显著各向异性。
蒙特卡罗结果显示 shot-noise 振幅分布很宽且有高振幅长尾，典型实现低于系综均值。
摘要强调 PTA 观测解释需要建模完整概率分布，而非只用简单矩估计。
methods: 蒙特卡罗模拟
经验校准的超大质量黑洞双星源族模型
shot-noise 振幅概率分布建模
与基于应变矩的估计进行比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 SMBHB 源族模型的经验校准假设、频率依赖如何进入蒙特卡罗抽样，以及 shot-noise 概率分布对 PTA 实际角分辨率和噪声建模的敏感性。

papers.title: IPA: Morphology and Kinematics of Molecular Hydrogen Winds in Five Young Protostars across the Mass Spectrum Observed with JWST
papers.abstract: Molecular winds may play a key role in governing angular momentum transport and accretion during the early evolution of protostars. We present the morphology and kinematic properties of the H$_2$ emission in five young, envelope-dominated, protostars across a broad bolometric luminosity range, from 0.2 to $10^4~L_{\odot}$, observed with the NIRSpec/IFU and MIRI/MRS onboard JWST as part of the Investigating Protostellar Accretion (IPA) program. A rich set of pure rotational lines of H$_2$, up to $v=0-0$ S(18), and a few ro-vibrational lines are detected in the winds, revealing bipolar structures. The H$_2$ lines show a stratified/onion-like structure morphologically and kinematically, where the lines with higher $E_{\rm up}$ show a higher degree of collimation and higher velocities. Additionally, the wind velocity scales with the $L_{\rm bol}$ of the host protostellar system. In 4 out of 5 protostars, H$_2$ emission fills the outflow cavity without showing pronounced limb brightening. We also report a tentative detection of H$_2$ wind rotation in IRAS 16253, which suggests a launch radius of $\sim4$ au and the magnetic lever arm parameter of $\sim5-10$. Taken together, these properties of the H$_2$ winds can be explained by the magnetohydrodynamic disk wind models. We detect a collimated, high-velocity H$_2$ jet toward HOPS 370, which is more evolved than the extremely young source HH 211, but is accreting at a high accretion rate. This suggests that the presence of collimated molecular jets in protostars is more closely connected to accretion rate than system age.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in ApJ. 27 main text pages, 16 figures

analysis.title_zh: IPA：JWST 观测五个跨质量谱年轻原恒星中分子氢风的形态与运动学
analysis.summary_zh: 该文利用 JWST NIRSpec/IFU 和 MIRI/MRS 研究五个不同光度年轻包层主导原恒星中的 H₂ 分子风形态与运动学。摘要报告这些风呈双极、分层“洋葱状”结构，高激发线更准直且速度更高，风速随宿主原恒星 bolometric luminosity 增大，并可用磁流体力学盘风模型解释。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要属于恒星形成研究，与 CMB 本身关系较远；但它涉及角动量输运、吸积和反馈过程，这些小尺度重子物理最终影响星系形成与再电离源族建模，是宇宙学前景污染和星系演化背景理解的间接组成部分。
key_points: JWST NIRSpec/IFU 与 MIRI/MRS 观测到五个年轻原恒星中的 H₂ 双极分子风。
高激发能 H₂ 线更准直、速度更高，呈形态和运动学分层结构。
摘要认为这些性质可由磁流体力学盘风模型解释。
methods: JWST NIRSpec/IFU 观测
JWST MIRI/MRS 观测
H₂ 纯转动线与少量转动-振动线分析
形态学与运动学比较
与磁流体力学盘风模型解释相联系
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 H₂ 速度、准直度与原恒星 bolometric luminosity 的标定方式，以及 IRAS 16253 风旋转和 HOPS 370 高速 H₂ 喷流的证据是否稳健。

papers.title: The Fate of Large Scale White Noise in Second-Order Cosmological Perturbation Theory
papers.abstract: Working to second order in cosmological perturbation theory, we reconsider the Large Scale White Noise (LSWN) effect proposed in [2511.13866] and [2511.15803]. We demonstrate that the kurvature density variable $Δρ$ does indeed develop LSWN at second order. However, contrary to the claims of [2511.15803], we show that this is not inherited as an infrared (IR) pole in the second-order comoving curvature perturbation $R_2$. This apparent enhancement was an artifact of using a linear Poisson equation to relate two genuinely second order quantities. Further, we show that $R_2$ is protected from developing any such IR enhancement: $\lim_{k \rightarrow 0} \left( k^2 R_2 \right) = 0$, which follows from a conservation law in the soft limit. The constraint proposed in [2511.15803] and its implications for the small-scale primordial power spectrum are therefore invalid.

analysis.title_zh: 二阶宇宙学扰动理论中大尺度白噪声的命运
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在二阶宇宙学扰动理论中重新考察大尺度白噪声效应，区分曲率密度变量 Δρ 与二阶共动曲率扰动 R₂ 的行为。摘要报告称 Δρ 确会在二阶产生 LSWN，但 R₂ 不出现相应红外极点，先前关于小尺度原初功率谱的约束因此被认为无效。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 和早期宇宙扰动理论直接相关，因为 CMB 对原初曲率扰动及其尺度依赖极其敏感。若二阶效应是否产生红外增强的判断改变，会影响从 CMB 和大尺度结构推断小尺度原初功率谱约束的理论基础。
key_points: 二阶扰动中的曲率密度变量 Δρ 会产生大尺度白噪声。
摘要称二阶共动曲率扰动 R₂ 不继承相应红外极点。
作者认为先前基于线性泊松方程连接二阶量的约束及其小尺度原初功率谱含义无效。
methods: 二阶宇宙学扰动理论
软极限分析
守恒律论证
对先前文献中线性泊松方程使用的检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对 Δρ 与 R₂ 的规范定义、二阶约束方程的推导，以及软极限守恒律是否足以排除所有相关的红外增强。

papers.title: The Galactic Neutrino Sky: Predictions from Gamma-ray Source Populations
papers.abstract: High-energy neutrino emission from the Galactic plane has been detected at a significance of $5.7σ$, with a prominent excess toward the inner Galaxy. We show that this excess can be naturally explained by the spatial distribution of Galactic neutrino sources. By combining $γ$-ray source catalogs spanning GeV-PeV energies and selecting candidate hadronic emitters, we construct ReGal-$γ$, a template of resolved Galactic $γ$-ray sources that may also produce high-energy neutrinos. Compared with models of Galactic diffuse emission, ReGal-$γ$ predicts a neutrino intensity that is more strongly concentrated toward the inner Galaxy. Combined with models of diffuse cosmic-ray emission and unresolved $γ$-ray sources, the template reproduces both the spectral energy distribution and the Galactic longitudinal count profile reported by IceCube without requiring additional renormalization of the emission models. We test this result using an independent $γ$-ray source template constructed from different catalogs and find that our conclusion is robust against uncertainties in source modeling. Future measurements of the energy-dependent longitudinal and latitudinal neutrino distributions will provide tighter constraints on these models and help determine the spatial distribution of Galactic neutrino sources.
papers.comment: 7+4 pages, 4+3 figures. To be submitted to ApJL, comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: 银河中微子天空：来自伽马射线源族群的预言
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究 IceCube 探测到的银河平面高能中微子发射，特别是内银河方向的超额，是否可由银河中微子源的空间分布解释。作者基于 GeV-PeV 伽马射线源表选择候选强子发射体并构建 ReGal-γ 模板，摘要称其与弥散宇宙线发射和未分辨伽马源模型结合后，可复现 IceCube 报告的能谱能量分布和银河经度计数轮廓。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这不是 CMB 论文，主要属于高能天体物理和多信使研究；对 CMB 宇宙学的直接影响较弱。不过，银河前景建模、源族群模板和多波段天图方法与 CMB 前景分析在方法论上有相通之处，尤其是理解银河平面源分布和弥散辐射建模时可作为背景参考。
key_points: 论文解释 IceCube 报告的银河平面高能中微子发射及内银河超额。
作者用 GeV-PeV 伽马射线源表构建候选强子源模板 ReGal-γ。
该模板结合弥散宇宙线发射和未分辨伽马源模型，可复现摘要所述 IceCube 能谱和银河经度计数轮廓。
methods: GeV-PeV 伽马射线源表
候选强子发射体选择
ReGal-γ resolved Galactic γ-ray source template
Galactic diffuse emission models
diffuse cosmic-ray emission models
unresolved γ-ray source models
IceCube reported spectral energy distribution and Galactic longitudinal count profile
独立 γ-ray source template 交叉检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对候选强子伽马源的筛选标准、源表完备性和选择函数如何影响内银河集中度，并检查所谓无需额外重归一化与 IceCube 数据匹配的统计检验方式。

papers.title: NASA ASTRA Initiative White Paper: Space-Based Mission for Ultrahigh Energy Particles
papers.abstract: Ultra-high-energy cosmic rays ($E_{\rm CR} \gtrsim 1$ EeV) are the highest-energy particles known, signaling extreme particle processes at work in the universe. However, many aspects of their nature remain largely unknown, even after more than a century of study. Very-high-energy ($E_ν\gtrsim 1$ PeV neutrinos associated with cosmic-ray interactions, both during the acceleration process and propagation, would provide new insight into these extreme particles, as we have seen at lower energies with the dawn of TeV neutrino astronomy. Nevertheless, only a handful of such neutrinos have been observed thus far. A space-based observatory dedicated to studying cosmic rays, neutrinos, and photons would provide an unprecedented platform for observations of these extreme-energy messengers.
papers.comment: Science Community (Physics of the Cosmos Program Analysis Group: PhysPAG; Cosmic Ray and Neutrino Science Interest Group: CRN SIG) NASA ASTRA Initiative White Paper submitted to the Community Science (Ad ASTRA) Workshop

analysis.title_zh: NASA ASTRA 倡议白皮书：用于超高能粒子的空间基任务
analysis.summary_zh: 这是一篇 NASA ASTRA 倡议白皮书，概述超高能宇宙线及其相互作用产生的 PeV 以上中微子仍有许多未解问题。摘要提出，专门的空间基观测台可为宇宙线、中微子和光子的极端能量多信使观测提供新平台。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文主要属于高能天体物理和仪器任务规划，与 CMB 的联系不是直接的初始宇宙各向异性测量，而在于共同依赖大尺度宇宙背景、粒子传播和多信使宇宙学框架。对 CMB 研究者而言，相关性主要体现在极高能粒子与宇宙背景辐射场相互作用、传播衰减以及未来空间任务设计经验上。
key_points: 讨论超高能宇宙线及其相关 PeV 以上中微子观测的科学动机。
主张建设空间基观测台，同时研究宇宙线、中微子和光子等极端能量信使。
摘要未给出具体任务设计参数、灵敏度预期或新的物理约束。
methods: 空间基观测台设想
宇宙线、中微子和光子的多信使观测
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对该白皮书提出的任务概念是否包含明确的探测技术、能区覆盖、曝光量和相对现有/规划实验的增益；还要区分科学愿景与可检验的性能预测。

papers.title: Thermal Origin of Black Hole Quasinormal Modes
papers.abstract: When a black hole rings after a merger, it emits gravitational waves at characteristic frequencies known as quasinormal modes (QNMs). In the eikonal limit, these modes are governed by the unstable circular light orbits that form the photon ring. In this work, we demonstrate that the ringing of a black hole has a precise thermal interpretation. A probe string propagating in the near-ring geometry acquires an induced Rindler horizon on its worldsheet, with a temperature set by the Lyapunov exponent of the photon ring. Out of this structure, the black hole QNMs emerge as thermal excitations, so that the characteristic ringing of a black hole is the retarded response of a thermal system living on the photon ring. We explicitly derive the QNM spectrum from two complementary perspectives: microscopically, via unstable transverse worldsheet fluctuations, and macroscopically, through the pole structure of the causal response function of an open thermal quantum system.

analysis.title_zh: 黑洞准正常模的热起源
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出黑洞准正常模的热起源解释：在 eikonal 极限中，近光子环传播的探针弦世界面出现由光子环 Lyapunov 指数设定温度的 Rindler 视界。摘要称作者从微观的世界面横向不稳定涨落和宏观的开放热量子系统因果响应函数极点两方面导出了 QNM 谱。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文主要面向引力波和黑洞理论，对 CMB 宇宙学的直接关联较弱。不过，黑洞环降信号是引力波天文学中的基本模板问题，而引力波背景和强引力检验与宇宙学多信使研究存在交叉。
key_points: 黑洞并合后的准正常模在 eikonal 极限与光子环的不稳定圆形光轨相关。
作者提出探针弦在近环几何中的世界面 Rindler 视界给出热解释。
摘要称 QNM 谱可由世界面涨落和开放热量子系统响应函数极点两种角度导出。
methods: eikonal 极限分析
近光子环几何中的探针弦
世界面 Rindler 视界与温度
不稳定横向世界面涨落
开放热量子系统的因果响应函数极点分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对探针弦构造与真实黑洞引力扰动 QNM 谱之间的对应范围，尤其是 eikonal 极限、背景黑洞类型和热响应解释的适用条件。

papers.title: Adiabatic Perturbations in GW170817-Compatible Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Inflation
papers.abstract: We study the adiabaticity of the cosmological perturbations in the context of inflationary Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet theories. We focus on viable inflationary Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet theories which are compatible with the current Cosmic Microwave Background radiation experiments and also are compatible with the GW170817 observations. We derive the effects of the adiabaticity requirement on the Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet physical parameters and we show that the sound speed of the scalar perturbations and the propagation speed of the tensor perturbations are constrained. We consider two classes of inflationary viable and GW170817-compatible theories, and in the first class the adiabaticity is not violated during inflation, while in the second class the adiabaticity is violated only at the end of inflation. We discuss the effects of the adiabaticity violation in the second class of models. From our analysis, it seems that only one class of viable EGB inflationary theories, which is also compatible with the GW170817 event, is free from adiabaticity pathologies.

analysis.title_zh: 与 GW170817 相容的 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 暴胀中的绝热扰动
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文在 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 暴胀框架中研究宇宙学扰动的绝热性要求，并限定模型需与当前 CMB 实验和 GW170817 观测相容。摘要称绝热性条件会约束标量扰动声速和张量扰动传播速度；在两类可行模型中，一类暴胀期间不破坏绝热性，另一类只在暴胀末期破坏绝热性，因此似乎只有前一类没有绝热性病态。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作关系到暴胀模型能否同时满足 CMB 标量/张量扰动约束和引力波事件对张量传播速度的限制。对 CMB 研究者而言，绝热性、声速和张量传播速度会影响原初扰动谱的理论一致性，是评估非标准暴胀模型是否可用于解释 CMB 数据的关键。
key_points: 论文研究 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 暴胀中宇宙学扰动的绝热性条件。
模型要求同时与当前 CMB 实验和 GW170817 观测相容。
摘要称两类模型中仅一类在暴胀期间无绝热性病态，另一类在暴胀末期出现绝热性破坏。
methods: Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 暴胀理论分析
宇宙学扰动绝热性条件推导
标量扰动声速约束
张量扰动传播速度约束
两类与 CMB 和 GW170817 相容的模型比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“与 CMB 实验相容”和“与 GW170817 相容”的具体条件如何施加，特别是张量传播速度约束、标量声速稳定性以及暴胀末期绝热性破坏是否会影响可观测谱。

papers.title: Not R Kurvature: Beating Large-Scale White Noise
papers.abstract: Kurvature, a recently identified curvature invariant, has been argued to acquire superhorizon, or large-scale, white noise from hard-hard momentum coupling even when matter nonlinearities are small. If kurvature were related directly to cosmological curvature perturbations R through a Poisson equation, this white noise would cause an infrared-divergent variance sensitive to ultraviolet hard-mode physics. However, this relation does not generically hold. Kurvature is not intrinsic 3-curvature: on comoving slices it contains extrinsic-curvature terms, and intrinsic curvature is not related to R by a Poisson equation beyond linear order. We test this inference with second-order perturbation theory in radiation domination, relevant to CMB observables. Quadratic hard-hard composites do generate large-scale white noise in the kurvature density, but the Hamiltonian constraint separates it into intrinsic curvature and extrinsic shear, or equivalently density and expansion. Only the extrinsic terms carry the growing dimensionless kurvature density that mimics an ordinary density fluctuation above the horizon. The direct hard-hard curvature power is ultraviolet convergent, dominated by horizon-scale modes at evaluation, and leaves no IR relic in R from purely ultraviolet modes. By contrast, the Poisson construction of a curvature potential from kurvature is infrared divergent and cutoff sensitive; its white noise arises from extrinsic curvature associated with nonlinear acoustic beat modes in a radiation fluid.

analysis.title_zh: 不是 R 曲率：克服大尺度白噪声
analysis.summary_zh: 本文质疑将最近提出的 kurvature 不变量通过 Poisson 方程直接等同于宇宙学曲率扰动 R 的推断，并在与 CMB 可观测量相关的辐射主导时期用二阶扰动理论进行检验。摘要报告称 hard-hard 二次复合量确实会在 kurvature 密度中产生大尺度白噪声，但 Hamiltonian 约束显示增长的无量纲 kurvature 密度由外禀项携带，直接的 hard-hard 曲率功率紫外收敛且不会从纯紫外模在 R 中留下红外遗迹。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 初始条件和大尺度各向异性建模依赖对曲率扰动 R 的正确非线性解释；若错误地把某个曲率不变量的白噪声投射到 R，可能会高估紫外小尺度物理对大尺度 CMB 模式的影响。该文针对辐射主导时期的二阶效应澄清内禀曲率、外禀曲率和声学拍频的角色，对理解 CMB 相关非线性扰动理论有参考价值。
key_points: 讨论所谓 kurvature 大尺度白噪声是否会转化为曲率扰动 R 的红外发散。
在辐射主导时期用二阶扰动理论检验，强调其与 CMB 可观测量的相关性。
摘要称白噪声主要来自外禀曲率/非线性声学拍频，而非纯紫外模在 R 中留下红外遗迹。
methods: 辐射主导时期的二阶扰动理论
hard-hard 动量耦合产生的二次复合量分析
Hamiltonian 约束分解
共动切片上的内禀曲率与外禀曲率项区分
Poisson 构造的曲率势与 cutoff 敏感性比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 kurvature 的定义、它与常用共动曲率扰动 R 及三维内禀曲率的关系，以及二阶辐射流体计算中 Hamiltonian 约束如何把白噪声分配到内禀曲率、外禀剪切、密度和膨胀项。

papers.title: Cross-frequency SGWB anisotropy from compact topology: CMB B-mode covariance as a transfer probe
papers.abstract: Compact spatial topology restricts the eigenmodes of primordial tensor perturbations, and the resulting discreteness can render the primordial stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) anisotropic. Here we treat the CMB tensor $B$-mode covariance as a transfer-filtered measurement of that ultra-low-frequency anisotropy. Writing the normalized angular tensor-power measure as $F(k,\hat k)=1+Q(k,\hat k)$ and its nonmonopole moments as $q_{LM}(k)$, we obtain an explicit kernel that maps $q_{LM}(k)$ onto the off-diagonal covariance $δC^{BB}_{\ell m,\ell' m'}$. The kernel factorizes into tensor transfer functions and a spin-weighted Gaunt coefficient and obeys the parity rule $L+\ell+\ell'$ even for $BB$ and odd for $TB/EB$. It is an exact source--response representation of the full compact covariance rather than an additional observable. For a cubic three-torus the geometry pins down a common cubic angular subspace and orientation across frequency bands, although the amplitudes of the allowed multipoles still depend on the radial shell and source spectrum. The same topology-restricted template can therefore be read out either through the CMB $B$-mode kernel or through the anisotropy response of PTA/LISA/Taiji/TianQin searches. Using CAMB transfer functions and an invariant anisotropic-template statistic, we contrast this tensor channel with the scalar $T/E$ covariance. Independent direct angular-shell sums and $q_{LM}$--Gaunt contractions agree at $L_q^{\max}=2\ell_{\max}$ to relative Frobenius residuals of $1.4\times10^{-14}$--$3.0\times10^{-14}$. The scalar sector holds most of the practical CMB topology information; a fixed-template scan places the combined full-sky $S/N=1$ transition between $L/χ_*=2.34$ and $2.36$, while the $B$-mode channel remains subthreshold but isolates the primordial SGWB contribution.

analysis.title_zh: 紧致拓扑导致的跨频率随机引力波背景各向异性：作为转移探针的 CMB B 模协方差
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究紧致空间拓扑如何通过离散本征模使原初随机引力波背景产生各向异性，并把 CMB 张量 B 模协方差表述为这种超低频各向异性的转移滤波测量。摘要报告了一个从 q_LM(k) 到 B 模非对角协方差的显式核，并在立方三环面例子中比较张量 B 模与标量 T/E 拓扑信息，认为实用 CMB 拓扑信息主要在标量扇区，B 模通道未达阈值但更直接隔离原初 SGWB。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接连接 CMB B 模协方差、原初张量扰动和宇宙空间拓扑，是 CMB 非对角协方差与低频随机引力波背景联合解释的理论框架。对研究 CMB 拓扑约束、B 模系统学之外的张量信号来源，以及 PTA/LISA/Taiji/TianQin 与 CMB 的互补性都有潜在意义。
key_points: 紧致空间拓扑会限制原初张量扰动本征模，并可导致超低频随机引力波背景各向异性。
论文给出从张量功率各向异性矩 q_LM(k) 到 CMB B 模非对角协方差的显式核。
摘要称标量 T/E 扇区包含多数实用拓扑信息，B 模通道未达阈值但可隔离原初 SGWB 贡献。
methods: CMB 张量 B 模协方差的转移滤波表述
q_LM(k) 非单极矩到 δC^{BB}_{ℓm,ℓ'm'} 的核映射
张量转移函数与自旋加权 Gaunt 系数分解
CAMB 转移函数
不变各向异性模板统计量
三维立方环面模型
直接角壳求和与 q_LM-Gaunt 收缩对照
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对核函数推导中的归一化、宇称选择规则和 L_q^{max}=2ℓ_max 截断是否足以支持数值一致性；还要区分“B 模隔离 SGWB 贡献”与“实际探测灵敏度不足”之间的界限。

papers.title: Ubiquitous Interstellar Neutral Helium Detected with JWST
papers.abstract: We report the discovery of ubiquitous neutral helium emission in sky spectra taken with JWST's NIRSpec instrument. The emission, with a wavelength of 1.0833 micron, resembles one of the "sky lines" that are seen by ground-based observatories. We examine this emission in all suitable NIRSpec spectra in the public archive, totaling 22 days of exposure time. We find that this He I emission is almost always present: it is well-detected in 80 percent of the observations, and in 53 percent of the individual exposures. The emission is highly time-variable: at a given pointing, the line intensity can vary by factors of several over the course of a day. The He I emission is strongest when JWST crosses through the cone of interstellar neutral helium that is gravitationally focused by the sun; intensity during the cone crossing is anti-correlated with solar activity. The low redshift and narrow velocity width of the He I line, and the elevated intensity when JWST crosses through the focusing cone, together indicate that origin of the He I emission is cold Milky Way gas passing through our solar system. JWST provides a new way to study this interstellar gas, revealing new insights such as extreme variability on timescales of hours to days, which has not been previously reported.
papers.comment: submitted to the AAS journals; 23 pages, 17 figures, 4 tables

analysis.title_zh: JWST 探测到普遍存在的星际中性氦
analysis.summary_zh: 该文报告在 JWST NIRSpec 天光谱中发现普遍存在的 1.0833 微米中性氦发射，并检索公共档案中总计 22 天曝光的适用光谱。摘要称该线多数观测中可见、变化很快，在 JWST 穿越太阳引力聚焦的星际中性氦锥时最强，低红移和窄线宽指向太阳系内穿行的冷银河系气体起源。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项结果不直接涉及 CMB，但对使用空间望远镜近红外光谱进行星系和高红移宇宙研究有实际影响：一种随时间变化的局地天光线可能成为背景建模和弱线测量的系统误差来源，也提供了研究太阳系内星际介质流的新窗口。
key_points: 在 JWST NIRSpec 公共档案天光谱中发现普遍存在的 1.0833 微米 He I 发射。
发射在小时到天尺度上强烈变化，并在 JWST 穿越太阳引力聚焦的星际中性氦锥时最强。
摘要将其归因于穿过太阳系的冷银河系气体。
methods: JWST NIRSpec 天光谱
公共档案中所有适用 NIRSpec 光谱
总计 22 天曝光时间
He I 1.0833 微米发射线分析
与 JWST 穿越星际中性氦聚焦锥及太阳活动的相关性比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对作者如何排除仪器背景、黄道光或目标污染，以及 He I 线强度与聚焦锥位置、太阳活动反相关的统计与选择函数处理。

papers.title: Dynamical Barbero--Immirzi field coupled to quintessence: gravitational-wave propagation constraints and next-generation forecasts
papers.abstract: We investigate the imprints of a dynamical Barbero--Immirzi (BI) field $γ(x)$ coupled to a quintessence scalar field $φ$ on gravitational-wave (GW) propagation. In the framework of Einstein--Cartan--Holst gravity, promoting $γ$ to a dynamical scalar introduces a stress--energy that back-reacts on the metric, modifying the GW friction term. A minimal coupling $\proptoβ\,φ^2γ^2$ between the BI field and quintessence leads to a two-parameter extension of the Belgacem--Maggiore parametrization, characterized by $\xBI$ (from the isolated BI field) and $\xcp$ (from the coupling). This is the first study to simultaneously constrain both parameters using GW data. We derive the modified GW propagation equation in the coupled system and identify a distinctive redshift dependence: the coupling-induced term grows faster than the isolated BI term, offering a handle to break degeneracies. Using the LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA GWTC-3 dark-siren constraint $Ξ_0=1.2^{+0.7}_{-0.7}$, we obtain the first simultaneous constraints: $|\xBI|\lesssim0.7$ and $|\xcp|\lesssim0.13$ at 90\% credibility. We then forecast the sensitivity of next-generation detectors Einstein Telescope (ET) and Cosmic Explorer (CE), showing that a 10-year observation campaign can improve these bounds by two orders of magnitude, reaching $σ(\xBI)\sim3\times10^{-2}$ and $σ(\xcp)\sim1.2\times10^{-2}$. Translated into microscopic parameters, this corresponds to $γ_{\rm dyn}\lesssim10^{-12}$ and $β\lesssim10^{-3}$, providing a powerful new observational window into the interplay between quantum-gravity phenomenology and dark energy. Our results demonstrate that GW propagation offers a promising avenue to probe the dynamical BI field and its coupling to the dark sector, with implications for loop quantum gravity and modified gravity theories.
papers.comment: The manuscript contains four figures and two tables, to be submitted. All comments are welocme

analysis.title_zh: 与 Quintessence 耦合的动力学 Barbero-Immirzi 场：引力波传播约束与下一代预报
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇理论与预报论文研究动力学 Barbero-Immirzi 场 γ(x) 与 quintessence 标量场 φ 耦合后对引力波传播的印记，并在 Einstein-Cartan-Holst 引力框架下推导修正传播方程。摘要称作者首次用 GW 数据同时约束孤立 BI 场和耦合项两个参数，并用 GWTC-3 暗警报约束及 ET/CE 未来观测给出灵敏度预报。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文不直接处理 CMB 数据，但涉及暗能量、修正引力和引力波传播，这些主题与 CMB 推断的背景宇宙学和晚期宇宙检验互补。对 CMB 读者而言，关键价值在于它展示了标准 siren 或暗 siren 如何约束暗能量/量子引力现象学参数，并可与 CMB 对背景膨胀和引力理论的约束形成互补。
key_points: 论文研究动力学 Barbero-Immirzi 场与 quintessence 标量耦合对引力波传播的影响。
在 Einstein-Cartan-Holst 引力中，动力学 BI 场会通过反作用修改引力波摩擦项。
摘要给出使用 GWTC-3 暗警报约束和对 ET、CE 下一代探测器的预报。
methods: Einstein-Cartan-Holst gravity
dynamical Barbero-Immirzi field γ(x)
quintessence scalar field φ
minimal coupling ∝ β φ^2 γ^2
two-parameter extension of Belgacem-Maggiore parametrization
modified GW propagation equation
LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA GWTC-3 dark-siren constraint Ξ0=1.2^{+0.7}_{-0.7}
Einstein Telescope and Cosmic Explorer forecasts
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对从耦合 Einstein-Cartan-Holst 理论到修正引力波传播方程的推导、参数 xBI 与 xcp 的定义及先验选择，以及 GWTC-3 暗警报约束和 ET/CE 预报中是否与背景宇宙学参数或暗能量模型存在退化。

papers.title: CMB Spectral Distortion Anisotropies from Acoustic Damping with primordial non-Gaussianity
papers.abstract: In this paper, we evaluate the precise distortion source and transfer functions caused by mixing of blackbodies of different temperatures using the recently developed frequency hierarchy (FH) treatment of CosmoTherm. With this we are able to evaluate the effects of primordial non-Gaussianity (PNG) on the $μT$, $μE$, $y T$ and $y E$ cross-power spectra including the coupled spectro-spatial evolution and important photon-transport effects retained by the FH treatment. For local-type PNG, we compare our results with those from previous works, illustrating new aspects that were previously not captured. We then demonstrate how the $μT$ and $μE$ signals change in the presence of enhanced curvature perturbations at small scales. For a nearly scale-invariant primordial spectrum, our results agree broadly with previous estimates on large angular scales but exhibit additional small-scale damping and modified $y$-distortion correlations arising from the scale dependence of the heating source and the distinct transport of distortion perturbations. Tight-coupling and monopole-source approximations accurately reproduce the $μ$-distortion spectra, while the $y$-distortion signals remain more sensitive to the detailed source evolution. For enhanced small-scale power, anisotropies generated by propagation of the distorted average spectrum can become comparable to those from anisotropic dissipation. Their different angular dependences and parameter scalings principally allow the small-scale power amplitude and primordial non-Gaussianity to be constrained separately. The results presented here thus pave the path for studying PNG in new regimes using existing and upcoming high precision CMB anisotropy data to measure primordial distortion correlations.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 9 figures, to be submitted to JCAP, comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: 具有原初非高斯性的声学阻尼所致 CMB 谱畸变各向异性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究声学阻尼产生的 CMB 谱畸变各向异性在原初非高斯性存在时的相关信号，使用 CosmoTherm 新近发展的 frequency hierarchy 方法计算由不同温度黑体混合导致的畸变源项和转移函数。摘要报告了 μT、μE、yT、yE 交叉谱的变化：近尺度不变谱时大角尺度结果与既有估计大体一致，但出现额外小尺度阻尼和修正的 y 畸变相关；小尺度功率增强时，畸变平均谱传播产生的各向异性可与各向异性耗散产生的信号相当。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 谱畸变与温度、E 模偏振的交叉相关是探测极早期小尺度扰动和原初非高斯性的途径，覆盖常规 CMB 温度/偏振各向异性较难直接约束的尺度。该文直接面向未来高精度 CMB 数据中 μ、y 畸变相关的理论建模，因此与 CMB 非高斯性和小尺度功率谱约束密切相关。
key_points: 使用 CosmoTherm 的 frequency hierarchy 处理谱畸变各向异性的源项与转移函数。
计算 PNG 对 μT、μE、yT、yE 交叉功率谱的影响，并与既有局域型 PNG 结果比较。
摘要称 μ 畸变谱可由紧耦合和单极源近似较好复现，而 y 畸变更依赖详细源演化。
methods: CosmoTherm 的 frequency hierarchy（FH）处理
黑体混合导致的畸变源函数与转移函数计算
μT、μE、yT、yE 交叉功率谱
局域型原初非高斯性比较
紧耦合近似与单极源近似
增强小尺度曲率扰动情形
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 FH 处理相对以往近似到底保留了哪些光子输运效应，以及这些效应如何改变小角尺度阻尼、y 畸变相关和对 PNG/小尺度功率的参数区分能力。

papers.title: Big-Bang Nucleosynthesis and WIMP Dark Matter Freeze-Out as Probes of Yukawa Cosmology
papers.abstract: We investigate Big-Bang Nucleosynthesis (BBN) in the context of Yukawa cosmology. We first derive the modified Friedmann equations by starting from the first law of thermodynamics on the apparent horizon. Using observational data on \(^4\mathrm{He}\), deuterium, and \(^7\mathrm{Li}\) abundances, we place stringent bounds on the Yukawa coupling \(α\). The \(^4\mathrm{He}\) and deuterium constraints are mutually consistent (\(-0.24 \lesssim α\lesssim 0.12\)), while \(^7\mathrm{Li}\) requires $α\in [-0.76,\,-0.72]$. This indicate that Yukawa cosmology cannot resolve the Lithium Problem. We then extend our analysis to WIMP freeze-out, and show that the modified Hubble parameter alters the relic abundance, yielding an independent constraint \(-0.017 \lesssim α\lesssim 0.018\) from \(Ω_{\mathrm{CDM}}h^2 = 0.120 \pm 0.001\). We also derive the modified time-temperature relation, and show that the positive \(α\) raises the early Universe temperature. Our analysis demonstrates that BBN and dark matter relic abundance serve as complementary probes of modified gravity. Our studies confirm that Yukawa cosmology is a testable framework for early-Universe physics.

analysis.title_zh: 大爆炸核合成与 WIMP 暗物质冻结作为 Yukawa 宇宙学的探针
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 Yukawa 宇宙学对 BBN 和 WIMP 暗物质冻结的影响，先由表观视界热力学第一定律推导修正 Friedmann 方程，再用轻元素丰度和冷暗物质丰度约束 Yukawa 耦合 α。摘要报告 ^4He 与氘约束相容，^7Li 所需范围不同因而不能解决锂问题；WIMP 遗迹丰度给出独立且更窄的 α 约束，并指出正 α 会提高早期宇宙温度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: BBN、暗物质遗迹丰度和膨胀率都与 CMB 推断的早期宇宙参数相互校验；若修正引力改变 Hubble 参数和时间-温度关系，它会影响 CMB 分析中对辐射史、物质丰度和暗物质模型的一致性检验。
key_points: 论文用 BBN 轻元素丰度约束 Yukawa 宇宙学参数 α。
摘要报告 ^4He 与氘给出的范围相容，而 ^7Li 偏好的 α 区间不同，不能解决锂问题。
WIMP 冻结丰度给出更强的独立约束，并显示正 α 会提高早期宇宙温度。
methods: 表观视界热力学第一定律
修正 Friedmann 方程推导
BBN 轻元素丰度观测数据：^4He、氘、^7Li
WIMP 冻结分析
冷暗物质丰度 Ω_CDM h^2 = 0.120 ± 0.001
修正时间-温度关系推导
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 Yukawa 宇宙学修正 Friedmann 方程的推导假设、BBN 丰度计算与观测误差处理，以及 WIMP 约束是否依赖特定湮灭截面或暗物质模型设定。

papers.title: Observational constraints on fractional holographic dark energy in the light of DESI DR2
papers.abstract: Based on the fractional entropy from fractional quantum mechanics, fractional holographic dark energy (FHDE) has been proposed with the Hubble horizon as the IR cutoff (FHDEH). We extend this framework by adopting the future event horizon and the particle horizon as the IR cutoff, proposing the FHDEF and FHDEP models. Using the SN+OHD+DESI DR2 dataset to constrain these models, we find that all three models provide a marginally lower $χ^{2}_{min}$ compared to $Λ$CDM but without significant preference according to AIC and BIC. When CMB distance priors are included, the FHDEH and FHDEP models are strongly ruled out. We further analyze the cosmological evolution for these models, and find that only the FHDEF model predicts nearly identical evolutions of $Ω_{m}$ and $Ω_{de}$ to those of the $Λ$CDM model across cosmic history, but its deceleration parameter $q$ deviate from the $Λ$CDM model in the future, indicating richer late time dynamics beyond the standard $Λ$CDM cosmology.
papers.comment: It is to be published in Chinese Physics C

analysis.title_zh: DESI DR2 背景下对分数全息暗能量的观测约束
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究基于分数量子力学分数熵的分数全息暗能量，并将红外截断从 Hubble 视界扩展到未来事件视界和粒子视界。摘要称在 SN+OHD+DESI DR2 下三种模型相对 ΛCDM 仅有边际 χ² 改善且 AIC/BIC 不支持显著偏好，而加入 CMB 距离先验后 FHDEH 和 FHDEP 被强烈排除，FHDEF 的 Ω_m 与 Ω_de 演化最接近 ΛCDM 但未来 q 有偏离。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文属于暗能量模型检验，CMB 相关性主要来自距离先验对晚期宇宙学参数和暗能量模型的约束。对 CMB 研究者而言，关键在于这些模型是否与 CMB 压缩观测量相容，以及使用距离先验时是否能可靠代表完整 CMB 似然。
key_points: 论文把分数全息暗能量推广到未来事件视界和粒子视界作为红外截断的情形。
SN+OHD+DESI DR2 下三种模型 χ²_min 略低于 ΛCDM，但 AIC/BIC 不给出显著偏好。
加入 CMB 距离先验后，FHDEH 和 FHDEP 被摘要称为强烈排除。
methods: 分数全息暗能量模型 FHDEH、FHDEF、FHDEP
SN+OHD+DESI DR2 数据联合约束
CMB 距离先验
χ²_min、AIC、BIC 模型比较
宇宙学演化分析，包括 Ω_m、Ω_de 和减速参数 q
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 CMB 距离先验的构造和适用性，特别是其是否依赖 ΛCDM 或早期宇宙假设；同时检查 DESI DR2 与 SN/OHD 的组合是否存在数据相关性或校准假设。

papers.title: Correlated parity violation in gravity and electromagnetism from five-dimensional spacetime
papers.abstract: Parity violation in the gravitational and electromagnetic sectors has been extensively investigated, yet the two are conventionally treated as independent phenomena. This separation, however, may be a four-dimensional prejudice. In higher-dimensional spacetime, gravity and electromagnetism may share a common geometric origin---and so, perhaps, does their parity violation. In this paper, we pursue this idea by constructing parity-violating Kaluza-Klein models in both Riemannian and teleparallel geometries. In Riemannian geometry, the simplest five-dimensional parity-violating term reduces to several complicated four-dimensional terms, including the familiar gravitational Chern-Simons term, which suffers from a ghost instability. In teleparallel geometry, however, the result is strikingly simple. The simplest five-dimensional parity-violating term reduces to only two ghost-free terms---the familiar Nieh-Yan term and the standard electromagnetic Chern-Simons term. Remarkably, the model predicts that the helicity-dependent dispersion shift for electromagnetic waves is exactly six times that for gravitational waves, $Δω^{2}_{ EM}=6\,Δω^{2}_{GW}$, a background-independent relation. This relation offers a falsifiable test of unification through joint cosmic microwave background and gravitational wave birefringence observations.

analysis.title_zh: 来自五维时空的引力与电磁相关宇称破缺
analysis.summary_zh: 本文探讨引力和电磁宇称破缺是否可由五维时空中的共同几何起源相关联，分别在 Riemannian 与 teleparallel 几何中构造宇称破缺 Kaluza-Klein 模型。摘要称 Riemannian 情形会产生包含有鬼引力 Chern-Simons 项的复杂四维项，而 teleparallel 情形只约化为无鬼的 Nieh-Yan 项和标准电磁 Chern-Simons 项，并预言电磁波螺旋度依赖色散偏移为引力波的六倍。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇称破缺会导致 CMB 偏振旋转或双折射，也可能影响引力波传播；该文提出电磁与引力双折射之间的固定关联，可用 CMB 双折射和引力波双折射联合检验。对 CMB 研究者而言，它提供的是一种将 CMB 偏振异常或宇称破缺信号与引力波传播效应联系起来的理论框架。
key_points: 构造五维 Kaluza-Klein 框架中的引力与电磁宇称破缺模型。
比较 Riemannian 几何与 teleparallel 几何下的四维约化结果。
摘要给出电磁波与引力波螺旋度依赖色散偏移的固定比例关系。
methods: 五维 Kaluza-Klein 模型构造
Riemannian 几何中的宇称破缺项约化
teleparallel 几何中的宇称破缺项约化
引力 Chern-Simons 项、电磁 Chern-Simons 项与 Nieh-Yan 项分析
CMB 与引力波双折射观测检验的理论关系
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对五维宇称破缺项的选择是否唯一或最小、四维约化中无鬼结论依赖哪些假设，以及 Δω²_EM=6Δω²_GW 的背景无关性在何种场方程和规范约定下成立。

papers.title: Foreground Subtraction with a Tensor-Based Oriented Singular Value Decomposition Method for HI Experiments
papers.abstract: We introduce a native tensor-based framework for foreground mitigation in 21\,cm intensity mapping (IM), utilizing the Oriented Singular Value Decomposition (O-SVD) algorithm. While 21\,cm IM is a powerful probe of the large-scale structure of the Universe, its efficacy is severely limited by astrophysical foregrounds that are orders of magnitude brighter than the cosmological signal. Traditional mitigation strategies often necessitate flattening multidimensional data cubes into two-dimensional matrices, a process that potentially compromises the intrinsic spatial-spectral correlations by treating distinct spatial pixels as independent samples. By treating multi-frequency sky maps and angular power spectra as third-order tensors, the O-SVD method performs decomposition directly on the multilinear manifold, preserving the underlying physical topology and leveraging the distinct coherence properties of astrophysical foregrounds across different dimensions. We demonstrate the performance and versatility of the O-SVD framework through its application to high-fidelity simulations from the SKA Science Data Challenge 3a (SDC3a) and real-world observational data from the Tianlai Cylinder Pathfinder Array. Our results indicate that O-SVD provides a robust and universal approach for foreground subtraction, achieving high-fidelity signal recovery while offering superior performance compared to conventional matrix-based Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) methods.

analysis.title_zh: 用于HI实验的基于张量的定向奇异值分解前景扣除方法
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对21 cm强度映射中远强于宇宙学信号的天体物理前景，提出直接在多维数据结构上工作的张量化O-SVD前景消减方法。摘要称，该方法在SKA SDC3a模拟和天籁柱面阵观测数据上实现了高保真信号恢复，并相对传统矩阵SVD表现更好。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 21 cm强度映射是大尺度结构和宇宙学参数测量的重要探针，其系统误差核心之一就是前景去除与信号损失控制。虽然这不是传统CMB论文，但其多频天空图分解、前景相干性利用和谱-角相关保持等问题，与CMB前景分离和多频数据分析有直接方法学关联。
key_points: 提出面向21 cm强度映射的张量化前景消减框架。
将多频天空图和角功率谱作为三阶张量处理，以保留空间-频谱相关。
在SKA SDC3a模拟和天籁柱面阵实测数据上，摘要称其优于传统矩阵SVD。
methods: Oriented Singular Value Decomposition（O-SVD）
三阶张量表示多频天空图和角功率谱

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对O-SVD与矩阵SVD的比较是否使用相同的模式数选择、掩膜、噪声与信号泄漏评估，并检查“高保真信号恢复”和“通用鲁棒”的量化指标是否充分支持摘要表述。

papers.title: Multi-tracer mass bias in matched cosmic voids from SDSS DR7 and the ELUCID constrained simulation
papers.abstract: Cosmic voids provide a unique environment for studying the relationship between galaxies, subhaloes, and dark matter in the underdense Universe. Using the SDSS galaxy catalogue and the ELUCID constrained simulation, we establish an observationally anchored framework for measuring multi-tracer mass bias within matched cosmic voids. A sample of 102 matched void pairs is constructed to directly compare galaxy, subhalo, and dark matter mass distributions within an observationally constrained realisation of the local Universe. We find that both the galaxy-to-dark matter and subhalo-to-dark matter mass ratios decrease toward void centres, indicating that luminous and halo tracers become increasingly depleted relative to the underlying matter distribution in the deepest underdensities. In contrast, the galaxy-to-subhalo mass ratio exhibits substantially larger statistical uncertainties within the inner void regions ($r/R_{\rm v}\lesssim0.5$). By comparing measurements obtained using independent and common coordinate frameworks, we show that coordinate offsets contribute to the observed scatter but cannot fully account for the large uncertainties. The remaining uncertainty primarily arises from the severe scarcity of massive subhaloes ($\log_{10}(M_{\rm sub}/h^{-1}M_\odot)\ge11.8$) within void interiors, which greatly reduces the number of statistically valid measurements near void centres. Our results provide a direct measurement of multi-tracer mass bias in observationally constrained cosmic environments and highlight the fundamental statistical limitations of multi-tracer studies in extreme underdense regions.

analysis.title_zh: 来自SDSS DR7与ELUCID约束模拟的匹配宇宙空洞中的多示踪质量偏差
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用SDSS DR7星系数据和ELUCID约束模拟，在102对匹配宇宙空洞中测量星系、子晕和暗物质之间的多示踪质量偏差。摘要报告星系/暗物质和子晕/暗物质质量比向空洞中心降低，而星系/子晕质量比在内区因大质量子晕稀缺而具有较大统计不确定性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇宙空洞是检验大尺度结构形成、示踪偏差和暗物质分布的重要环境，也可与弱透镜、星系巡天和次级CMB效应等宇宙学观测形成互补。不过该摘要不涉及CMB数据或CMB分析方法，对CMB读者更像是大尺度结构系统误差与示踪偏差背景材料。

papers.title: Unveiling Metal Mixing in a Grand-Design Spiral: A UV-optical multiphase spatially resolved study of M83
papers.abstract: We present a spatially resolved, multiphase study of chemical enrichment around young star clusters (YSCs) in the nearby grand-design spiral M83 by combining far-ultraviolet(UV) absorption-line spectroscopy from HST/COS with cospatial optical spectroscopy from VLT/MUSE and LBT/MODS. Our sample includes 18 YSCs spanning spectroscopic ages of ~1-6 Myr and galactocentric radii out to R/R_{25}=0.56. Neutral (H I) abundances were derived from UV absorption-line spectroscopy and compared with ionised (H II) abundances from reddening-corrected optical emission lines. Because auroral lines are not detected in all regions, we develop and apply an empirical multi-zone electron temperature (T_e) calibration based on strong-line diagnostics to estimate T_e and derive reliable nebular abundances. We measure oxygen(O), sulphur(S), nitrogen(N), and iron(Fe) abundance tracing enrichment from distinct nucleosynthetic channels. The alpha-elements (O and S) exhibit similar behaviour, consistent with enrichment by core-collapse supernovae, whereas Fe shows weaker variations, reflecting its delayed production by Type Ia supernovae. Nitrogen displays the largest phase offset (ionised-neutral), with enhancements of up to $Delta$N/H~1.5 dex and $Delta$N/O>1.5 dex in the ionised gas relative to the neutral phase, indicating localised enrichment by massive stars and inefficient mixing between gas phases on Myr timescales. While the ionised gas exhibits signatures of feedback-regulated chemical enrichment and large-scale abundance gradients, corresponding trends are weak or absent in the neutral gas, consistent with metals remaining largely confined to the immediate star-forming environment during the earliest stages of cluster evolution in a massive grand-design spiral.
papers.comment: 21 Figures, 8 Tables in the main text and 9 Figures and 5 Tables in the appendix; 47 pages total, including the appendix and bibliography

analysis.title_zh: 揭示宏伟设计旋涡星系中的金属混合：M83 的紫外-光学多相空间分辨研究
analysis.summary_zh: 该文通过 HST/COS 远紫外吸收线与 VLT/MUSE、LBT/MODS 光学光谱，对近邻 grand-design 旋涡星系 M83 中年轻星团周围的多相化学富集进行空间分辨研究。摘要报告电离气体显示反馈调节的富集和大尺度丰度梯度，而中性气体中相应趋势较弱或缺失，尤其氮在电离相相对中性相中增强明显，说明早期星团演化阶段金属混合效率较低。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究聚焦星系化学演化，不直接分析 CMB；但金属富集、反馈和气体混合影响星形成历史、尘埃与星系光谱能量分布建模，这些都是解释 CMB 前景、星系样本选择和宇宙再电离源形成环境时需要的背景物理。

比较中性气体与电离气体中的 O、S、N、Fe 丰度。
摘要称氮在电离相相对中性相中增强最明显，指向局地富集和 Myr 时间尺度上的低效相间混合。

papers.title: Locating the missing baryons in the warm-hot intergalactic medium with fast radio bursts and the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect
papers.abstract: Traditional astronomical censuses in the late-time Universe can only account for a fraction of the baryonic matter budget. Hydrodynamical simulations predict that the missing baryons reside in the vast filamentary structures of the cosmic web as a highly diffuse, warm-hot intergalactic medium (WHIM). Observing the WHIM directly has remained a long-standing challenge due to its typical temperature. In this study, we report the first detection of spatial cross-correlations between the dispersion measures (DMs) of fast radio bursts (FRBs) from the second CHIME/FRB catalog and the thermal Sunyaev-Zel'dovich (tSZ) Compton-$y$ map from the Planck satellite. By masking virialized galaxy clusters to isolate the diffuse signal, we find a positive correlation with a probability $>99.77\%$ between FRBs and tSZ maps. Our joint parameter inference constrains the fraction of cosmic baryons in the WHIM to be $f_{\rm WHIM}=0.48$ with a $68\%$ confidence interval of $0.27<f_{\rm WHIM}<0.61$, anchored at a mean WHIM temperature of $2.4 \times 10^6\ {\rm K}$. More rigorous masking strategies confirm the signal originates from the WHIM instead of galaxy clusters. Our result demonstrates that the missing baryons are residing in the diffuse gas within the cosmic web, closing the cosmic baryon budget in the local Universe.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, submitted to AAS journals

analysis.title_zh: 利用快速射电暴和 Sunyaev-Zel'dovich 效应定位温热星系际介质中的缺失重子
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 CHIME/FRB 第二目录的快速射电暴色散量与 Planck tSZ Compton-y 图进行空间互相关，以寻找宇宙网中温热星系际介质的缺失重子。摘要报告在遮蔽维里化星系团后得到正相关检测，并通过联合参数推断约束 WHIM 中的宇宙重子比例及其平均温度锚定值。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: tSZ 是 CMB 光子经热电子散射产生的次级各向异性，因此该工作把 CMB 二级效应与 FRB 色散量结合，用来追踪低红移弥散重子。它不直接改写原初 CMB 参数推断，但对宇宙重子预算、低红移大尺度结构气体分布和 tSZ 前景/信号建模有直接相关性。
key_points: 使用 CHIME/FRB 第二目录的 FRB 色散量与 Planck tSZ Compton-y 图做空间互相关。
通过遮蔽维里化星系团来隔离弥散 WHIM 信号。
摘要报告正相关检测，并由联合参数推断给出 WHIM 中重子比例约束。

papers.title: Production of Primordial Black Holes in the Double D3-Brane - anti-D3-Brane Inflation Model
papers.abstract: A natural extension of the successful $D3$-${\bar D}3$-brane inflation model in string theory is one with two $D3$-${\bar D}3$-brane pairs, giving rise to a novel feature in string-theory. When the first pair annihilates, $D1$-strings and $F1$-strings are produced. Following the non-commutative geometric properties in string theory, it is shown by Myers that the presence of the $D3$-charge field strength of the remaining $D3$-${\bar D}3$-brane pair leads to the formation of dielectric $3$-branes -- neutral, finite-size bound states of $3$-branes with $D1$-strings. They behave as matter with little or no pressure. Spanning a wide range of masses, they seed primordial black holes in the early universe.

analysis.title_zh: 双 D3 膜-反 D3 膜暴胀模型中的原初黑洞产生
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论弦论中双 D3-反 D3 膜对暴胀模型，指出第一对膜湮灭产生的 D1/F1 弦可在剩余膜对的 D3 荷场强作用下，通过 Myers 机制形成介电 3-膜束缚态。摘要称这些近似无压的有限尺寸中性态覆盖宽质量范围，可在早期宇宙中播种原初黑洞。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初黑洞的产生机制直接关系到小尺度原初扰动、非标准暴胀动力学和暗物质候选体。对 CMB 研究而言，此类模型需要与 CMB 对大尺度暴胀谱、非高斯性、弦论遗迹以及 PBH 蒸发或吸积效应的约束保持一致，但摘要本身未给出这些约束的定量检验。
key_points: 提出双 D3-反 D3 膜对暴胀模型中产生原初黑洞的机制。
第一对膜湮灭后产生 D1 弦和 F1 弦；剩余膜对的 D3 荷场强可形成介电 3-膜束缚态。
这些有限尺寸、中性的介电 3-膜被描述为近似无压物质，可在早期宇宙播种原初黑洞。

papers.title: Sneutrino Tribrid Inflation in Flipped $\mathbf{SU(5)}$: Confronting ACT DR6 and Planck
papers.abstract: We construct a realization of sneutrino tribrid inflation within the $R$-symmetric flipped $SU(5)$ grand unified theory. A vector-like pair of matter multiplets, $10_V+\overline{10}_V$, provides a $D$-flat inflaton direction along the right-handed sneutrino component, with an additional $Z_2$ symmetry forbidding a direct inflaton mass term so that the leading inflationary interaction is a non-renormalizable Kähler-driven operator. Unlike previous studies, we treat the superpotential cutoff scale $M_s$ as independent of the reduced Planck mass, $m_P$, substantially enlarging the viable parameter space. Confronting the model with the ACT DR6/Planck determination $n_s=0.9734\pm0.0034$ and the $2σ$ bound on the running of the spectral index, we identify broad regions of viable parameter space in which the flipped $SU(5)$ symmetry-breaking scale can approach the conventional GUT scale, $M\simeq M_{\rm GUT}$, and the tensor-to-scalar ratio can reach observable values, $r\gtrsim10^{-3}$, within reach of forthcoming CMB $B$-mode experiments such as LiteBIRD and CMB-S4. We further study the post-inflationary dynamics, identifying the inflaton with the lightest right-handed sneutrino in a conventional type-I seesaw sector, whose out-of-equilibrium decay generates a lepton asymmetry that is converted into the observed baryon asymmetry via non-thermal leptogenesis and electroweak sphalerons, for a reheating temperature consistent with both successful leptogenesis and the gravitino constraint.

analysis.title_zh: 翻转 SU(5) 中的 Sneutrino Tribrid 暴胀：面对 ACT DR6 与 Planck 的检验
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在 R 对称翻转 SU(5) 大统一理论中构造右手 sneutrino 作为 inflaton 的 tribrid inflation 实现，并将超势 cutoff 尺度 M_s 与约化 Planck 质量解耦以扩大参数空间。摘要称，在 ACT DR6/Planck 的 n_s 测定和 running 约束下，存在较宽可行区域，可使对称破缺尺度接近常规 GUT 标度并给出 r≳10^-3，同时后暴胀衰变可通过非热轻子生成解释重子不对称。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接把粒子物理暴胀模型与 CMB 标量谱指数、running 和原初张量模约束相连；其声称的 r 水平落在 LiteBIRD、CMB-S4 等未来 B 模实验关注范围内，因此对用 CMB 区分具体高能暴胀模型有参考价值。

用 ACT DR6/Planck 的标量谱指数测定和谱指数 running 的 2σ 约束检验参数空间。
摘要称模型可给出未来 CMB B 模实验可能探测的 r≳10^-3，并连接非热轻子生成。

papers.title: QUIJOTE scientific results - XX. Commissioning and First Results from the Thirty and Forty Gigahertz Instrument (TFGI)
papers.abstract: We present the commissioning and first results of the Thirty and Forty Gigahertz Instrument (TFGI), which observes the sky at 31 and 41 GHz with angular resolutions of 21' and 18' from the second QUIJOTE telescope at the Teide Observatory. Its primary goal is to conduct a deep cosmological survey in selected regions of the Northern sky with high-sensitivity polarization measurements. The commissioning phase covered Nov2021-Oct2022, during which the instrument operated with a configuration of 7 receivers, 4 at 31 GHz and 3 at 41 GHz. Over this period, approximately 1200 h of data were acquired. Of these, 380 h were dedicated to calibration sources, used to characterize the instrumental properties of TFGI, including the pointing model, beam response, gain stability, polarimetric performance, and instantaneous sensitivity. We provide a detailed characterization of these properties and describe how they are being improved for future observing runs. We use 230 h of observations from bright Galactic regions (Cygnus, W43, W44, and W47) to further validate the instrument performance. As an illustrative example, we present the intensity and polarization spectral energy distributions of W44, finding good agreement with existing measurements. From the noise map of these observations, we measure a polarization sensitivity of ~8.3 $μ$K deg$^{-1}$ after an effective observing depth of 0.57 h deg$^{-2}$. This performance, achieved considering only 2 detectors at 31 GHz, is already comparable to that achieved by WMAP (with almost 3 times the integration time per unit area, 1.61 h deg$^{-2}$). Extrapolating these results to the full TFGI array, with up to 29 detectors, we show that the instrument is expected to reach the target sensitivity of ~ 1 $μ$K deg$^{-1}$ at both 31 and 41 GHz over three cosmological fields covering a total area of 3600 deg$^2$ after an effective integration time of 5.7 years.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 19 figures, 17 tables. Accepted for publication in Publications of the Astronomical Society of the Pacific (PASP)

analysis.title_zh: QUIJOTE 科学结果 XX：Thirty and Forty Gigahertz Instrument（TFGI）的调试与首批结果
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告 QUIJOTE 第二望远镜上 Thirty and Forty Gigahertz Instrument（TFGI）的调试和首批科学结果，该仪器在 31 和 41 GHz 进行北天选区的高灵敏度偏振观测。摘要称调试数据刻画了指向、波束、增益稳定性、偏振性能和瞬时灵敏度，并用亮银河区验证性能；现有观测给出偏振灵敏度约 8.3 μK deg^{-1}，外推完整阵列后预计可在三个宇宙学场达到约 1 μK deg^{-1}。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 31–41 GHz 是 CMB 偏振前景建模中非常关键的低频区间，尤其有助于约束同步辐射和异常微波辐射等银河前景。TFGI 若能达到摘要所述灵敏度，将为北天大面积 CMB 偏振分析、B 模前景清除和多频联合图像提供重要低频数据。

调试期数据用于刻画指向、波束、增益稳定性、偏振性能和灵敏度。
摘要报告现有 31 GHz 两个探测器表现已可与 WMAP 相比，并外推全阵列可达目标灵敏度。

向完整 TFGI 阵列性能外推
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对灵敏度估计从噪声图到 μK deg^{-1} 的定义、有效观测深度的计算、系统误差控制，以及从 2 个探测器外推到最多 29 个探测器时采用的噪声和效率假设。

papers.title: Implicit Likelihood Inference and $z$-Binned Reconstruction of Dark Energy $w(z)$
papers.abstract: In this paper, to reconstruct the equation of state (EOS) of dark energy (DE) $w(z)$ with the redshift binning method, we first introduce a $w_i$CDM model with a piecewise-constant EOS in $7$ redshift bins. Then, we turn to the Learning the Universe Implicit Likelihood Inference (LtU-ILI) pipeline to perform a multi-round ILI of $w_i$ from the cosmological data combination, including $TT$, $TE$, $EE$ and lensing power spectra of Planck 2018, distance ratios of DESI DR2 and corrected apparent magnitudes of SNIa from Pantheon+ sample. More precisely, we build the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) power spectrum, Baryon Acoustic Oscillation (BAO) distance ratio and Type Ia Supernovae (SNIa) apparent magnitude simulators by $\mathtt{CLASS}$ and embed them into the LtU-ILI pipeline. And, using Sequential Neural Likelihood Estimation (SNLE), we sequentially train neural networks with $6$ rounds of total $6\times20000$ simulations to target a ``black box'' likelihood of our forward model $w_i$CDM. Finally, with the estimated posteriors of $w_i$, we find that except for the unconstrained $w_5$ and $w_6$ (the last two bins), our reconstruction of $w(z)$ marginally favors dynamical DE in the first bin and is consistent with the cosmological constant at $68\%$ C.L. in the other bins.

analysis.title_zh: 暗能量 w(z) 的隐式似然推断与按红移分箱重构
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 7 个红移分箱的 w_iCDM 模型重构暗能量状态方程 w(z)，并通过 LtU-ILI 管线和 SNLE 对 Planck 2018 CMB、DESI DR2 BAO 与 Pantheon+ SNIa 数据组合进行隐式似然推断。摘要报告，除最后两个 bin 基本不受约束外，第一 bin 边际偏好动态暗能量，其他 bin 在 68% 置信水平下与宇宙学常数一致。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗能量重构是 CMB 与低红移观测联合约束宇宙学模型的核心问题；该工作把 Planck CMB 功率谱和 lensing 与 DESI、Pantheon+ 联合，并使用神经隐式似然方法，因而对评估 CMB 在动态暗能量约束中的作用和新型推断管线的可靠性都相关。
key_points: 用 7 个红移 bin 的分段常数 w_iCDM 重构暗能量状态方程。
将 Planck 2018 CMB、DESI DR2 BAO 与 Pantheon+ SNIa 数据组合纳入隐式似然推断。
摘要称除最后两个 bin 约束不足外，第一 bin 边际偏好动态暗能量，其余 bin 在 68% C.L. 下与宇宙学常数一致。

Learning the Universe Implicit Likelihood Inference 管线

DESI DR2 距离比
Pantheon+ 校正 Ia 型超新星视星等
Sequential Neural Likelihood Estimation

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对红移分箱边界、先验选择、SNLE 后验校准与覆盖率测试，以及神经似然近似是否能可靠处理 Planck CMB 与 DESI/Pantheon+ 数据组合中的退化和系统误差。

papers.title: Overview and status of BICEP Array's BA4-90/150 CMB polarimeter
papers.abstract: The inflation paradigm postulates a period of rapid expansion in the early Universe, which would generate gravitational waves. These tensor perturbations would produce a faint B-mode signature in the polarization of the cosmic microwave background (CMB), but this signal is orders of magnitude weaker than that from the CMB's other anisotropy and that from astrophysical foregrounds. Placing more-stringent upper limits on this signal or making a definitive detection thus requires exceptional control over instrument and measurement systematics, in addition to extremely-deep maps. The fourth BICEP Array receiver, BA4-90/150, aims to build and improve upon the heritage of the field-leading BICEP series of small-aperture CMB experiments with a dichroic instrument observing in 90 and 150 GHz bands, to advance the search for the inflationary B-mode signal. The instrument will utilize transition-edge-sensor bolometers, which will be read out using a new two-level time-division-multiplexed system and be fed via feedhorn-coupled orthomode transducers and refined cold refractive optics, with the goal of both improving systematics control and sensitivity over existing receivers. With a planned deployment to the South Pole in the 2026-27 austral summer, the instrument will occupy the fourth and final remaining slot in the BICEP Array mount, completing the phaseout of Keck Array receivers. An overview of the BA4-90/150 receiver will be presented, along with a discussion of its current status and future plans for the instrument.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, submitted to Proc. SPIE

analysis.title_zh: BICEP Array 的 BA4-90/150 CMB 偏振仪概述与现状
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇仪器论文概述 BICEP Array 的 BA4-90/150 CMB 偏振接收机，目标是在 90/150 GHz 双频段以更高灵敏度和更强系统误差控制搜索暴胀产生的 CMB B 模信号。摘要报告其采用 TES 玻尔计、新两级时分复用读出、馈源喇叭耦合正交模转换器和改进低温折射光学，并计划在 2026-27 南半球夏季部署至南极。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初 B 模是 CMB 宇宙学中检验暴胀张量扰动的核心目标之一，而该信号远弱于其他 CMB 各向异性和天体前景。BA4-90/150 属于直接服务于 B 模偏振测量的地面仪器建设，读者应关注其频段选择、系统误差控制和灵敏度提升如何影响未来对张量标量比的限制或探测能力。
key_points: BA4-90/150 是 BICEP Array 第四台、也是最后一个接收机槽位的 90/150 GHz 双频 CMB 偏振仪。
目标是通过更深巡天图和更好的系统误差控制推进暴胀 B 模搜索。
摘要强调 TES 玻尔计、新的两级时分复用读出、馈源喇叭耦合正交模转换器和改进低温折射光学。

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 BA4-90/150 相比既有 BICEP/Keck 接收机在系统误差控制、灵敏度、光学设计和读出架构上的具体改进是否有量化指标，以及这些改进如何转化为对原初 B 模约束的实际增益。

papers.title: Inflationary Axion Isocurvature in the CMB across All Ultralight Masses
papers.abstract: If the Peccei-Quinn symmetry of an ultralight axion is broken before the end of inflation, axion quantum fluctuations seed isocurvature perturbations, linking them to the tensor-to-scalar ratio $r$. We extend the effective time average (ETA) approach of the Boltzmann code ${\rm AxiECAMB}$ to accurately evolve these perturbations across the full axion mass range from dark energy ($m_a \lesssim H_0$) to dark matter ($m_a \gg 10^{-28}$ eV) types. We provide analytic fitting formulae for the axion abundance given the initial field value $φ_{\rm ini}$, accurate at sub-percent level for $m_a \gg H_0$ and allowed dark matter fraction $f_{\rm dm}$. In the dark matter regime, the Planck bound on CDM isocurvature requires $r\ f_{\rm dm} < 0.08\,(m_a/10^{-27}\,{\rm eV})^{-1/2}$, which becomes stronger than the current BICEP tensor bound for $m_a f_{\rm dm}^2 \gtrsim 10^{-26.4}\,{\rm eV}$. For $10^{-32} \lesssim m_a/{\rm eV} \lesssim 10^{-28}$, Jeans suppression breaks the degeneracy with CDM isocurvature, leaving unique signatures, and in the dark energy regime ($m_a \lesssim H_0$), the isocurvature signal is even more highly suppressed, peaking only at the CMB quadrupole. We provide analytic scalings for both signatures. Given the tensor bound, any primary CMB detection in these two lightest regimes would indicate a non-inflationary origin of the isocurvature modes or a breakdown of the standard frozen-field misalignment scenario. A window of coexistence opens near $m_a \sim 10^{-25}$ eV and $f_{\rm dm} \gtrsim 0.1$ where both axion isocurvature and tensor modes could be discovered just below current bounds while simultaneously alleviating the $S_8$ tension.

analysis.title_zh: 全超轻质量范围内 CMB 中的暴胀轴子等曲率扰动
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究若超轻轴子的 Peccei-Quinn 对称性在暴胀结束前破缺，轴子量子涨落产生的等曲率扰动如何在从暗能量型到暗物质型的全质量范围影响 CMB，并扩展 AxiECAMB 的 ETA 方法来演化这些扰动。摘要给出轴子丰度拟合公式、暗物质质量区间中的 Planck CDM 等曲率约束关系，以及轻质量区间中由 Jeans suppression 或暗能量行为导致的独特或受抑信号。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 等曲率和 B 模张量模是检验暴胀及超轻轴子暗物质/暗能量情景的重要窗口；该论文把 r、轴子质量和暗物质占比联系起来，说明哪些质量区间的 CMB 探测可支持或排除标准 frozen-field misalignment 起源，对未来 CMB 等曲率和原初引力波分析具有直接意义。
key_points: 研究暴胀前 PQ 对称性破缺时超轻轴子等曲率扰动在全质量范围内的 CMB 信号。
扩展 AxiECAMB 的 ETA 方法，并给出轴子丰度与等曲率信号的解析拟合或标度。
摘要指出不同质量区间的 CMB 等曲率特征不同，并给出与 r、f_dm、m_a 相关的约束关系。
methods: AxiECAMB Boltzmann 代码
effective time average 方法扩展
解析拟合公式
Planck CDM 等曲率约束
当前 BICEP 张量约束比较

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 AxiECAMB 的 ETA 扩展在各质量区间的精度验证、等曲率初始条件和 misalignment 假设，以及摘要给出的 r、m_a、f_dm 标度关系如何从 Planck/BICEP 约束映射而来。

papers.title: The Impact of Splashback Galaxies on Galaxy Assembly Bias
papers.abstract: The clustering of galaxies is affected by the assembly history of their underlying dark matter halos. This complex phenomenon, known as galaxy assembly bias, has been extensively studied, but the exact physical origin remains unclear. Splashback halos, typically low-mass halos that have traversed larger neighboring halos, have been suggested to be associated with halo assembly bias. Using a semi-analytic galaxy-formation model applied to the Millennium simulation, we explicitly explore the role that splasback galaxies play in galaxy assembly bias. We identify splashbacks as present-day central galaxies that were formerly satellites of a more massive host, and construct stellar-mass selected galaxy samples with the splashbacks either removed or reclassified as satellites of their former host halo. We find that splashbacks tend to reside in low-mass, highly concentrated halos and in dense environments, and that they have relatively high stellar-to-halo mass ratios. Splashbacks appear to be largely responsible for the low-mass tail of the occupancy variation for highly concentrated halos and for halos in dense environments. Finally, when computing the impact of assembly bias on galaxy clustering, we find that while removing the splashbacks significantly reduces the signal, reassigning them has little effect on its amplitude but shifts the transition scale. We repeat the analysis with the hydrodynamical simulation TNG300, confirming the robustness of our results. Our results provide insight into assembly bias and have potential implications for modeling the galaxy-halo connection.

analysis.title_zh: 飞溅回落星系对星系装配偏置的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究飞溅回落星系是否是星系装配偏置的重要来源。作者在 Millennium 模拟的半解析星系形成模型中识别曾为卫星、现为中心的星系，并测试移除或重分类它们对恒星质量选择样本聚类的影响；摘要报告称，移除飞溅回落星系会显著降低装配偏置信号，而重分配主要改变转折尺度，并在 TNG300 中得到稳健性确认。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系装配偏置会影响用星系聚类推断暗物质晕占据关系和宇宙学参数的建模。对 CMB 研究者而言，它与大尺度结构、CMB 透镜及星系巡天交叉相关分析中的星系-晕连接系统误差有关。
key_points: 飞溅回落星系被定义为现在的中心星系、过去曾是更大宿主的卫星。
去除这类星系会显著降低星系聚类中的装配偏置信号。
在 Millennium 半解析模型与 TNG300 水动力学模拟中得到一致的稳健性检验。
methods: Millennium simulation 上的半解析星系形成模型
将飞溅回落星系移除或重新归类为其原宿主晕的卫星
恒星质量选择的星系样本
星系聚类中装配偏置影响的计算
TNG300 水动力学模拟复核
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对飞溅回落星系的识别定义、移除与重分类两种处理对 halo occupation 和聚类尺度依赖的具体影响，以及 Millennium 半解析模型与 TNG300 中选择函数是否一致。

papers.title: Axion dark matter search with a photonic bandgap cavity haloscope and dielectric tuning rod over 10.25-10.45 GHz
papers.abstract: We report the development of a new widely tunable cavity and demonstrate its use in a search for dark matter axions. We achieve unloaded quality factors above $10^{5}$, roughly $25\times$ larger than a bare copper cavity at the same frequency, using concentric sapphire shells to reduce Ohmic losses on the cavity barrel. A rotating sapphire rod tunes our cavity mode over the $10.1-11.7$ GHz range, approximately $16\%$ of its resonant frequency. Using an amplified receiver chain, we demonstrate sensitivity to new axion parameter space by tuning the cavity over the $200$ MHz range between $10.25-10.45$ GHz (42.4 - 43.2, $μ$eV) to constrain the axion-to-photon coupling to $|g_{aγγ}|$ $\leq$ 1 $\times$ $10^{-12}$ ${GeV}^{-1}$. This cavity can scan its tuning range about $9$ times faster compared to a bare copper cavity when paired with a photon counting device, laying the groundwork for a definitive search for the QCD axion over $10.1-11.7$ GHz.

analysis.title_zh: 使用光子带隙腔 haloscope 和介质调谐杆在 10.25--10.45 GHz 搜索轴子暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 论文报告一种新的可宽范围调谐光子带隙腔，并将其用于 10.25--10.45 GHz 频段的暗物质轴子搜索。摘要称该装置通过蓝宝石结构提高品质因数并降低损耗，已探索新的轴子参数空间，对轴子-光子耦合给出 |g_{aγγ}| ≤ 1×10^{-12} GeV^{-1} 的约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 轴子是冷暗物质候选之一，暗物质微观性质会影响宇宙学模型的物质成分解释。该实验不直接分析 CMB，但对暗物质候选粒子的实验限制为 CMB 与大尺度结构所采用的暗物质假设提供粒子物理层面的互补检验。
key_points: 开发并演示一种可宽范围调谐的光子带隙腔轴子 haloscope。
使用同心蓝宝石壳降低欧姆损耗，并用旋转蓝宝石棒调谐腔模。
在 10.25--10.45 GHz 范围搜索暗物质轴子，并对轴子-光子耦合给出约束。
