papers.title: Numerical Backreaction and Finite-Time Energy Transfer in Post-Recombination Magnetogenesis from Ultralight Dark Matter
papers.abstract: We study gauge-field production in a post-recombination magnetogenesis scenario driven by an ultralight pseudoscalar dark matter field $φ$ coupled to electromagnetism. Previous analytical work has shown that a homogeneous oscillating $φ$ background can excite gauge field modes through tachyonic and narrow-band resonance channels. Here we follow the coupled evolution of the homogeneous $φ$ mode and gauge field modes of both helicities in an expanding background. Our numerical work confirms the results for the spectra of produced gauge particles obtained in the previous approximate analytical treatments. In addition, our study allows us to determine when back-reaction shuts off the resonance. We find that for parameter values for which the tachyonic instability band is open, back-reaction does not shut off the resonance until a fraction ${\cal{F}}$ of order one of the initial dark matter energy density has been transferred to photons, and this happens on a time scale which is short compared to the Hubble time. In the parameter range in which only the narrow resonance band is open, ${\cal{F}}$ eventually reaches order one, but the time when this happens increases as the effective coupling constant decreases, and therefore ${\cal{F}}$ may remain negligible until the present time.

analysis.title_zh: 再组合后由超轻暗物质产生磁场中的数值反作用与有限时间能量转移
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究再组合后由超轻赝标量暗物质与电磁场耦合驱动的磁场生成，数值跟踪均匀 φ 模与两种螺旋度规范场模在膨胀背景中的耦合演化。摘要称数值结果确认了此前近似解析的粒子产生谱，并进一步给出反作用何时终止共振：快子不稳定带打开时可在短于哈勃时间内向光子转移初始暗物质能量的有序一部分；仅窄共振时转移可延迟到今天仍可忽略。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 再组合后的电磁场产生会影响宇宙磁场起源，并可能通过额外辐射、CMB 偏振旋转、各向异性或谱畸变受到限制。对反作用和能量转移时间尺度的数值估计，是判断这类暗物质磁场生成模型是否与 CMB 观测兼容的关键。
key_points: 研究超轻赝标量暗物质驱动的再组合后磁场生成。
数值演化同时包含均匀暗物质场与两种螺旋度的规范场模。
摘要称反作用可在短于哈勃时间的尺度上传递初始暗物质能量的有序一部分，但窄共振区可能到今天仍很小。
methods: 膨胀背景中的耦合数值演化
均匀振荡赝标量场与电磁场耦合模型
两种螺旋度规范场模
与既有近似解析谱结果比较
反作用终止共振的判定
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其反作用判据、能量守恒处理、膨胀背景近似以及参数区间是否与 CMB 各向异性、谱畸变、法拉第旋转和暗物质丰度约束相容。

papers.title: Probing the baryonic--dark matter connection in galaxy clusters using X-rays with gated recurrent unit neural networks
papers.abstract: Accurate cluster mass measurements are crucial for cosmology, yet conventional hydrostatic equilibrium (HSE) methods can suffer from systematic biases, particularly in dynamically disturbed systems. We present a gated recurrent unit (GRU) based deep learning framework for predicting three-dimensional mass profiles of galaxy clusters from spherically averaged intra-cluster medium (ICM) radial profiles. By treating ICM profiles as sequential data, the GRU captures radial dependencies and naturally handles profiles with different radial samplings. We train and validate the model using high-resolution hydrodynamical simulations from The Three Hundred Project, achieving unbiased mass predictions with a typical 1$σ$ scatter of $\sim$5% over most of the cluster region, significantly improving upon HSE estimates. The model provides radius-dependent uncertainty estimates and remains robust against variations in data quality and cluster morphology. When trained jointly on independent simulation suites (GIZMO-SIMBA and GADGET-X), it successfully generalises across both simulations. Feature importance analysis shows that enclosed gas mass is the dominant predictor, with pressure and temperature providing additional information on the radial mass distribution. We further apply the GRU model to X-ray observations of the REXCESS and X-COP cluster samples from XMM-Newton and compare the inferred mass profiles with HSE estimates. The HSE masses are systematically lower than the GRU predictions for the higher-mass X-COP sample, while the REXCESS sample shows mass differences that are close to zero on average. This work provides a data-driven framework for cluster mass inference that bridges simulations and observations and can be extended to multi-wavelength datasets, including Sunyaev-Zel'dovich and optical observations.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 21 figures, 4 tables, submitted to A&A, abstract abridged for arXiv submission, comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: 使用带门控循环单元神经网络的 X 射线观测探测星系团中的重子--暗物质联系
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对星系团宇宙学中质量估计的系统偏差问题，提出用 GRU 将球对称平均的 ICM 径向剖面作为序列数据来预测三维质量剖面。摘要称该方法在 The Three Hundred Project 模拟上给出近乎无偏、典型散布约 5% 的质量预测，并在 REXCESS 与 X-COP 的 XMM-Newton 观测上与 HSE 结果比较，发现高质量 X-COP 样本的 HSE 质量系统低于 GRU 预测。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系团质量校准直接影响由星系团数目推断的 σ8、Ωm 等宇宙学参数，并与 CMB 初级各向异性给出的参数约束存在交叉检验关系。若机器学习方法能降低 HSE 偏差，它会影响用 X 射线、SZ 和光学星系团样本进行的 CMB-SZ 联合宇宙学分析。
key_points: 用 GRU 从星系团 ICM 径向剖面预测三维质量剖面。
训练和验证基于 The Three Hundred Project，并测试跨 GIZMO-SIMBA 与 GADGET-X 模拟泛化。
应用到 XMM-Newton 的 REXCESS 与 X-COP，发现高质量 X-COP 中 HSE 质量低于 GRU 预测。
methods: 门控循环单元神经网络
球对称平均 ICM 径向剖面
The Three Hundred Project 高分辨率流体动力学模拟
GIZMO-SIMBA 与 GADGET-X 联合训练
特征重要性分析
XMM-Newton 的 REXCESS 和 X-COP X 射线观测

papers.title: Evolving Dark Energy from the Back-Reaction of Cosmological Perturbations
papers.abstract: We argue that the back-reaction of inhomogeneities, when combined with a pure cosmological constant, produces an effective dark energy whose equation of state can evolve with time. Our analytical computation agrees with recent numerical simulations, which have shown that the back-reaction of inhomogeneities can impact dark energy around the present time. Here, its equation of state is derived from an average version of the Friedmann equations, for which the average is taken over a fixed volume of matter particles (not necessarily global). When treating the inhomogeneities as small perturbations around a homogeneous background, dark energy acquires a time dependence which reduces to a boundary term, at least at quadratic order in the scalar modes of the perturbations. Thus, it becomes negligible for a global average. On the other hand, when treating instead the spatial derivatives of the inhomogeneities perturbatively in a gradient expansion, dark energy gets the same time dependence, which no longer reduces to a boundary term. This time dependence can be significant even for a global average or when the constant spatial curvature induced by the inhomogeneities is negligible. It also keeps the same sign around the present time, thus causing dark energy to remain either always phantom or never phantom, not allowing for any crossing from one type of behaviour to the other.

analysis.title_zh: 由宇宙学扰动反作用产生的演化暗能量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论宇宙非均匀性的反作用在存在纯宇宙学常数时是否会表现为随时间演化的有效暗能量，并从平均 Friedmann 方程推导其状态方程。摘要称解析结果与近期数值模拟一致；在小扰动处理下时间依赖在标量二阶至少化为边界项而对全局平均可忽略，但在梯度展开下不再是边界项，且当前附近可产生显著、符号不变的时间依赖。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗能量状态方程是 CMB 与 BAO、超新星和大尺度结构联合约束的核心参数之一。若非均匀性平均反作用能模拟演化暗能量，需要重新审视将 CMB 约束外推到低红移宇宙时对均匀背景和 ΛCDM 参数化的假设。
key_points: 讨论非均匀性反作用与纯宇宙学常数共同产生演化的有效暗能量。
从平均 Friedmann 方程推导有效状态方程，并比较小扰动展开与梯度展开。
摘要称当前附近时间依赖可保持同一符号，使暗能量始终为 phantom 或始终非 phantom。

固定物质粒子体积上的平均
小扰动展开
标量扰动二阶计算
梯度展开
与近期数值模拟比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对平均方案的规范依赖、边界项处理、固定物质体积的物理定义，以及梯度展开在当前宇宙非线性结构尺度上的适用范围。

papers.title: Gravitational Wave Birefringence in generalized Palatini Chern Simons
papers.abstract: The cosmological propagation of gravitational waves (GWs) can exhibit amplitude and phase polarization distortions when parity symmetry is broken, a phenomenon known as cosmological birefringence. In this paper, we investigate the phenomenology of GW birefringence in a gravitational model $f(R)$ coupled to a dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) term, analyzed in the metric and Palatini formalisms. At the background level, this model can lead to dynamical dark energy, while for GW propagation we find that the Palatini formalism predicts both amplitude and velocity birefringence, whereas the metric formalism predicts amplitude birefringence only. We also find that the birefringence effects can either be suppressed or enhanced by the $f(R)$ interactions, depending on the specific form of $f(R)$. Considering three common $f(R)$ models (Hu-Sawicki, Exponential, and Hyperbolic gravity) fit to recent cosmological data, we find that birefringence is enhanced relative to the $f(R) = R$ case, by $1-10\%$ in the Palatini formalism and up to a factor of 2 in the metric formalism. We also translate current GW birefringence constraints to bounds on the dCS coupling within our model. Finally, we show that in our model the birefringence effect grows polynomially with source redshift, in contrast to the linear-distance scaling commonly assumed in phenomenological models of GW birefringence in the current literature.

analysis.title_zh: 广义 Palatini Chern-Simons 理论中的引力波双折射
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究在 f(R) 引力耦合动力学 Chern-Simons 项时，宇宙学尺度上的引力波传播如何产生宇称破缺导致的双折射，并比较度规形式与 Palatini 形式。摘要报告称 Palatini 形式可产生振幅和速度双折射，而度规形式只产生振幅双折射；在三类常用 f(R) 模型中，双折射相对 f(R)=R 情形可被增强，并且其红移依赖呈多项式增长。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要面向引力波宇宙学和修正引力，但与 CMB 宇宙学也相关：宇称破缺和宇宙学双折射是 CMB 偏振研究中的核心主题之一，尽管这里讨论的是引力波而非电磁波。其 f(R) 背景可导致动力学暗能量，也关系到用 CMB、BAO、超新星等联合数据约束晚期宇宙学和修正引力模型。
key_points: 研究广义 Palatini/度规形式下的 f(R)+动力学 Chern-Simons 引力波双折射。
Palatini 形式给出振幅和速度双折射，度规形式只给出振幅双折射。
摘要称常见 f(R) 模型会相对 f(R)=R 增强双折射，并可把现有引力波约束转化为 dCS 耦合界限。
methods: f(R) 引力与动力学 Chern-Simons 项耦合模型
度规形式与 Palatini 形式对比
Hu-Sawicki、Exponential、Hyperbolic 三类 f(R) 模型
拟合近期宇宙学数据的模型参数
现有引力波双折射约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对双折射传播方程在度规与 Palatini 形式中的推导、f(R) 参数如何由宇宙学数据拟合而来，以及把现有引力波双折射约束映射到 dCS 耦合时是否依赖特定源红移或先验假设。

papers.title: When galaxies burst II. Implications of enhanced burstiness for the 21-cm Cosmic Dawn signal
papers.abstract: Recent JWST observations suggest that star formation in the early universe was substantially burstier than assumed in standard models. Such burstiness can be described as a stochastic process characterized by the burst amplitude and the coherence time of star formation epochs. In this paper, we investigate how bursty star formation modifies the 21-cm power spectrum during Cosmic Dawn through its impact on the non-local radiation fields that govern its evolution, namely Lyman-$α$ and X-ray backgrounds. To do so, we introduce an unequal-time correlation in the star-formation-rate density sourcing the two fields and we compute its impact using the analytical framework implemented in the public code Zeus21. We find that the burstiness-induced time correlation produces a shot-noise-like contribution in the Lyman-$α$ and X-ray fields, enhancing both their auto- and cross-power spectra while leaving the global 21-cm signal, $T_{21}(z)$, unchanged. As a result, the 21-cm power spectrum is strongly modified by a shot-noise-like contribution at the beginning of the Cosmic Dawn, where the signal is dominated by lower-mass halos ($M_h\lesssim10^{10}\,M_\odot$), and is boosted by a factor of a few near the Wouthuysen-Field absorption trough. Elsewhere at low redshift, where the clustering signal dominates and larger halos drive the signal, the burstiness component is negligible.

analysis.title_zh: 当星系暴发 II：增强的暴发性对 21 厘米宇宙黎明信号的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 JWST 所暗示的早期宇宙更强暴发式恒星形成会如何影响宇宙黎明时期的 21-cm 功率谱。作者在 Zeus21 的解析框架中为 Lyman-α 和 X 射线背景源项引入恒星形成率密度的不等时相关；摘要报告称这会给相关辐射场带来类似 shot noise 的贡献，增强其自功率谱和互功率谱，从而在宇宙黎明早期及 Wouthuysen-Field 吸收谷附近显著提升 21-cm 功率谱，但不改变全球 21-cm 信号。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 21-cm 宇宙黎明信号是 CMB 之后早期结构形成和再电离前物理的重要探针，可与 CMB 对初始扰动、再电离历史和小尺度结构的约束互补。若早期恒星形成的时间随机性显著改变 21-cm 功率谱，将影响未来 21-cm 实验与 CMB 数据联合解释早期星系形成和辐射背景演化的方式。
key_points: 把早期宇宙暴发式恒星形成建模为具有振幅和相干时间的随机过程。
在 Zeus21 的解析框架中引入恒星形成率密度的不等时相关。
摘要称暴发性增强 Lyman-α 和 X 射线场功率谱，从而在宇宙黎明早期显著改变 21-cm 功率谱，但不改变全球 21-cm 信号。
methods: JWST 早期星系观测动机
暴发式恒星形成的随机过程建模
恒星形成率密度的不等时相关
Zeus21 公共代码的解析框架
Lyman-α 背景与 X-ray 背景
21-cm 功率谱与全球信号 T21(z)
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对不等时相关函数如何参数化、shot-noise-like 项如何进入 Lyman-α/X 射线场及 21-cm 功率谱，以及“全球信号不变但功率谱增强”的结论在不同晕质量、红移和源模型假设下是否稳健。

papers.title: The correlation between voids identified in 3D large-scale-structure and 2D weak-lensing maps
papers.abstract: We investigate the correspondence between voids identified in the 3D halo distribution and those detected in WL convergence maps. We used 108 realizations of the full-sky lensing simulations, populated with a source galaxy redshift distribution consistent with the Dark Energy Survey Year 3 sample. Catalogs of 3D halo voids and WL voids were constructed using the VIDE and tunnel algorithms, respectively. The spatial association between the two populations was quantified by measuring the angular excess number density of halo voids around WL void centers. We detected a statistically significant (S/N >= 25) positive correlation between WL voids and low-redshift halo voids (0 < z_hv < 0.5) at small angular separations, indicating that WL voids trace genuine underdensities in the large-scale matter distribution. The correlation amplitude closely depends on the WL void selection scheme and decreases when stringent peak-amplitude thresholds are applied, thereby reducing the number of detected WL voids and broadening their effective sizes. The signal also displays a strong redshift dependence: halo voids at higher redshift exhibit weaker correlations because of the declining efficiency of the WL kernel, while WL voids identified from higher-redshift source bins produce stronger correlations due to the increased contribution from line-of-sight structures. We additionally examined the impact of halo-void morphology and found that rounder voids with a weaker alignment along the line of sight display marginally stronger associations with WL voids. Our results provide new insights into the contribution of 3D structure to WL-selected underdensities and offer guidance for future observational analyses seeking to interpret WL voids as tracers of the matter field.

analysis.title_zh: 三维大尺度结构中识别的空洞与二维弱透镜图之间的相关性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究三维大尺度结构 halo 分布中识别的 void 与二维弱透镜汇聚图中 void 的对应关系，使用全天透镜模拟并分别用 VIDE 和 tunnel 算法构建目录。摘要报告低红移 halo void 与 WL void 在小角距上存在显著正相关，相关强度依赖 WL void 选择、红移以及 void 形态。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 弱透镜 void 是从投影质量分布中识别的欠密结构，能补充星系团、剪切两点函数等传统宇宙学探针。对 CMB 研究者而言，这类低红移结构探针可用于与 CMB 给出的初始条件和 ΛCDM 生长历史相互检验，特别是在暗能量、结构增长和投影透镜核建模方面。
key_points: 比较三维 halo void 与二维弱透镜汇聚图中 void 的空间对应关系。
摘要报告低红移 halo void 与 WL void 在小角距上有正相关，且随选择阈值、红移和 void 形态变化。
结果旨在帮助解释 WL void 是否可作为大尺度物质欠密区的示踪。
methods: 108 个全天弱透镜模拟实现
与 Dark Energy Survey Year 3 样本一致的源星系红移分布
VIDE 算法构建三维 halo void 目录
tunnel 算法构建 WL void 目录
测量 WL void 中心周围 halo void 的角向超额数密度

papers.title: What could an emerging Big Bang Nucleosynthesis discrepancy be hinting at?
papers.abstract: The latest measurement of the primordial deuterium abundance is in $\sim 2σ$ tension with several state-of-the-art predictions of standard Big Bang nucleosynthesis (BBN), when using the baryon density inferred from the $Λ$CDM model fit to cosmic microwave background (CMB) data. This tension increases to $\sim 3σ$ for models attempting to solve the Hubble tension, such as early dark energy (EDE), which generally predict a larger baryon density than in $Λ$CDM. We test whether this discrepancy could be pointing to a non-standard expansion history during BBN. We compute light-element abundances with PRIMAT and compare $Λ$CDM, a $ΔN_{\rm eff}$ extension, and a very early dark energy (vEDE) component. For vEDE, we sample $ΔH/H$, the fractional increase of the expansion rate while deuterium burning is freezing out and helium-4 fusion is mostly over. The Bayesian analysis using BBN plus the CMB baryon-density constraint in the EDE cosmology gives $ΔH/H = 0.087^{+0.036}_{-0.037}$ during the deuterium burning epoch, i.e. at a temperature $T_{\rm D}\simeq0.03\,{\rm MeV}$, and no residual tension. The vEDE component preserves the observed deuterium abundance at the larger CMB baryon density while only mildly affecting helium-4. By contrast, extra radiation raises the helium-4 abundance too efficiently and does not reconcile the baryon density determinations. Together with inflation, dark energy, and EDE, our results hint at the presence of another light scalar field in cosmology.

analysis.title_zh: 一个正在显现的大爆炸核合成差异可能暗示什么？
analysis.summary_zh: 本文探讨最新原初氘丰度测量与使用 CMB 推断重子密度得到的标准 BBN 预言之间的张力，检验这是否指向 BBN 时期的非标准膨胀史。摘要报告，在 BBN 加 CMB 重子密度约束下，极早期暗能量成分可提高氘燃烧冻结时期的膨胀率并消除残余张力，而单纯增加有效相对论自由度会过度提高氦-4丰度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接连接 CMB 推断的重子密度、BBN 轻元素丰度和早期宇宙膨胀史，是 CMB 参数解释中的核心一致性检验。若摘要所述机制成立，它会影响用 CMB 约束早期暗能量、有效中微子数和 Hubble 张力模型时对 BBN 先验的使用。
key_points: 讨论原初氘丰度与基于 CMB 重子密度的标准 BBN 预言之间的新张力。
比较 ΛCDM、ΔN_eff 扩展和极早期暗能量成分对轻元素丰度的影响。
摘要称 vEDE 可在较高 CMB 重子密度下保持氘丰度，并较温和地影响氦-4，而额外辐射不能同样调和。
methods: PRIMAT 轻元素丰度计算
BBN 与 CMB 重子密度约束的贝叶斯分析
ΛCDM 模型比较
ΔN_eff 扩展
very early dark energy/vEDE 成分
采样氘燃烧冻结时期的膨胀率分数增量 ΔH/H
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对 CMB 重子密度约束在 EDE 宇宙学中的取法、PRIMAT 输入核反应率和观测氘丰度系统误差，以及 vEDE 参数化是否与 CMB、BBN 和其他早期宇宙约束自洽。

papers.title: Gravitational Lensing Predictions from Wave Simulations of Fuzzy Dark Matter
papers.abstract: In the cold dark matter paradigm, ultra-light particles are emerging as strong contenders to conventional massive particles. A unique prediction of dark matter comprising such ultra-light particles, known as fuzzy dark matter (FDM), is the presence of strong density modulations throughout galactic halos due to wave interference, which -- when approximated by a Gaussian random field (GRF) -- have been proposed to account for the inability to reproduce the observed positions (when measured at sufficient precisions) and flux ratios of multiply-lensed images of quasars. Here, we predict for the first time the properties of gravitationally lensed images generated from 3-D density fields obtained by wave simulations that directly evolve the Schrödinger--Poisson equations. Using a novel framework to project these evolved density fields along various axes of the 3-D halo, we obtain the distribution of perturbations to the positions of lensed images. As an exacting test, we find that particles of mass $10^{-22}$ eV can reproduce the positions of the quadruply-lensed radio jets in system HS 0810+2554 to a level better than that of either the GRF approximation or, to a greater extent, an NFW best-fit solution, both of which rely on accurately capturing the global 3-D density field of dark matter halos. Our work highlights the importance of wave simulations for making accurate FDM lensing predictions and the potential for high-resolution observations of lensed systems to serve as a direct probe of the nature of dark matter.

analysis.title_zh: 来自模糊暗物质波模拟的引力透镜预言
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对模糊暗物质的波动干涉密度调制，使用直接演化 Schrödinger–Poisson 方程的三维波模拟来预测强引力透镜图像的位置扰动。摘要称其新投影框架得到的预测可用于检验多重成像类星体，其中 10^-22 eV 粒子在 HS 0810+2554 系统中的表现优于 GRF 近似和 NFW 最佳拟合。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质微观性质会影响小尺度结构，而这些尺度通常不是原初 CMB 各向异性最直接约束的区域。强透镜中的小尺度扰动可与 CMB 对暗物质、初始功率谱和结构形成的约束互补，帮助区分冷暗物质与超轻粒子暗物质情景。
key_points: 用直接演化 Schrödinger–Poisson 方程的波模拟来预测 FDM 引力透镜图像扰动。
提出将三维演化密度场沿不同轴投影的框架，以获得透镜像位置扰动分布。
摘要报告质量为 10^-22 eV 的粒子可比 GRF 近似和 NFW 最佳拟合更好地再现 HS 0810+2554 四重透镜射电喷流位置。
methods: 模糊暗物质三维波模拟
直接演化 Schrödinger–Poisson 方程
沿三维 halo 不同轴投影演化密度场的新框架
引力透镜像位置扰动分布预测
与 GRF 近似和 NFW 最佳拟合解比较
HS 0810+2554 四重透镜射电喷流系统
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对波模拟的 halo 初始条件和分辨率、三维密度场投影到透镜面的处理、与 GRF/NFW 比较是否使用一致的全局 halo 约束，以及单个透镜系统对 FDM 粒子质量的代表性。

papers.title: New Type IIB Poly-instanton Effects and Axion Quintessence
papers.abstract: Previous studies of poly-instantons in type IIB Calabi-Yau orientifolds found that these effects arise when Euclidean D3-branes wrap rigid cycles with a Wilson line. In this work, we extend this result through a general analysis of instanton zero modes, revealing the existence of new poly-instanton effects for rigid cycles with a deformation, provided that O3-planes are localised on the worldvolume of the Euclidean D3-brane. We provide concrete Calabi-Yau examples with explicit orientifold involution and brane setup. One of them is particularly well suited for realising axion hilltop quintessence. In particular, the double exponential suppression of poly-instanton effects allows to reproduce the observed vacuum energy for natural values of the underlying parameters.

analysis.title_zh: 新的 IIB 型 Poly-instanton 效应与轴子 Quintessence
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 IIB Calabi-Yau orientifold 中 poly-instanton 效应的来源，指出除既有的带 Wilson 线刚性循环外，带形变的刚性循环在欧几里得 D3-brane 世界体上局域 O3 平面时也可产生新效应。摘要还给出具体 Calabi-Yau/orientifold/brane 构造，并称其中一个适合实现轴子 hilltop quintessence，双指数抑制可在自然底层参数下复现观测真空能。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文偏高能宇宙学而非直接 CMB 分析，但它涉及暗能量/quintessence 的微观构造。若轴子 quintessence 给出可观测的暗能量演化，它会影响晚期膨胀史、距离尺度和 CMB 透镜等宇宙学约束；不过摘要没有给出具体 CMB 预言。
key_points: 提出 IIB Calabi-Yau orientifold 中新的 poly-instanton 来源。
新效应要求带形变的刚性循环，且 O3 平面局域在欧几里得 D3-brane 世界体上。
一个构造被摘要称为适合实现轴子 hilltop quintessence。
methods: 瞬子零模的一般分析
具体 Calabi-Yau 例子
显式 orientifold involution 与 brane setup
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对新的零模计数条件是否充分且稳定，尤其是 O3 平面局域化、带形变刚性循环与 poly-instanton 贡献之间的逻辑链条，以及“自然参数”下复现观测真空能的参数依赖是否需要额外调谐。

papers.title: Primordial black holes forming during kination: the trapped, the overdense, and the void
papers.abstract: We study primordial black-hole (PBH) formation in a single-field model which passes from slow roll, through a transient ultra-slow-roll phase, into kination. Nonlinear numerical-relativity simulations are used to follow localised, initially sub-Hubble field fluctuations across the non-attractor transition, to determine the resulting super-Hubble curvature profiles, and subsequently to evolve their re-entry during kination. Within the set of initial configurations explored here, we find three qualitatively distinct outcomes, namely a patch which remains trapped in inflation, a positive-curvature overdensity, and a negative-curvature void bounded by an overdense shell. Each may form a PBH, although by a different physical mechanism. For one selected profile in each of the overdense and void channels, we measure collapse thresholds and compare them with thresholds for sinc profiles. The comparison shows that neither the central curvature nor the peak linear compaction alone provides a profile- or channel-independent collapse criterion. PBH abundances in non-attractor models must therefore be formulated in terms of the distribution of complete profiles, with the trapped, overdense, and void channels treated separately.

analysis.title_zh: Kination 期间形成的原初黑洞：被困者、过密区与空洞
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究单场模型从慢滚经短暂超慢滚进入 kination 时的原初黑洞形成，使用非线性数值相对论模拟追踪初始亚哈勃场涨落、超哈勃曲率轮廓及其在 kination 中的再入。摘要报告在所探索初始构型中存在三类可形成 PBH 的通道，并指出中心曲率或线性 compaction 峰值都不能作为轮廓和通道无关的塌缩准则。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: PBH 形成与早期宇宙小尺度扰动、暴胀非吸引子阶段及可能的暗物质候选有关；这些机制虽然通常发生在 CMB 直接探测尺度之外，但会约束暴胀模型的整体功率谱形状和非高斯性设定。对 CMB 研究者而言，关键联系在于该模型如何与大尺度 CMB 约束相容，以及小尺度增强是否伴随可观测的二阶引力波或其他宇宙学信号。
key_points: 研究慢滚、短暂超慢滚到 kination 的单场模型中 PBH 形成。
数值相对论模拟给出三类结局：困在暴胀中、正曲率过密、负曲率空洞伴随过密壳。
摘要强调 PBH 丰度需要完整曲率轮廓分布，而非单一中心曲率或线性 compaction 峰值。
methods: 非线性数值相对论模拟
局域、初始亚哈勃场涨落演化
kination 期间再入演化
塌缩阈值测量
与 sinc profiles 阈值比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对初始构型集合的覆盖范围、三种通道的判据定义、塌缩阈值测量方式，以及从完整 profile 分布推导 PBH 丰度时需要的统计假设是否可操作。

papers.title: The road towards precision measurements of $H_0$ with bright sirens in the Einstein Telescope era
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave standard sirens provide an independent probe of cosmic expansion since their luminosity distances are inferred directly from the gravitational-wave signal and, for bright sirens (BSs), the source redshifts are obtained through the identification of electromagnetic counterparts. In this work, we forecast the constraining power of future bright siren catalogues on the Hubble constant using simulated binary-neutron-star mergers detected by the Einstein Telescope with associated electromagnetic counterparts. We construct mock catalogues with different numbers of events and redshift distributions, with GW170817 as a reference BS, and analyse the resulting constraints within a flat $Λ$CDM cosmology. We find that, when bright sirens are used as a standalone probe, most of the information on $H_0$ is provided by low-redshift events, with the improvement in precision saturating for sources above $z \sim 1$; beyond that redshift, the constraining power of BSs is increasingly limited by the degeneracy with $Ω_m$, which prevents further gains in precision on $H_0$. In this case, approximately $90$ low-redshift BSs are required to reach $σ_{H_0} \sim 1\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$, while about $45$ are sufficient for $σ_{H_0} \sim 2\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$. When external BAO information is included to reduce the $H_0 - Ω_m$ degeneracy, intermediate-redshift sirens become more informative and the required number of events decreases substantially, to roughly $20$ and $15$ BSs for $σ_{H_0} \sim 1\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ and $σ_{H_0} \sim 2\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$, respectively. These results highlight the importance of both electromagnetic counterpart identification and complementary background probes in making BSs a competitive, distance-ladder-independent test of the Hubble tension.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Prepared for submission to the Open Journal of Astrophysics

analysis.title_zh: 爱因斯坦望远镜时代用亮标准警报实现 H0 精密测量之路
analysis.summary_zh: 本文预报爱因斯坦望远镜时代带电磁对应体的双中子星亮标准警报对 H0 的约束能力，在平直 ΛCDM 中用不同事件数和红移分布的模拟目录进行分析。摘要报告称，单独使用亮标准警报时信息主要来自低红移事件，z≳1 后受 H0-Ωm 退化限制；加入 BAO 后可显著减少达到给定 H0 精度所需的事件数。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: H0 张力是当前 CMB 与低红移距离标尺之间的核心宇宙学问题之一；亮标准警报提供不依赖传统距离阶梯的距离-红移测量，可作为检验 CMB 推断 H0 与晚期宇宙测量是否一致的独立通道。该文还强调 BAO 等背景探针在打破参数退化中的作用，与 CMB+BAO 联合宇宙学分析直接相关。
key_points: 爱因斯坦望远镜时代的亮标准警报可独立约束 H0。
低红移事件对单独约束 H0 贡献最大，高红移处受 H0-Ωm 退化限制。
加入 BAO 信息后，中等红移警报更有用，所需事件数明显减少。
methods: 模拟由爱因斯坦望远镜探测并带电磁对应体的双中子星并合事件
构造不同事件数和红移分布的 mock bright-siren catalogues
以 GW170817 作为参考亮标准警报
平直 ΛCDM 宇宙学下的 H0 约束预报
加入外部 BAO 信息以减弱 H0-Ωm 退化
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 mock 目录的事件选择、红移分布、电磁对应体识别假设和距离误差建模；这些假设直接决定所需亮标准警报数量以及与 BAO 联合后的收益。

papers.title: The burgeoning rise of the 21-cm forest I: constraints on the optical depth of the intergalactic medium at $5.38 < z < 5.84$
papers.abstract: The redshifted 21-cm line is a promising probe of the Epoch of Reionization, during which the first generation of stars ionized the InterGalactic Medium (IGM). We aimed to constrain the IGM neutral Hydrogen fraction and spin temperature via redshifted 21-cm absorption against high-redshift radio sources. We analysed an 18-hour observation of the radio-loud quasar PSO J352.4034-15.3373 ($z = 5.84$) in the 203-222.5 MHz band. We obtained a continuum image with a $0.66$ mJy/beam rms noise and a spectrum with $3.6$ mJy/beam rms noise per 390 kHz-wide channel. We fit the quasar spectrum with a power-law continuum modified by an intervening 21-cm absorption, testing two scenarios: an island model, a residual cold neutral Hydrogen patch surviving at the end of reionization, and a global model, approximating the overall decline of the IGM HI fraction and spin temperature with redshift. Combining archival data spanning 150 MHz to 3.0 GHz with our measurements, we determined a quasar flux density of $86.8 \pm 1.1$ mJy at 200 MHz and a spectral index of $-0.88 \pm 0.02$ across the full frequency range. We found no evidence for the 21-cm absorption from intervening neutral Hydrogen at $5.38<z<5.84$. Assuming the island model, we set a 95% confidence lower limit on the IGM spin temperature of $1.73$ K in residual HI regions. Assuming the global model, we constrained the 21-cm optical depth to $τ_{21}< 0.02$ (95% C.L.). These results provide constraints on the 21-cm optical depth near the end of reionization, over the $5.38 < z < 5.84$ range, and confirm that the IGM was heated above the adiabatic cooling limit ($\sim 0.8$ K at $z = 5.68$), consistent with theoretical predictions and with 21-cm power spectrum measurements at higher redshifts. Our results also disfavour the presence of extremely cold HI regions at $z < 5.84$ and open the way to future 21-cm absorption from high-redshift sources.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 24 figures, 11 tables. Submitted to Astronomy & Astrophysics (A&A)

analysis.title_zh: 21 厘米森林的迅速兴起 I：5.38 < z < 5.84 星际际介质光学深度的约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 z=5.84 射电亮类星体 PSO J352.4034-15.3373 的 203-222.5 MHz 观测，搜寻再电离末期介入 IGM 中性氢造成的红移 21 cm 吸收。摘要报告未发现 5.38<z<5.84 的吸收证据，并在两种模型下分别给出 IGM 自旋温度下限和 21 cm 光学深度上限，认为结果不支持 z<5.84 存在极冷 HI 区域。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 21 cm 吸收和 21 cm 功率谱是研究再电离与早期 IGM 热史的重要互补探针；这些热史和电离史会影响 CMB 的再电离光学深度解释及早期结构形成图景。虽然该工作不是 CMB 观测本身，但它为 CMB 再电离约束提供低红移端的独立物理检验。
key_points: 利用高红移射电类星体背景源搜寻 21 cm 吸收。
在 5.38<z<5.84 未发现介入中性氢的 21 cm 吸收证据。
给出了 IGM 自旋温度下限和 21 cm 光学深度上限，指向再电离末期 IGM 已被加热。
methods: 对射电亮类星体 PSO J352.4034-15.3373 的 18 小时观测
203-222.5 MHz 频段的红移 21 cm 吸收分析
连续谱成像与频谱提取
幂律连续谱加介入 21 cm 吸收模型拟合
island model 与 global model 两种情景测试
结合 150 MHz 至 3.0 GHz 的 archival data
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对前景连续谱拟合、频率相关系统误差、RFI/校准处理以及 island/global 模型如何把未探测转化为自旋温度和光学深度限制。

papers.title: Beyond $j=1$: Observational Constraints on Almost-$Λ$CDM Cosmologies
papers.abstract: The cosmographic condition $j(z)=1$ provides the kinematical signature of the spatially flat $Λ$CDM model independently of any specific dark-energy or modified-gravity theory. We investigate the extent to which current observations permit departures from this condition by considering three phenomenological ``almost-$Λ$CDM'' cosmographic closures, in which the cosmic jerk differs slightly from unity through a small deformation parameter $ε$. The models are constrained using Markov Chain Monte Carlo analyses of recent DESI baryon acoustic oscillation measurements together with compressed Planck cosmic microwave background likelihoods and the Union3, Pantheon+, and DESY5 Type Ia supernova compilations. Rather than assuming a parameterized dark-energy equation of state, our cosmographic framework reconstructs the expansion history directly from observations, with the effective dark-energy equation of state emerging as a derived quantity. We find that all three closures are tightly constrained to the vicinity of the $Λ$CDM cosmographic fixed point, with Planck data driving the preferred evolution toward $j_0\simeq1$ and $w_{\rm DE,0}\simeq-1$. Despite their distinct kinematical constructions, the reconstructed dark-energy evolution consistently exhibits smooth freezing behaviour close to $w=-1$, without crossing the phantom divide. Model comparison using the Akaike and Bayesian information criteria shows that the almost-$Λ$CDM models remain statistically competitive with standard dark-energy parameterizations while requiring fewer assumptions about the functional form of $w(z)$. These results demonstrate the power of model-independent cosmography for constraining the cosmic expansion history and provide a natural framework for future studies of cosmological perturbations and structure formation.

analysis.title_zh: 超越 j=1：对近似 ΛCDM 宇宙学的观测约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究当前观测是否允许宇宙 jerk 条件 j(z)=1 偏离平直 ΛCDM，引入三个带小形变参数 ε 的 almost-ΛCDM 宇宙志闭合，并用 DESI BAO、压缩 Planck CMB 似然和多个 Ia 超新星样本进行 MCMC 约束。摘要报告三种模型都被限制在接近 ΛCDM 的区域，Planck 数据推动 j0≈1、wDE,0≈-1，重构暗能量呈接近 w=-1 的平滑冻结行为。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文直接使用压缩 Planck CMB 似然并讨论 ΛCDM 背景膨胀的运动学检验，因此与 CMB 推断的标准宇宙学框架密切相关。对 CMB 读者而言，关键在于它把 CMB、BAO 和超新星联合用于检验是否需要超出 ΛCDM 的背景演化，而不先指定 w(z) 的具体参数化。
key_points: 以 j(z)=1 作为平直 ΛCDM 的运动学标志。
用 DESI BAO、压缩 Planck CMB 似然和多个 Ia 超新星样本约束 almost-ΛCDM 宇宙志模型。
摘要称三种闭合形式均被限制在接近 ΛCDM 固定点，暗能量演化接近 w=-1 且不跨越 phantom divide。
methods: 宇宙志 cosmographic closures，引入小形变参数 ε 使 jerk 偏离 1
Markov Chain Monte Carlo 分析
DESI BAO 测量
压缩 Planck CMB likelihoods
Union3、Pantheon+、DESY5 Ia 型超新星汇编
Akaike 与 Bayesian 信息准则模型比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对三种 cosmographic closure 的定义、压缩 Planck 似然包含的信息量、先验对 ε 和重构 wDE 的影响，以及 AIC/BIC 比较是否在相同数据与参数计数下进行。

papers.title: Monopoles, Strings, Walls and Gravitational waves
papers.abstract: The gauge symmetry breaking $SU(2) \to U(1) \to Z_2 \to 1$ successively produces monopoles, strings and domain walls bounded by strings (WBS), with the elementary monopole carrying a $U(1)$ magnetic flux twice as large as the elementary string. The elementary strings and subsequently WBS emit gravitational waves, and during their decay, the WBS yield a network of composite strings that carry the same $U(1)$ flux as the monopoles. Depending on the cosmological evolution, we provide the gravitational wave spectra generated by the elementary strings and WBS, in combination with the composite strings which are either effectively stable, quasistable, or metastable. These three scenarios are also realized in the symmetry breaking chain $SU(3) \to SO(3) \to Z_2 \to 1$. Both $SU(2)$ and $SU(3)$ have appeared in the literature as flavor gauge symmetries.

analysis.title_zh: 单极子、弦、畴壁与引力波
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究规范对称性逐级破缺 SU(2) → U(1) → Z2 → 1 中依次生成的单极子、宇宙弦和由弦束缚的畴壁，并讨论这些缺陷及其衰变产生的复合弦所辐射的引力波谱。摘要还指出类似的三类复合弦稳定性情景也可在 SU(3) → SO(3) → Z2 → 1 破缺链中实现。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇宙弦、畴壁等早期宇宙拓扑缺陷不仅能产生随机引力波背景，也可能影响 CMB 各向异性和偏振约束。对 CMB 研究者而言，这类模型的重要性在于它把粒子物理相变历史与可观测的引力波和潜在 CMB 缺陷信号联系起来。
key_points: SU(2) 或 SU(3) 分步破缺可依次产生单极子、弦和由弦束缚的畴壁。
摘要给出由基本弦、WBS 以及复合弦共同产生的引力波谱情景。
复合弦可分别处于有效稳定、准稳定或亚稳定三类演化。
methods: 规范对称性破缺链 SU(2) → U(1) → Z2 → 1
规范对称性破缺链 SU(3) → SO(3) → Z2 → 1
拓扑缺陷网络的宇宙学演化情景分类
引力波谱计算

papers.title: Interacting Dark Energy and Dark Matter in O(3) No-Scale Gravity
papers.abstract: Dark Energy (DE) and Dark Matter (DM) are among the greatest mysteries in particle physics and cosmology, since their origins remain unclear. It is intriguing to consider whether both may originate from a purely gravitational sector. We propose that they arise from degrees of freedom associated with the partners of the Brans-Dicke boson in No-Scale Gravity, a fundamental scale-invariant gravitational theory in which the Planck scale is illusional. We consider the Brans-Dicke boson, together with two scalar fields, to form a vector multiplet under an $O(3)$ symmetry, whose angular directions in the Einstein frame are identified with DM and DE. Small explicit breaking of $O(3)$ generates their masses and interaction, and we show that the resulting model reproduces the required background cosmological evolution and present-day abundances, with the lighter field providing a dynamical DE component at late times. Although the DE field remains canonical, the interacting cosmology exhibits an effective phantom-like evolution at late times, of the type suggested by DESI in combination with other cosmological probes, without introducing a fundamental phantom degree of freedom. The model provides a first-principles realization of interacting DE, in which DM, DE, and their coupling emerge from the symmetry structure of the underlying gravitational theory.

analysis.title_zh: O(3) No-Scale 引力中的相互作用暗能量与暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出暗物质和暗能量可源自 No-Scale Gravity 中 Brans-Dicke 玻色子伙伴的自由度，并通过 O(3) 对称性及其小显式破缺生成质量和相互作用。摘要称该模型可再现所需背景宇宙学演化和当前丰度，且在不引入基本 phantom 自由度的情况下表现出晚期有效 phantom-like 演化。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质-暗能量相互作用会改变晚期膨胀史、距离尺度和结构增长，从而影响 CMB 与 BAO、超新星、DESI 等数据的联合解释。若该模型要用于宇宙学参数推断，必须检验其是否保持与 CMB 约束的早期宇宙物理一致。
key_points: 暗物质和暗能量被建模为 No-Scale Gravity 中 Brans-Dicke 伙伴自由度的角向模式。
小的 O(3) 显式破缺产生质量和相互作用。
模型在背景层面复现所需宇宙学演化和当前丰度，并出现有效 phantom-like 晚期行为。
methods: O(3) No-Scale Gravity 理论构造
Einstein frame 中的标量场角向自由度识别
O(3) 对称性的显式小破缺
背景宇宙学演化与当今丰度检验
与 DESI 及其他宇宙学探针提示的晚期演化作定性联系
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对背景演化的拟合范围、与 CMB 声学尺度和早期宇宙约束是否兼容、暗物质-暗能量相互作用形式是否稳定，以及所谓有效 phantom-like 行为是否只在背景层面成立。

papers.title: Can cosmic voids ease the Hubble tension? Local expansion in $w_0w_a$CDM
papers.abstract: We investigate the effect of local cosmic voids on low-redshift measurements of the Hubble rate in flat $w_0w_a$CDM cosmologies. Using a hydrodynamical model for isolated spherical inverse top-hat underdensities, we compute the void-induced Hubble shift as a function of redshift, enclosed density contrast $δ_{\rm E}$ and cosmological parameters. We find that the effect is mainly controlled by the matter sector, through $δ_{\rm E}$ and $Ω_{\rm m,0}$, while dynamical dark energy gives only subdominant late-time corrections. For a Planck-calibrated $Λ$CDM background, matching the SH0ES value requires a present-day void with $δ_{\rm E}(z=0)\simeq -0.44$, substantially deeper than the KBC-like local underdensity. A KBC-like void lowers the SH0ES-Planck discrepancy to about $2σ$, but is not deep enough to fully reconcile the two measurements. Allowing for dynamical dark energy, including regions motivated by recent DES and DESI analyses, changes this result only at the percent level. We also show that the reported redshift dependence of locally inferred $H_0$ values can be represented phenomenologically by an effective enclosed matter profile. This reconstruction should be interpreted as a consistency test of local-structure effects rather than as explanation for an evolving background value of $H_0$. Overall, local underdensities can affect low-redshift Hubble-rate inferences, but they do not resolve the Hubble tension within the spherical void setup considered here.

analysis.title_zh: 宇宙空洞能缓解 Hubble 张力吗？w0waCDM 中的局域膨胀
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在平直 w0waCDM 框架下，用孤立球形 inverse top-hat 欠密区的流体动力学模型计算局域空洞对低红移 Hubble 率推断的偏移。摘要报告称 KBC-like 空洞可把 SH0ES-Planck 差异降至约 2σ 但不足以完全调和，动力学暗能量只造成百分比量级修正，因此该球形空洞设定不能解决 Hubble 张力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: Hubble 张力直接涉及 CMB 推断的早期宇宙 H0 与低红移距离梯测量之间的不一致。该论文检验局域结构系统效应是否能解释差异，对判断是否需要修改早期宇宙物理、暗能量模型或观测系统误差很有参考价值。
key_points: 论文量化了球形局域空洞对低红移 Hubble 率测量的影响。
在 Planck 标定的 ΛCDM 背景下，匹配 SH0ES 需要比 KBC-like 更深的当前空洞。
动力学暗能量，包括 DES/DESI 启发区域，只带来百分比量级修正，不能在该球形空洞框架内解决 Hubble 张力。
methods: 平直 w0waCDM 宇宙学
孤立球形 inverse top-hat 欠密区的流体动力学模型
void-induced Hubble shift 随红移、包围密度反差和宇宙学参数的计算
Planck 标定 ΛCDM 背景
与 SH0ES、KBC-like 局域欠密、DES 和 DESI 动机区域比较
用有效包围物质分布表征局域推断 H0 的红移依赖
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对球形孤立空洞和 inverse top-hat 模型假设是否足以代表真实局域结构，以及 Hubble shift 的定义、SH0ES/Planck 比较方式和约 2σ 缓解结论对数据选择的敏感性。

papers.title: Modeling the HI-Halo Connection: Evolution, Scatter, and a Halo-based Prescription for 21-cm Mock Catalogs
papers.abstract: The redshifted 21-cm line of neutral hydrogen (HI) is a powerful tracer of large-scale structure, and post-reionization HI intensity mapping is emerging as a competitive cosmological probe whose interpretation requires a description of how HI populates galaxies and dark matter halos. We characterize the HI--halo mass relation, its redshift evolution, and its intrinsic scatter, identifying its secondary dependences. We use the updated GAlaxy Evolution and Assembly (GAEA) semi-analytic model, applied to the Millennium-I and Millennium-II simulations, to predict the HI mass function (HIMF) and the HI--halo mass relation from the present day to redshift $z\simeq5$. At $z=0$, the model reproduces the observed HIMF and its decomposition by host-halo mass. The median HI--halo mass relation rises with halo mass, peaks near $10^{11.7}\,M_\odot$, declines as central galaxies are quenched by feedback from active galactic nuclei, and rises again where satellites dominate, approaching a single power law at high redshift. We show that the substantial scatter, of about 0.5 dex, is not random but is governed by halo assembly: at fixed mass, higher-spin, later-forming, and less-concentrated halos are systematically HI-richer, with spin together with either concentration or formation time accounting for part of this scatter and leaving an intrinsic dispersion of about 0.3 dex. We encode the median relation, these secondary trends, and the intrinsic scatter in a compact, physically motivated prescription expressed entirely in terms of quantities available in dark-matter halo catalogs. This prescription reproduces the full scatter and enables the construction of large-volume 21-cm mock catalogs for interpreting ongoing intensity-mapping measurements with SKA precursor facilities, such as MeerKAT, and for preparing for forthcoming surveys with the SKA.

analysis.title_zh: 建模 HI–暗物质晕联系：演化、散布，以及用于 21 cm 模拟目录的基于晕的处方
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究再电离后中性氢如何占据星系和暗物质晕，以便解释 21 cm 强度映射。作者用更新的 GAEA 半解析模型和 Millennium-I/II 模拟刻画 HI–晕质量关系、红移演化与散布，并将中位关系、次级依赖和内禀散布编码成可用于暗物质晕目录的 21 cm mock 处方。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 21 cm 强度映射是大尺度结构和宇宙学参数测量的重要途径，可与 CMB 透镜、星系巡天等进行互相关；其系统误差很大程度取决于 HI 偏置和 HI–晕占据模型。该文提供的 mock catalog 处方可帮助解释 MeerKAT、SKA 先导及未来 SKA 的强度映射数据。
key_points: 用更新的 GAEA 半解析模型结合 Millennium-I/II 模拟研究 HI 与暗物质晕的关系。
摘要称 HI–晕质量关系存在约 0.5 dex 散布，并与自旋、形成时间、浓度等晕装配性质相关。
给出仅依赖暗物质晕目录量的处方，用于生成 21 cm mock catalog。
methods: GAEA 半解析星系形成模型
Millennium-I 和 Millennium-II 暗物质模拟
HI 质量函数与 HI–halo 质量关系预测
基于暗物质晕目录量的经验/物理动机处方
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其 HI–晕处方的适用红移、晕质量范围、对卫星/中心星系分解的处理，以及该处方在不同模拟体积和分辨率下是否稳健。

papers.title: Galactic Science with the LiteBIRD satellite: Spectral characterization of diffuse Galactic polarized emission at the angular power spectrum level
papers.abstract: Detection of primordial $B$-mode polarization in the cosmic microwave background (CMB) from tensor perturbations generated during inflation is a major scientific goal of future CMB missions. Its success will strongly depend on the characterization of polarized foregrounds, a challenge that the LiteBIRD satellite aims to tackle with its 15 frequency bands ranging from 40 to 402 GHz. In this work, we forecast the ability of LiteBIRD to characterize polarized dust and synchrotron emission in the diffuse interstellar medium (ISM), at the angular power spectrum level. From simulated LiteBIRD intensity and polarization maps with different foreground complexities, we compute cross-frequency angular power spectra and fit them to dust and synchrotron spectral energy distributions, which are modeled by a modified black body and a power law, respectively. We find that LiteBIRD will be able to measure the dust temperature, dust and synchrotron spectral indices and spatial correlation with dispersions as low as $σ(T_{\rm d})\sim0.2$ K, $σ(β_{\rm d})\sim0.006$, $σ(β_{\rm s})\sim0.04$ and $σ(ρ)\sim10^{-2}$, as well as to detect and quantify deviations from the proposed parametric model due to variations of the emission properties in the three dimensions of our Galaxy. Additionally, LiteBIRD is likely to rule out the power-law model of polarized foreground angular power spectra suggested by Planck data. It will also be able to detect differences in the values of $β_{\rm d}$, $T_{\rm d}$, and $β_{\rm s}$ between $E$ modes, $B$ modes, and intensity in the diffuse ISM for the first time, highlighting the joint variations of the physical conditions and the magnetic field structure across the Galaxy. We conclude that in addition to detailed studies of CMB polarization, LiteBIRD will open a new window onto the physical conditions governing the ISM of the Milky Way.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 19 figures. Prepared for submission to JCAP

analysis.title_zh: LiteBIRD 卫星的银河科学：在角功率谱层面对弥散银河偏振辐射进行光谱表征
analysis.summary_zh: 本文评估 LiteBIRD 在角功率谱层面对银河弥散偏振前景进行光谱表征的能力，这直接服务于原初 CMB B 模探测。作者用不同复杂度的 LiteBIRD 模拟图计算跨频角功率谱，并用尘埃修正黑体和同步辐射幂律模型拟合；摘要称 LiteBIRD 可高精度约束尘埃温度、尘埃和同步辐射谱指数及空间相关，并可探测偏离简单参数模型的效应。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初 B 模搜寻受银河偏振尘埃和同步辐射前景限制，LiteBIRD 的多频覆盖正是为前景分离和系统检验设计的。该文的结果关系到未来 CMB 偏振分析中前景模型、E/B 模差异、频率去相关和参数化假设的可靠性，因此与 CMB 研究高度相关。

使用模拟的强度与偏振图，计算跨频角功率谱，并拟合修正黑体尘埃谱和幂律同步辐射谱。
摘要报告 LiteBIRD 可测量前景谱参数与空间相关，并可能检验 Planck 所提示的偏振前景角功率谱幂律模型。

跨频角功率谱

papers.title: Constraints on the VHE counterpart of two binary black hole mergers observed by the MAGIC and CTAO LST-1 telescopes
papers.abstract: We present very-high-energy gamma-ray observations of two binary black hole merger candidates, GW240615_113620 and GW241125_010116, performed with the Major Atmospheric Gamma Imaging Cherenkov (MAGIC) telescopes and the first Large-Sized Telescope of the Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory's (CTAO LST-1). GW240615_113620 was the best localized event of the fourth observing run of the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA gravitational waves interferometers. GW241125_010116 was temporally and spatially coincident with a sub-threshold short-duration burst detected with the Swift-Burst Alert Telescope (BAT), the Swift-X-Ray Telescope (XRT) and the Einstein Probe Follow-up X-ray Telescope (FXT). We observed the two events in stereoscopic mode, taking advantage of the improved sensitivity of joint MAGIC+LST-1 observations. No detection was achieved in the GeV-TeV gamma-ray band for any of the two sources. The unfavourable observing conditions of both events posed a challenge for a standard analysis and therefore a non standard analysis was necessary for both objects. Owing to the small localization area and the association with a GRB-like burst respectively, these events represented an unprecedented opportunity to study in details the electromagnetic emission from binary black holes merger events and, in particular, we discussed two theoretical models that predict a detectable gamma-ray emission and the possible future applications.
papers.comment: Published version. Corresponding authors: Andrea Simongini, Juan Jiménez Quiles, Mario Pecimotika, Monica Seglar-Arroyo

papers.title: Ringing of the Reionization: A first direct measurement of the intergalactic pressure smoothing scale at redshift z>4.2 as imprinted onto small-scale peculiar velocities in the Lyman-alpha forest
papers.abstract: The epoch of reionization leaves detectable imprints in the thermal history of the Universe. In particular, the fast ionization fronts passing over cold gas in the cosmic web overpressurize the gas, leading to the well-established phenomenon of pressure smoothing due to the hydrodynamic response of the gas. Although the effect has been indirectly measured from the power spectra of the Lyman-$α$ forest over the past decades, very few examples exist of directly measuring the typical scale associated with this physical process. This work identifies an acoustic feature in the power spectrum of the projected peculiar velocity gradient $η$. Using toy models and linear theory, this work shows that the acoustic feature is likely strongly associated with the pressure smoothing scale. A feature at the same scale is imprinted on the small-scale flux power spectrum of the Lyman-$α$ forest at $k=0.1-1\;\mathrm{s/km}$. A methodology developed for the simulations is applied to the latest measurements of the flux power spectra at $z=4.2-5.0$ to provide the first direct measurements of the pressure smoothing scale at high redshifts, $λ_p(z=4.2) > 33.78\;\mathrm{ckpc}\;(1σ)$, $λ_p(z=4.6) = 32.36\pm8.35\;\mathrm{ckpc}$ and $λ_p(z=5.0)=31.27\pm18.28\;\mathrm{ckpc}$. This proof-of-concept study paves the way for future observational programs aimed at recovering the thermal history using small-scale observations of the Lyman-$α$ forest.

analysis.title_zh: 再电离的振铃：在 z>4.2 红移处星系际压力平滑尺度的首次直接测量，其印迹来自 Lyman-alpha 森林中的小尺度本动速度
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究再电离后冷气体受快速电离前沿加热而产生的压力平滑如何印刻在 Lyman-alpha 森林的小尺度速度和通量统计中。摘要称作者用玩具模型、线性理论和模拟方法识别出与压力平滑尺度相关的声学特征，并将方法用于 z=4.2-5.0 的通量功率谱测量，给出高红移压力平滑尺度的直接测量。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 再电离热历史会影响小尺度物质和气体分布，从而影响 Lyman-alpha 森林对早期宇宙的约束。对 CMB 研究者而言，这类测量可作为 CMB 再电离光学深度约束的低红移互补信息，帮助区分再电离时间、持续时间和加热历史。
key_points: 在 Lyman-alpha 森林的小尺度通量功率谱中寻找与压力平滑尺度相关的声学特征。
摘要称在 z=4.2-5.0 的最新通量功率谱测量上给出高红移压力平滑尺度的直接测量。
该研究被定位为利用小尺度 Lyman-alpha 观测恢复再电离热历史的概念验证。

papers.title: QCD CP-violation scenario for a revised cosmological dynamics: analysis of the binned Pantheon Sample of Super Novae Ia
papers.abstract: We investigate a modified cosmological dynamics in which the Universe is composed of baryonic matter and a complex (classical) scalar field. The phase component of this field is identified with the axion field, which accounts for the dark matter contribution, while its modulus follows a $λφ^4$-like theory, associated with a dominant constant energy density and describing the dark energy component of the Universe. When the potential term of this complex scalar field is studied near its maximum, it naturally provides an interaction term between dark matter and dark energy. The cosmological model that emerges from this physical framework leads to a modified $Λ$CDM dynamics, in which the dark matter contribution is slightly and monotonically suppressed. We then construct the effective running Hubble constant associated with this revised cosmological scenario and we compare this diagnostic tool with the binned data of the Pantheon Sample of Type Ia Supernovae. As a result of the fitting procedure, we are able to provide a satisfactory interpretation of the data in terms of our theoretical conjecture that results statistically favored with respect to the $Λ$CDM model.

analysis.title_zh: 用于修正宇宙学动力学的 QCD CP 破缺情景：Pantheon Ia 型超新星分箱样本分析
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出一种受 QCD CP 破缺/轴子图景启发的修正宇宙学模型，其中复标量场相位充当暗物质、模量充当暗能量，并自然引入暗物质-暗能量相互作用。作者构造有效 running Hubble constant，并用 Pantheon Ia 超新星分箱样本进行拟合，摘要称该理论相对于 ΛCDM 得到统计偏好。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作涉及暗物质、暗能量及其相互作用，会直接改变背景膨胀史，因此与 CMB 推断的 ΛCDM 参数和 Hubble 张力讨论相关。不过摘要只提到超新星数据，尚不能判断其是否与 CMB 声学峰、早期宇宙物理和结构形成约束相容。
key_points: 提出由重子物质和复经典标量场组成的修正宇宙学动力学。
场的相位被解释为轴子暗物质，模量对应暗能量，并在势能极大值附近产生暗物质-暗能量相互作用。
摘要称用 Pantheon Ia 超新星分箱数据拟合后，相对于 ΛCDM 在统计上更受支持。
methods: 复经典标量场宇宙学模型
λφ^4 类势能

papers.title: From Dark Matter to Galaxies: Halo-Free Mock Generation via Conditional Point-Cloud Diffusion
papers.abstract: We present a diffusion-based generative model for constructing realistic galaxy catalogues from dark matter density fields. The model takes a three-dimensional dark matter density field as input and generates galaxies directly as a point cloud with positions and physical properties, including star formation rate (SFR), without identifying dark matter haloes or subhaloes. We train the model on galaxy catalogues from the IllustrisTNG hydrodynamical simulation. The generated catalogues reproduce the spatial correspondence between galaxies and the underlying dark matter field, preferentially populating dense regions and filamentary structures. They also accurately reproduce the one- and two-dimensional distributions of SFR and stellar mass, the galaxy auto-power spectrum, and the galaxy--dark matter cross-power spectrum. The model generates galaxies associated with structures below the nominal resolution of the input density field by marginalising over unresolved small-scale structure rather than relying on a resolved halo catalogue. With an optimised diffusion sampling schedule, it generates a catalogue with SFR $> 1 ~\rm M_\odot/yr$ over a $(151.3 ~\rm Mpc)^3$ volume in approximately 10 seconds on a single GPU. Our model therefore provides a practical engine for producing large mock ensembles for upcoming galaxy redshift surveys and line-intensity mapping experiments, and offers a path toward simulation-based inference that bypasses halo finding and directly connects field-level dark matter statistics to observable galaxy populations.

analysis.title_zh: 从暗物质到星系：通过条件点云扩散实现无晕 mock 生成
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出一种扩散生成模型，以三维暗物质密度场为条件，直接以点云形式生成带有位置和物理属性的星系目录，而不经过晕或子晕识别。摘要称该模型在 IllustrisTNG 上训练后，可复现星系分布、SFR/恒星质量统计、星系自功率谱和星系-暗物质交叉功率谱，并能快速生成大体积 mock。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 未来星系红移巡天和线强度映射需要大量 mock 来建模选择效应、协方差和非线性偏置；这些低红移大尺度结构数据常与 CMB 联合约束宇宙学参数、暗物质性质和结构增长。该方法若稳健，可改进 CMB 透镜、星系巡天和强度映射交叉相关分析中的模拟支撑。
key_points: 提出条件点云扩散模型，从三维暗物质密度场直接生成星系目录。
不需要识别暗物质晕或子晕，输出星系位置及恒星形成率等物理属性。
在 IllustrisTNG 训练后，摘要称能复现星系统计量以及星系-暗物质交叉功率谱，并可快速生成 mock 目录。

papers.title: Accurate parameter inference for the Light-cone Epoch of Reionization 21-cm signal
papers.abstract: The light-cone (LC) effect introduces line-of-sight (LoS) statistical inhomogeneity into the 21-cm signal. Consequently, the traditional power spectrum (PS) fails to capture the full two-point statistical information. The evolving power spectrum (ePS), $P_e(k, z)$, offers an alternative that accounts for this LoS evolution. We compare the statistical power of three different summary statistics: the standard cylindrical PS $P(k_\perp,k_\parallel)$, slice-wise PS $P_s(k, z)$ (3D PS for small bandwidth LC slices), and ePS $P_e(k, z)$. We first demonstrate that $P_e(k,z)$ successfully recovers the benchmark 3D PS of coeval simulations across most $k$ and $z$, whereas the slice-wise PS recovers only at large $k$. To efficiently perform parameter inference, we train artificial neural network (ANN) emulators on $500$ LC 21-cm signals. Our forecasts incorporate cosmic variance, estimated using $50$ statistically independent realizations of the signal, alongside SKA-Low system noise for integration times of $1000$ and $104$ hrs. We find that ePS outperforms its peers, yielding $3$ and $1.4$ times tighter constraints than $P(k_\perp,k_\parallel)$ and $P_s(k,z)$, respectively. Our results establish the ePS as an optimal summary statistic for interpreting forthcoming data.

analysis.title_zh: 光锥再电离时期 21-cm 信号的精确参数推断
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对再电离时期 21-cm 光锥效应造成的视线方向统计非均匀性，比较标准柱状功率谱、逐切片功率谱和演化功率谱 ePS 在参数推断中的表现。摘要报告 ePS 在多数 k 和 z 上能较好恢复共时模拟的基准 3D 功率谱，并在含 cosmic variance 与 SKA-Low 噪声的预报中给出更紧的参数约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 再电离 21-cm 观测与 CMB 的大尺度偏振光学深度、再电离历史和早期结构形成约束互补。若 ePS 确实能更充分利用光锥 21-cm 的两点统计信息，它将有助于把未来 SKA-Low 观测转化为对再电离模型和宇宙学参数的更强约束。
key_points: 研究再电离 21-cm 光锥效应导致的视线方向统计非均匀性。
比较标准柱状功率谱、逐切片功率谱和演化功率谱三类摘要统计量。
摘要称 ePS 给出的参数约束优于另外两种统计量，并适合解释未来数据。

papers.title: Constraining Effective Viscosity in the Intracluster Medium via the Thermal Sunyaev-Zeldovich Effect -- Predictions from the SLOW Constrained Coma Cluster Simulations
papers.abstract: We study the effect of viscosity on the Sunyaev-Zeldovich signal in a simulated constrained Coma cluster analog. We aim to provide alternative constraints on the amount of viscosity in the ICM. We use the Coma cluster realization with different levels of viscosity from the LOWER DECKS zoom-ins of the SLOW constrained simulations. We generate mock thermal and kinetic Sunyaev-Zeldovich maps and and analyze their statistics. We compare them to Planck observations. Viscosity shows a consistent trend in thermal SZ (tSZ) profiles, increasing the signal in the center and suppressing it in the outskirts. Viscosity also has a strong effect on the tSZ power spectrum, elevating its amplitude on all scales. Comparisons with Planck observations suggest that the effective ICM viscosity is below $5\%$ of the Spitzer value. Unsharp masking reveals an effect on small scales, which are, however, not yet detectable with current observational data. The thermal Sunyaev-Zeldovich effect shows clear and consistent trends that allow us to probe the effective viscosity of the ICM. Our analysis suggests suppressed ICM viscosity below $5\%$ of the Spitzer value, consistent with previous X-ray analysis. Our results validate the strength of the SZ effect as an independent method to constrain ICM viscosity.

analysis.title_zh: 通过热 Sunyaev-Zeldovich 效应约束星系团内介质的有效黏滞性：来自 SLOW 受约束 Coma 星系团模拟的预言
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 SLOW 受约束模拟中的 Coma 星系团类似体，在不同 ICM 黏滞性设定下生成热和动 Sunyaev-Zeldovich mock 图并分析统计量。摘要报告黏滞性会增强中心 tSZ、压低外围 tSZ，并提高 tSZ 功率谱振幅；与 Planck 比较后认为有效 ICM 黏滞性低于 Spitzer 值的 5%。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: SZ 效应是 CMB 光子经过星系团热电子和运动气体后产生的关键次级各向异性，直接影响 CMB 星系团宇宙学和小尺度前景建模。理解 ICM 黏滞性如何改变 tSZ/kSZ 形态和功率谱，有助于改进星系团气体物理模型，并降低利用 SZ 样本进行宇宙学推断时的系统误差。
key_points: 用受约束的 Coma 星系团模拟研究 ICM 黏滞性对 SZ 信号的影响。
生成 mock tSZ 和 kSZ 图，并与 Planck 观测比较。
摘要称 tSZ 剖面和功率谱对黏滞性有清晰趋势，并指向低于 Spitzer 值 5% 的有效黏滞性。
methods: SLOW constrained simulations 的 LOWER DECKS zoom-in Coma 星系团实现

papers.title: Dynamical Test of Cosmic Acceleration: $k$-nearest Neighbor Cross Correlation of Cosmic Microwave Background and Cosmic Infrared Background
papers.abstract: The physical origin of cosmic acceleration remains one of the central questions in modern cosmology. The integrated Sachs-Wolfe (ISW) and Rees-Sciama (RS) effects, which arise from the evolution of gravitational potentials, provide a dynamical test of cosmic acceleration. We measure the cross correlation between the Planck temperature map of the cosmic microwave background (CMB) and a foreground-free map of the $100\,μ\mathrm{m}$ cosmic infrared background (CIB) from Y.-K. Chiang (2023), using the $k$-nearest neighbor cumulative distribution function ($k$NN-CDF). As the CIB map is reconstructed from ${\sim}600$ million Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer galaxies extending to $z\approx2.5$, the measurement is equivalent to a galaxy-CMB cross correlation. We find evidence for a positive cross correlation, rejecting the null hypothesis of no correlation at $p=0.02~(2.3σ)$ using the $χ^2$ test. We further quantify its amplitude with $A_{k\mathrm{NN}}$, defined relative to an assumed cosmological model, and obtain $A_{k\mathrm{NN}}=0.95\pm0.20~(4.8σ)$ with respect to $Λ\mathrm{CDM}$ mock data including the ISW and RS effects. The $k$NN-CDF analysis improves the detection significance by ${\sim}20\%$ over the two-point correlation function. We also explore evolving dark energy by constructing two tomographic maps from the full CIB map; the results are consistent with $Λ$CDM. Finer tomographic reconstruction of the CIB, for example from multiband data of SPHEREx, would further tighten constraints on evolving dark energy.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in ApJ. 25 pages, 23 figures

analysis.title_zh: 宇宙加速的动力学检验：宇宙微波背景与宇宙红外背景的 k 近邻互相关
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 kNN-CDF 测量 Planck CMB 温度图与去前景 100 μm CIB 图的互相关，以 ISW/RS 效应作为宇宙加速的动力学检验。摘要报告存在正互相关证据，给出相对 ΛCDM mock 的 A_kNN=0.95±0.20，并称层析 CIB 结果与 ΛCDM 一致。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: ISW/RS 信号直接关联晚期引力势演化，是 CMB 与大尺度结构交叉相关中检验暗能量和引力增长史的重要通道。若 kNN-CDF 确实比传统二点统计更有效，它可能为未来 CIB/星系巡天与 CMB 的交叉分析提供更高灵敏度的非传统统计量。

papers.title: Probing the matter-dominated expansion with multi-redshift Lyman-$α$ BAO from DESI DR2
papers.abstract: We present a multi-redshift Baryon Acoustic Oscillations (BAO) analysis of the DESI Data Release 2 (DR2) Lyman-$α$ (Ly$α$) forest, splitting the forest auto-correlation and its cross-correlation with quasars into three redshift bins. We obtain BAO measurements at effective redshifts $z_{\rm eff} = 2.13$, $2.40$, and $2.81$ with $\sim2.0$--$2.5\%$ precision per bin in the radial and transverse directions, corresponding to $\sim1.1$--$1.2\%$ precision for the isotropic BAO measurement. Using the same data products and modeling framework as the DESI DR2 Ly$α$ BAO analysis, we validate the pipeline on $400$ synthetic datasets and find unbiased BAO recovery with well-calibrated uncertainties. The measurements show an increase in the isotropic dilation parameter $D_V/r_d$ from $30.26\pm0.39$ to $32.22\pm0.47$ and in the Alcock-Paczyński parameter $D_M/D_H$ from $3.96\pm0.15$ to $5.63^{+0.22}_{-0.24}$. The Hubble distance $D_H/r_d$ decreases from $9.40\pm0.20$ to $7.22\pm0.17$, providing a direct measurement of the expansion history consistent with $Λ$CDM and the expected matter-dominated scaling, with $H(z)\propto(1+z)^n$ giving $n=1.34\pm0.16$. The redshift split also provides a self-consistent measurement of clustering evolution: the Ly$α$ forest bias evolves as $(1+z)^γ$ with $γ_α=3.05\pm0.16$, the RSD parameter has a redshift evolution described by $γ_β=-0.97\pm0.26$, and the quasar bias evolves with $γ_Q=1.56\pm0.23$, consistent with independent quasar clustering measurements. Combining these three-bin BAO measurements with DESI DR2 galaxy and quasar BAO measurements yields cosmological constraints consistent with the single-bin Ly$α$ BAO analysis in flat $Λ$CDM and $w_0w_a$CDM and improves curvature constraints by $\sim12\%$ in $Λ$CDM$+Ω_\mathrm{K}$.

analysis.title_zh: 用 DESI DR2 多红移 Lyman-α BAO 探测物质主导时期的宇宙膨胀
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 DESI DR2 的 Lyα 森林自相关及其与类星体互相关，在三个红移 bin 中测量 BAO，以直接刻画高红移物质主导时期的膨胀历史。摘要报告管线在 400 个合成数据集上验证为无偏，测得的距离量、Alcock-Paczyński 参数和 Hubble 距离演化与 ΛCDM 及物质主导标度一致，并在与 DESI DR2 其他 BAO 数据联合时改善曲率约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接服务于后复合时代距离-红移关系的精密测量，是 CMB 约束 ΛCDM 后向低红移和高红移结构巡天外推的重要交叉检验。Lyα BAO 位于 CMB 与低红移星系 BAO 之间的关键红移区间，可帮助检验早期宇宙给定声学标尺后的膨胀史、曲率和暗能量参数化是否自洽。
key_points: 将 DESI DR2 Lyα 森林自相关及其与类星体互相关分成三个红移 bin 做 BAO 分析。
摘要报告各红移 bin 的径向、横向 BAO 精度约为 2.0%--2.5%，并给出膨胀历史与聚类演化测量。
三 bin Lyα BAO 与 DESI DR2 星系、类星体 BAO 结合后，与单 bin Lyα BAO 的宇宙学约束一致，并改善曲率约束。

papers.title: Accelerating expansion and isotropic sky-hemisphere consistency in Pantheon+ supernovae: a revised analysis in the dark energy debate
papers.abstract: We perform four independent decompositions of the deceleration parameter $q_0$ using 1564 Type Ia supernovae (SNe Ia) from the Pantheon+ catalogue: by redshift bin, sky hemisphere, host galaxy mass, and supernova colour, correcting a coordinate error identified by Sah, Rameez & Sarkar (SRS26) in the sky-hemisphere direction used in our original analysis. Without any progenitor-age correction, the full sample yields $q_m=-0.490$, consistent with the $Λ$CDM expectation of $-0.55$. Applying the Son et al. (S25) progenitor-age correction shifts this to $q_m=-0.267$, remaining in the accelerating regime. The sky hemisphere test, using the corrected CMB dipole direction (RA$=167.80^\circ$, Dec$=-7.10^\circ$), shows consistent results between the CMB dipole ($q_m=-0.527$) and anti-dipole ($q_m=-0.464$) hemispheres, supporting isotropy but not the strong deceleration values reported previously. Our revised results are consistent with \lcdm{} and do not support either the original claim of near-zero baseline acceleration or the S25/SRS26 claim of a decelerating universe.

papers.title: Reading Between the Lines: Forward Modeling Dust, Continuum, and Spectral Cleaning for Multi-Line Intensity Mapping
papers.abstract: Line intensity mapping (LIM) offers a tomographic view of galaxy evolution by measuring the aggregate emission from unresolved galaxies. In the optical and near-infrared, the line emission is accompanied by much brighter continuum emission that must be removed to recover line auto- and cross-power spectra. We develop a forward-modeling framework using a $\sim2$deg$^2$ lightcone drawn from a cosmological $N$-body simulation populated with galaxies using a physics-based semi-analytic model (SAM). We construct intensity maps for the stellar continuum and for the strongest optical lines, H$α$, H$β$, [O III] $\lambda5007$, and [O II] $\lambda3727$, including nebular dust attenuation tied to galaxy properties. From these cubes, we measure cross-channel angular power spectra, $C_\ell(λ_i,λ_j)$, and the normalized correlation matrix $r_{ij}$. In line-only maps, the correlation matrices show same-redshift ridges between emission lines, demonstrating how multi-line intensity mapping (MLIM) can isolate large-scale structure and probe dust attenuation. We show that dust suppresses the line cross-power by an amount that depends on galaxy properties, wavelength, and line pair, so a single overall amplitude cannot capture its effect. In total maps, however, the continuum dominates the raw correlations and hides much of the line-ridge structure. We therefore apply principal component analysis (PCA)-based spectral cleaning and quantify the line-transfer function using the simulation truth. Removing 20 PCA modes gives the best trade-off between line recovery and continuum suppression in our mock maps. Our results demonstrate the promise and challenges of extracting dust-sensitive LIM observables from SPHEREx-like observations, and highlight the need to model continuum cleaning and its transfer function in quantitative inference pipelines.

analysis.title_zh: 读懂谱线之间：面向多谱线强度映射的尘埃、连续谱与光谱清理前向建模
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对光学/近红外谱线强度映射中明亮连续谱掩盖谱线功率谱的问题，基于宇宙学 N 体模拟 lightcone 和半解析星系模型前向构建连续谱、Hα、Hβ、[O III] 与 [O II] 强度立方体，并测量跨通道角功率谱和相关矩阵。摘要报告称，多谱线相关可显示同红移 ridge 并探测尘埃消光，但总图中连续谱主导相关；PCA 光谱清理后需用模拟真值刻画谱线 transfer function，在该 mock 中去除 20 个模式给出较佳折中。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇工作与 CMB 研究的联系主要在于大尺度结构示踪和前景处理：LIM 可作为 CMB lensing、ISW 或其他大尺度结构观测的互相关对象，而连续谱/尘埃清理及其 transfer function 的建模问题与 CMB 前景分离中的系统误差传播高度相似。对计划使用 SPHEREx-like LIM 数据进行宇宙学推断或与 CMB 交叉分析的读者尤其相关。

在 mock 图中，PCA 去除 20 个模式被摘要报告为谱线恢复与连续谱抑制之间的最佳折中。
